c86ad4c767d3b9305ad83d84839c7430bc0ed673.title: DreamVLA: From Generated Human Motions to Humanoid Vision-Language-Action Policies
c86ad4c767d3b9305ad83d84839c7430bc0ed673.comment: Accepted to CoRL 2026 workshops G2A: From Generative Models to Robot Actions and Open Problems in Contact-Rich Loco-Manipulation
c86ad4c767d3b9305ad83d84839c7430bc0ed673.summary: Training vision-language-action (VLA) policies typically depends on substantial robot demonstration data, making human teleoperation a costly and cumbersome bottleneck, particularly for whole-body humanoid interaction. Reinforcement learning in simulation offers an alternative for scaling this data, but designing task-specific rewards remains challenging. To address this, we propose DreamVLA, which uses generated motion trajectories to guide reinforcement learning (RL) in simulation, converting them into reliable task execution trajectories. These trajectories train VLA models in simulation without new task-specific teleoperation data. Our central contribution is a reference-conditioned DAgger distillation procedure: after a failed learner rollout, we restart the RL expert from a sampled learner state with the same reference suffix and aggregate successful corrective trajectories, addressing the distribution shift left by offline imitation. We evaluate picking from a platform, opening a drawer, pressing a button, and walking and picking from a platform, with ablations of DAgger iterations, residual RL, and generated dataset scale. Project website: this http URL .

AI.tldr: 为绕开人形全身遥操作数据瓶颈，DreamVLA 用生成的人体运动轨迹引导仿真中的强化学习，把其转化为可靠的任务执行轨迹来训练 VLA 策略，核心是参考条件化的 DAgger 蒸馏。摘要报告了评测任务与消融维度，但未给出任何数值结果。
AI.motivation: 训练 VLA 策略通常依赖大量机器人演示数据，人类遥操作成本高且繁琐，对全身人形交互尤为如此。仿真中的强化学习虽可替代式地扩展数据，但设计任务专用奖励仍然困难。
AI.method: 输入是生成的运动轨迹（作为参考），方法让这些轨迹去引导仿真中的 RL，把 RL 产出转化为可执行任务轨迹，再用这些轨迹在仿真中训练 VLA 模型，从而不需要新的任务专用遥操作数据。相对既有做法的关键改动是"参考条件化的 DAgger 蒸馏"：当学习者 rollout 失败后，把 RL 专家从采样的学习者状态重新启动，并保留相同的参考后缀，把成功的纠正轨迹汇总起来，以应对离线模仿留下的分布偏移。输出是可执行任务轨迹及据此训练的 VLA 策略。摘要未说明生成运动轨迹的具体来源模型。
AI.result: 摘要称该流程可在不使用新任务专用遥操作数据的情况下于仿真中训练 VLA 模型，但未报告任何数值、指标或与基线的对比。评测任务为：从平台拾取、打开抽屉、按下按钮、行走并从平台拾取；消融维度为 DAgger 迭代次数、残差 RL 与生成数据集规模。作者未在摘要中声明 SOTA。
AI.conclusion: 对具身智能而言，该工作提出一条"生成运动先验 + 仿真 RL + DAgger 式纠正蒸馏"的数据来源替代路径，重点在于减少任务专用遥操作数据与人工奖励设计的依赖；世界模型（Dream）部分仅体现在"生成运动轨迹"的措辞上，摘要未展开。由于摘要无任何数值结果、未报告真实机器人实验与计算开销，其有效性、泛化性与效率均无法从摘要判断。
AI.core_method: 用生成的人体运动轨迹作为参考来引导仿真 RL，并通过从学习者失败状态重启专家、保留同一参考后缀来收集纠正轨迹，把这些纠正轨迹蒸馏进 VLA 策略。
limitations: 摘要未报告任何定量结果（无指标、无数值、无基线对比），因此无法判断相对提升幅度。
摘要未提及真实机器人实验，所述训练与轨迹收集均在仿真中进行，真实部署效果属摘要未报告信息。
作者仅把'设计任务专用奖励困难'与'遥操作数据昂贵'作为动机陈述，摘要未报告方法自身的失败情形、奖励设计细节或生成运动数据的质量上限。

d2f809cd7ad60d90e4ef8ae63ee2cf2cbca9a7a5.title: Task-Critical Part Alignment Improves Imitation of Object Interactions
d2f809cd7ad60d90e4ef8ae63ee2cf2cbca9a7a5.comment: 6 pages, 6 figures. Accepted at ICAR 2025. This is the preprint version; the published version may differ slightly
d2f809cd7ad60d90e4ef8ae63ee2cf2cbca9a7a5.summary: This paper presents enhancements to the DINOBot framework for imitation learning of object-object interactions. We introduce two key contributions aimed at improving the accuracy and efficiency of alignment in imitation-based robotic tasks. First, we integrate RANdom SAmple Consensus (RANSAC) for outlier rejection during the alignment phase, effectively mitigating the impact of noisy depth data and spurious feature matches. This improves robustness when transferring demonstrations to real-world applications. Second, we refine the semantic correspondence process by focusing on task-relevant interaction regions, ensuring that the learned representation prioritizes critical object features that influence successful manipulation. We evaluated our approach in a range of real-world manipulation tasks, including picking, insertion, shaking, and pouring, using a robotic system. The experimental results demonstrate an overall improvement of 13.8% in task success rates compared to the baseline, along with faster convergence in the alignment process. These results highlight the effectiveness of our enhancements in improving precision and efficiency for object-object interaction imitation in robotics.

AI.tldr: 在 DINOBot 模仿学习框架中加入 RANSAC 离群点剔除，并把语义对应聚焦到任务相关的交互区域，用于对象-对象交互的示范对齐；作者报告在抓取、插入、摇晃、倾倒等真实机器人任务上任务成功率整体提升 13.8%，且对齐过程收敛更快。
AI.motivation: 摘要指出，示范向真实世界迁移时的对齐精度与效率不足：深度数据噪声与虚假特征匹配会损害对齐鲁棒性，且此前的语义对应过程未把学习到的表示集中在真正影响操作成败的关键物体特征上。
AI.method: 输入是对象-对象交互的示范与物体观测，在 DINOBot 模仿学习框架内做示范到真实场景的对齐。方法相对基线做了两处改动：一是在对齐阶段引入 RANSAC 做离群点剔除，以抑制噪声深度数据与错误特征匹配的影响；二是把语义对应过程限制/聚焦到任务相关的交互区域，使学习到的表示优先关注对成功操作起关键作用的物体特征。输出是更稳健的任务关键部件对齐结果，用于在真实机器人系统上执行模仿得到的操作。
AI.result: 作者在真实机器人系统上评测了抓取、插入、摇晃、倾倒等操作任务，报告任务成功率相比基线整体提升 13.8%，并对齐过程收敛更快。摘要未报告各项任务的分项成功率、样本量、统计显著性，也未给出收敛加速的具体数值，因此无法判断 13.8% 是相对提升还是百分点提升。摘要中未出现"最先进/SOTA"类表述，"基线"未在摘要中点名。
AI.conclusion: 对具身智能而言，该工作的意义在于：示范模仿中的对齐环节可以靠几何鲁棒估计（离群点剔除）与任务相关的语义聚焦同时改善成功率与对齐效率，且证据来自真实机器人操作任务而非仅仿真。但证据边界有限——摘要只给出一个总体成功率改善值与"收敛更快"的定性说法，未给出分任务结果、任务设置细节与统计检验，也未说明该结论在未见物体或新任务上的泛化性。
AI.core_method: 在对齐阶段用 RANSAC 剔除错误匹配、并将语义对应限制在任务相关交互区域，从而更稳健地把示范迁移到真实机器人。

key_results.finding: 在真实机器人操作任务（抓取、插入、摇晃、倾倒）上，任务成功率相比基线整体提升 13.8%
key_results.setting: 真实世界操作任务：picking、insertion、shaking、pouring，使用机器人系统；基线与具体任务设置摘要未报告
key_results.evidence_quote: The experimental results demonstrate an overall improvement of 13.8% in task success rates compared to the baseline, along with faster convergence in the alignment process.

key_results.setting: 同上真实机器人操作评测；加速幅度与度量摘要未报告
key_results.evidence_quote: along with faster convergence in the alignment process

key_results.finding: 作者称这些改进提升了对齐的精度与效率（定性总结，无新增数值）

limitations: 摘要未报告 13.8% 是相对百分比提升还是百分点提升，也未报告各任务分项成功率、试验次数/样本量与统计显著性——属于信息缺失，不代表方法本身无此项数据。
摘要只给出"收敛更快"的定性描述，未报告对齐收敛速度的量化指标（如耗时、迭代次数）——属于信息缺失。

582d479009f6cbedae7a5d24bc7eb5c4443adea1.title: Tactile Sensors Are an Effective Substitute for Wrist Cameras in Contact-Rich or Occluded Manipulation
582d479009f6cbedae7a5d24bc7eb5c4443adea1.comment: Accepted at the 3rd Workshop on Dexterous Manipulation: Full-Stack Robotics on Learning and Design, CoRL 2026
582d479009f6cbedae7a5d24bc7eb5c4443adea1.summary: Learned manipulation policies often rely on wrist-mounted cameras for close-range visual feedback that complements external views of the workspace. However, contact-rich manipulation requires establishing and maintaining contacts that can remain hidden even from wrist cameras. Tactile sensors mounted on fingers can reliably and directly measure contact, without needing visual access. In this work, we show that this feedback enables policies to recover the performance advantage of wrist cameras using scene and egocentric vision together with touch. Our approach incorporates two low-cost tactile arrays into a visuotactile ACT policy, without wrist images during training or deployment. We evaluate six real-world task families spanning placement, insertion, occluded retrieval, and sustained-contact tool use. On three contact-rich tasks, we independently vary wrist-camera and tactile availability while keeping the demonstrations, policy architecture, and optimization settings fixed. Adding wrist cameras improves success by 18.3-28.3 percentage points over vision without wrist images. Adding tactile sensing instead improves success by 31.7-60.0 percentage points and yields higher observed success than vision-only policies with wrist cameras on all three tasks, with significant advantages on two under Holm-corrected tests. These results support finger-mounted tactile sensing as an effective alternative to wrist cameras in the evaluated contact-rich settings.

AI.tldr: 在需要建立并维持接触的操作中，作者把两个低成本指尖触觉阵列接入 visuotactile ACT 策略，训练与部署都不使用腕部图像；在 3 个接触丰富任务上，触觉带来的成功率提升（31.7–60.0 个百分点）超过腕部相机（18.3–28.3 个百分点），并在 3 个任务上均高于"有腕部相机的纯视觉策略"。
AI.motivation: 摘要指出，学习型操作策略常依赖腕部相机提供近距离视觉反馈以补充外部视角，但接触丰富操作需要建立并维持接触，而这些接触即使对腕部相机也可能被遮挡；指尖触觉传感器可以直接、可靠地测量接触，无需视觉通路。这构成用触觉替代腕部相机的动机。
AI.method: 输入是场景视觉、自视角（egocentric）视觉以及来自两个低成本指尖触觉阵列的接触反馈；方法把这两个触觉阵列集成进 visuotactile ACT 策略，训练和部署阶段均不提供腕部图像。相对基线（同一策略仅用场景与自视角视觉，以及该视觉加腕部相机），变化点仅在于反馈来源：用指尖触觉替换腕部相机，而演示数据、策略架构与优化设置保持固定。输出是在真实世界任务中执行放置、插入、遮挡取物与持续接触工具使用等操作的策略。
AI.result: 在真实世界 6 个任务族（涵盖放置、插入、遮挡取物、持续接触工具使用）上评估；其中 3 个接触丰富任务上独立改变腕部相机与触觉的可用性，固定演示、架构与优化设置。作者报告：加入腕部相机比"无腕部图像的视觉"提升成功率 18.3–28.3 个百分点；改用触觉则提升 31.7–60.0 个百分点，并在全部 3 个任务上取得高于"带腕部相机的纯视觉策略"的观测成功率，其中 2 个任务在 Holm 校正检验下具有显著优势。摘要未给出各任务绝对成功率、具体基线名称或样本量。
AI.conclusion: 对具身智能而言，这项工作给出一个证据受限但方向明确的结论：在本文评估的接触丰富场景中，指尖触觉可作为腕部相机的有效替代，使策略恢复并超过腕部相机带来的性能优势。证据范围限于作者所述的 6 个真实世界任务族、其中 3 个任务的受控对照，以及观测成功率指标；摘要未报告真实部署条件之外的泛化性、硬件细节或延迟，因此不宜外推为触觉在所有操作场景中普遍优于腕部相机。
AI.core_method: 把两个低成本指尖触觉阵列接入 visuotactile ACT 策略，用"场景+自视角视觉+触觉"取代训练与部署中的腕部图像。
limitations: 作者自述的范围限制：结论仅支持“在本文评估的接触丰富场景中”触觉可作为腕部相机的替代（原摘要明确以 in the evaluated contact-rich settings 界定）。
作者自述的统计结果限制：3 个接触丰富任务中仅 2 个在 Holm 校正检验下显著占优，第 3 个仅报告观测成功率更高。

0506e985211b5021b74d9894940a3aade985796e.title: RoboMoCap: A Large-Scale Whole-Body Motion Capture Dataset with Egocentric Vision for Robot Learning
0506e985211b5021b74d9894940a3aade985796e.summary: Humanoid robots must coordinate locomotion and manipulation to navigate complex environments and perform everyday tasks. Learning such behaviours from human demonstrations requires accurate whole-body motion paired with egocentric vision, particularly for lower-body movements and foot placements that are frequently invisible from a first-person perspective. However, existing egocentric datasets often lack high-fidelity optical motion capture or systematic coverage of diverse loco-manipulation behaviours. To address this gap, we introduce RoboMoCap, a large-scale multimodal dataset combining egocentric vision with marker-based optical motion capture, specifically designed for locomotion-centric humanoid learning. RoboMoCap comprises over 200 hours of recordings from 14 participants, featuring six head-mounted cameras, wrist-mounted visual and inertial sensing, and optical full-body motion capture at 120 Hz. The dataset systematically covers diverse locomotion primitives, dynamic whole-body movements, and loco-manipulation tasks, including variable-speed walking, turning, constrained navigation, terrain traversal, object transportation, and manipulation during locomotion. It provides temporally aligned multimodal observations and metric whole-body motion representations, enabling the study of human movement beyond directly observable body regions. We systematically evaluate existing methods on three benchmark tasks: egocentric full-body motion reconstruction, foot contact and placement estimation, and human-to-humanoid motion retargeting. By pairing egocentric vision with high-fidelity human motion across diverse locomotion and interaction scenarios, RoboMoCap provides a foundation for egocentric motion understanding and humanoid learning from human demonstrations.

AI.tldr: RoboMoCap 是一个大规模多模态数据集，把第一视角视觉与标记式光学全身动捕配对，面向以运动为主的人形机器人学习，并给出三项基准任务（第一视角全身运动重建、足部接触与落点估计、人到人形机器人的运动重定向）。摘要未报告基准任务的数值结果。
AI.motivation: 从人类演示中学习人形机器人的运动与操作，需要把准确的全身运动与第一视角视觉配对；但第一视角常看不到下肢与落足。摘要指出，已有第一视角数据集往往缺少高保真光学动捕，也缺少对不同运动-操作行为的系统性覆盖。
AI.method: 输入是多模态同步记录：6 个头部摄像头、腕部视觉与惯性传感，以及 120 Hz 的标记式光学全身动捕，来自 14 名参与者的 200 余小时录制。数据集系统覆盖变速行走、转身、受限导航、地形通过、搬运物体、行走中操作等运动基元与全身动态动作，并提供时间对齐的多模态观测与度量全身运动表示。产出是一个可支撑三项基准评测的数据集：第一视角全身运动重建、足部接触与落点估计、人到人形机器人的运动重定向。
AI.result: 作者报告数据集规模为超过 200 小时、14 名参与者、6 个头部摄像头与 120 Hz 光学全身动捕，并在三项基准任务上系统评测了现有方法；摘要未给出任何基准任务的指标数值、对比基线或相对提升。
AI.conclusion: 对具身智能与人形学习而言，该工作的价值在于提供第一视角视觉与高保真人体运动的对齐数据，使下肢等不可直接观测区域的运动也能被学习与评测。摘要未报告量化性能，也未说明是否包含真实机器人实验，因此方法效果与可迁移性尚无摘要层面的证据。
AI.core_method: 把头部第一视角相机、腕部视觉-惯性传感与 120 Hz 标记式光学全身动捕时间对齐，构建覆盖运动与运动-操作场景的人体多模态数据集。
limitations: 作者自述的缺口指向已有工作（第一视角数据集缺少高保真光学动捕与系统的运动-操作行为覆盖），而非本文方法自身的局限；摘要未报告本文数据集的局限。
摘要未报告三项基准任务的具体指标、数值、基线与统计信息，因此无法判断方法在该数据集上的性能水平。
摘要未报告是否包含真实人形机器人部署或仿真实验，也未提及数据采集的伦理、标注一致性与许可等细节（摘要未报告）。

982b890c4eb350e5809f2cd2ad29fe24b168fa77.title: MoE-DAgger: Transition-Aware Router-Entropy Gating for Selective Human Correction in Phase-Structured Manipulation
982b890c4eb350e5809f2cd2ad29fe24b168fa77.comment: 9 pages, 5 figures, 5 tables. Project page: this https URL
982b890c4eb350e5809f2cd2ad29fe24b168fa77.summary: Selective data acquisition in Dataset Aggregation (DAgger) on robots requires deciding which learner rollouts to correct and when to intervene. In manipulation with ordered phases, router entropy from a phase-supervised soft mixture-of-experts (MoE) is insufficient: the same value can reflect either a normal adjacent-phase handoff or support for nonadjacent or earlier phases. We propose MoE-DAgger, which uses causal router history to distinguish these cases without providing the policy with a phase label, progress variable, or hard phase command during execution. The acquisition rule allows an adjacent transition to settle, but requests correction when high entropy persists outside such a transition, the transition times out, or routing persistently favors an earlier phase. Under matched active human-control budgets, MoE-DAgger achieves 84.0% task success on Green and 78.0% on Red, exceeding phase-unaware filtered entropy by 22 percentage points on Green and 26 points on Red, with no observed collisions in 50 rollouts per task. On 50 shared intervention-free traces per task, 83.3% and 80.0% of its first proposals fall on failed rollouts within predefined failure windows when 15 and 25 traces are selected, compared with 70.0% and 72.0% for temporal action-chunk disagreement and 63.3% and 60.0% for ensemble disagreement. Shadow replay and an active no-veto ablation indicate that suppressing queries at normal adjacent handoffs is a key contributor to the improved allocation.

AI.tldr: 针对 DAgger 中"该纠正哪些机器人 rollout、何时介入"的问题，作者提出 MoE-DAgger：用因果 router 历史判断高熵是正常相邻阶段交接还是真正需要纠正，从而选择性请求人工纠正。在匹配人工控制预算下，两任务成功率 84.0% 与 78.0%，分别高于 phase-unaware filtered entropy 22 与 26 个百分点。
AI.motivation: 在有序阶段的机器人操作任务中，基于阶段监督软 MoE 的 router 熵本身不足以作为介入信号：同一个熵值既可能来自正常的相邻阶段交接，也可能来自对非相邻阶段或更早阶段的支持，因此单看熵值无法区分"正常切换"与"学习者出错"。
AI.method: 输入是学习者 rollout 与 phase-supervised soft MoE 的 router 输出（含路由分布及其随时间的因果历史）。方法不向策略提供阶段标签、进度变量或硬阶段指令，而是在执行时用因果 router 历史来解释当前熵：若高熵出现在相邻阶段交接处，允许其自行收敛；若高熵在非交接情形下持续存在、交接超时、或路由持续偏向更早阶段，则触发一次人工纠正请求。输出是选择性的介入/纠正请求序列（即被采集的纠正数据），而非新的策略网络结构。
AI.result: 在匹配的主动人工控制预算下，MoE-DAgger 在 Green 与 Red 两个任务上分别取得 84.0% 和 78.0% 的任务成功率，相对 phase-unaware filtered entropy 分别高出 22 和 26 个百分点，每任务 50 次 rollout 中未观察到碰撞。在每任务 50 条共享的、无人工介入的轨迹上，选取 15 条与 25 条轨迹时，其首个提议分别有 83.3% 与 80.0% 落在预定义失败窗口内的失败 rollout 上；对应比较为 temporal action-chunk disagreement 的 70.0% 与 72.0%，以及 ensemble disagreement 的 63.3% 与 60.0%。shadow replay 与 active no-veto 消融表明，抑制正常相邻交接处的查询是分配效果提升的关键来源。
AI.conclusion: 对具身智能的数据采集而言，这说明"何时介入"的解释性信号（router 历史而非瞬时熵）可能比单纯用不确定性或模型分歧排序更能把有限的人工纠正预算投向失败轨迹。证据边界：结论建立在 Green/Red 两个有序阶段操作任务、匹配人工控制预算、每任务 50 次 rollout 与 50 条轨迹的协议之上；摘要未说明这些结果是仿真还是真机实验，也未报告训练/数据规模、延迟或统计显著性。
AI.core_method: 用 MoE 路由器输出的因果历史区分"正常相邻阶段交接"与"真正的学习失败"，只在前者之外申请人工纠正，且执行时不给策略任何阶段标签或进度信息。

key_results.finding: 在匹配主动人工控制预算下，MoE-DAgger 任务成功率为 Green 84.0%、Red 78.0%，比 phase-unaware filtered entropy 高 22 个百分点（Green）与 26 个百分点（Red）；每任务 50 次 rollout 未见碰撞。
key_results.setting: 有序阶段操作任务 Green 与 Red；对比基线为 phase-unaware filtered entropy；人工控制预算匹配；每任务 50 次 rollout。摘要未说明是仿真还是真机，也未给出预算的具体数值。
key_results.evidence_quote: Under matched active human-control budgets, MoE-DAgger achieves 84.0% task success on Green and 78.0% on Red, exceeding phase-unaware filtered entropy by 22 percentage points on Green and 26 points on Red, with no observed collisions in 50 rollouts per task.

key_results.finding: 在每任务 50 条无介入轨迹上，选取 15/25 条时首个提议落在失败窗口内失败 rollout 的比例为 83.3%/80.0%，高于 temporal action-chunk disagreement 的 70.0%/72.0% 与 ensemble disagreement 的 63.3%/60.0%。
key_results.setting: 每任务 50 条共享的 intervention-free 轨迹；预定义失败窗口；基线为 temporal action-chunk disagreement 与 ensemble disagreement；选取数量为 15 和 25。
key_results.evidence_quote: On 50 shared intervention-free traces per task, 83.3% and 80.0% of its first proposals fall on failed rollouts within predefined failure windows when 15 and 25 traces are selected, compared with 70.0% and 72.0% for temporal action-chunk disagreement and 63.3% and 60.0% for ensemble disagreement.

key_results.finding: 作者报告 shadow replay 与 active no-veto 消融表明，抑制正常相邻交接处的查询是分配效果提升的关键因素（未给出消融数值）。
key_results.setting: shadow replay 与 active no-veto 消融；摘要未报告消融的具体指标数值与实验条件。
key_results.evidence_quote: Shadow replay and an active no-veto ablation indicate that suppressing queries at normal adjacent handoffs is a key contributor to the improved allocation.

limitations: 作者未在摘要中列出明确的局限性；摘要未报告方法的失败情形或适用边界。

e25b8aca50539f7facbe00beba72cdb1c0060f4a.title: Model-Based Imitation Learning For Monocular Vision-Based Navigation
e25b8aca50539f7facbe00beba72cdb1c0060f4a.summary: Reliable navigation with a single monocular limited field-of-view camera is challenging because the lack of depth measurements and limited spatial awareness complicate collision checking. Existing approaches to tackle these challenges fall into two categories. Model-based planners can incorporate explicit collision-avoidance guidance which leads to better generalization but are often computationally expensive and require manual tuning of the algorithmic parameters. In contrast, end-to-end approaches trained by imitation learning can be flexible but typically encode safety only implicitly and thus can suffer from high collision rates in novel scenarios. In this paper, we present a middle ground through model-based imitation learning. The model-based part is a learned collision model that can map a sequence of past images and a candidate control sequence to a distribution of worst-case obstacle clearance. This predictive distribution in turn is used to define a collision-risk cost in a trajectory optimization formulation. The imitation component uses human demonstrations to learn scene-dependent balancing of collision risk with other task costs such as goal progress. We also use it to learn the algorithmic parameters (e.g., a warm start) of our optimizer to accelerate the solution process. We show that our approach can demonstrate highly reliable navigation in cluttered environments on robots with different embodiments. We also demonstrate a substantial reduction in collision rate over recent end-to-end and model-based baselines.

AI.tldr: 针对单目受限视野相机在杂乱环境中避障困难的问题，论文提出"模型驱动的模仿学习"折衷方案：学习一个碰撞模型，将过去图像序列与候选控制序列映射为最坏情况障碍间隙的分布，并把该分布定义为轨迹优化中的碰撞风险代价；同时用人类示范学习随场景变化的风险-任务代价权衡以及优化器参数（如热启动）以加速求解。作者报告可在不同本体机器人上于杂乱环境实现高可靠导航，并相对近期端到端与模型规划基线大幅降低碰撞率（摘要未给出任何数值）。
AI.motivation: 单目、有限视野相机缺少深度测量与空间感知，使碰撞检查变得困难。既有两类方法各有缺陷：模型规划器能引入显式避障引导因而泛化更好，但通常计算开销大且需要手工调整算法参数；由模仿学习训练的端到端方法灵活，但安全性只是隐含编码，在新场景中可能出现高碰撞率。
AI.method: 输入是过去图像的序列与一条候选控制序列，方法据此学习一个碰撞模型，输出"最坏情况障碍间隙"的预测分布；该分布被用来定义轨迹优化目标中的碰撞风险代价。模仿部分用人类示范做两件事：一是学习依赖场景地平衡碰撞风险与其他任务代价（如目标进展），二是学习优化器自身的算法参数（例如热启动）以加速求解过程。相对所描述的基线（显式避障的模型规划器与端到端模仿学习），本方法把"显式碰撞风险预测"与"示范驱动的代价权衡和求解器调参"结合，最终输出杂乱环境中的导航控制/轨迹。
AI.result: 摘要只给出定性结论，未报告任务名、benchmark、指标、数值、单位或比较条件。作者报告两点：在杂乱环境、不同本体机器人上实现"高可靠导航"；相对近期端到端与模型规划基线出现"碰撞率的大幅下降"。由于没有数值，"大幅下降"无法判断是相对百分比改进还是百分点改进，也无法判断是否为真机结果。这两点均为作者自述主张，未经独立验证。
AI.conclusion: 对具身智能/世界模型方向的意义在于：把显式碰撞风险（以学习到的间隙分布形式）作为代价接入轨迹优化，并用示范学习"场景相关的风险-任务权衡"和求解器参数，构成模型规划与端到端模仿学习之间的中间路线，且声称可跨本体迁移。但证据仅限摘要层：没有量化结果、没有真机与仿真的区分、没有平台与基线细节，因此"更可靠"和"碰撞率大幅降低"应视为未量化的作者主张，不宜据此推断其实用性、实时性或安全性保证。
AI.core_method: 用人类示范训练一个能把图像序列加候选控制序列映射为最坏情况障碍间隙分布的碰撞模型，把该分布作为碰撞风险代价加入轨迹优化，同时学会场景相关的风险与任务代价权衡，并学习优化器的热启动等参数以加速求解。

9930f5073c8519129ba604e303b47dc99c3a93e6.title: ObjectWorld: Scaling Object-Centric World Models with A Large-Scale 3D Full-Object Flow Dataset
9930f5073c8519129ba604e303b47dc99c3a93e6.summary: Generative world modeling from large-scale visual data offers a promising path toward scalable robot manipulation. This calls for an intermediate representation that can be supervised at scale and remains actionable for downstream control. We propose 3D full-object flow, an object-centric motion representation that assigns dense 3D trajectories to points across the complete surface of a target object, including its occluded regions. By extending visible-surface object flow to the full object geometry, this representation makes complete object motion explicit and applies uniformly to both rigid and deformable objects. To realize the potential of this representation at scale, we introduce a 1210-hour full-object flow dataset that addresses the scarcity of large-scale supervision for complete 3D object motion. The dataset integrates diverse real-world videos and physical simulations, with a scalable annotation pipeline for recovering full-object motion from real-world observations and quality metrics for systematically assessing annotation quality. We then train a world model that takes an image and a task description as input and predicts dense full-object flow over the reconstructed object geometry. Experiments show reliable annotation quality, data-scalable flow prediction, and effective downstream manipulation across novel scenes and robot embodiments. Project website with additional results and videos: this https URL .

AI.tldr: 提出“3D full-object flow”：为目标物体完整表面（含遮挡区域）上的点分配稠密3D轨迹，并构建1210小时数据集训练以图像和任务描述为输入的世界模型，用于下游机器人操作。
AI.motivation: 摘要指出，大规模视觉数据的世界建模有望支撑可扩展的机器人操作，但需要一个既能大规模监督、又能用于下游控制的中间运动表示；完整3D物体运动的监督数据仍然稀缺。
AI.method: 方法先把可见表面的物体流扩展到完整物体几何，输出覆盖物体全部表面（包括被遮挡部分）的稠密3D点轨迹，并统一处理刚性与可变形物体。为扩大监督规模，作者构建1210小时全物体流数据集，混合真实视频与物理仿真，并提供从真实观测恢复全物体运动的标注流程及标注质量指标。世界模型接收图像和任务描述，在重建的物体几何上预测稠密全物体流；摘要未说明网络结构或训练细节。
AI.result: 作者报告标注质量可靠、流预测可随数据扩展，并能在新场景和新机器人本体上支持有效下游操作；摘要未报告具体基准、指标数值或基线比较。数据集规模为1210小时，融合真实视频与物理仿真。
AI.conclusion: 该工作把“完整物体3D运动”作为可规模监督且可供控制使用的中间表示，并用大规模混合数据训练世界模型，指向跨场景、跨本体的操作泛化。但摘要只给出定性成效，尚无具体任务指标、真实/仿真分解或基线差距，不能据此判断相对现有方法的实际增益。

7297bd927cb0f427bae64ea90b4f5e3084bc3c4d.title: BAT-WAM: Bridging Action and Touch in World-Action Models for Dexterous Hands
7297bd927cb0f427bae64ea90b4f5e3084bc3c4d.summary: Dexterous manipulation with world action models (WAMs) relies on hand configuration and contact information, yet joint-state and whole-hand tactile observations may be partially or entirely missing. RGB images provide scene context and hand-object geometry but are insufficient to reliably recover these missing modalities. We further observe a correlation between hand state and tactile information. Motivated by this observation, we introduce BAT-WAM, a framework that bridges visual, joint-state, and tactile representations for WAMs. BAT-WAM learns separate codebooks and decoders for the tactile and action streams. An RGB-conditioned continuous latent bridge connects the two streams for bidirectional learning, while visual information serves as continuous context. Under the HTBench evaluation protocol, BAT-WAM reduces the root mean squared error (RMSE) of tactile reconstruction by 34.73% under fully masked conditions and 38.84% under partially masked conditions, relative to an image-conditioned HandTouch checkpoint. For future tactile prediction conditioned on target-time RGB and historical actions, it reduces mean RMSE by 85.56% relative to OpenWAM with HandTouch. Real-robot experiments further show that BAT-WAM consistently outperforms related WAM baselines in dexterous manipulation. Generalization experiments on unseen objects and scenes also demonstrate substantial improvements over baseline models. These findings support joint modeling of visual context, hand state, and touch as a representation approach for multimodal WAMs.

AI.tldr: 针对灵巧手世界动作模型(WAM)中关节状态与全手触觉常缺失的问题，BAT-WAM 用以 RGB 为条件的连续潜桥连接触觉流与动作流并联合建模视觉上下文；作者报告在 HTBench 上大幅降低触觉重建与预测误差，并在真机灵巧操作中优于相关 WAM 基线。
AI.motivation: 灵巧操作的世界动作模型依赖手部构型与接触信息，但关节状态和全手触觉观测可能部分或完全缺失。RGB 虽提供场景上下文与手物几何，却不足以可靠恢复这些缺失模态。作者还观察到手部状态与触觉信息之间存在相关性，并以此作为方法动机。
AI.method: 输入包括 RGB 图像、关节状态与触觉信息（可能被完全或部分掩蔽）。方法为触觉流与动作流分别学习独立的码本与解码器；并用一个 RGB 条件的连续潜变量桥连接这两条流，进行双向学习，视觉信息作为连续上下文。输出为触觉表示（用于重建与未来预测）及动作相关表示，服务于下游 WAM 的灵巧操作。相对基线（如图像条件 HandTouch、OpenWAM with HandTouch）的改变在于不直接以图像条件恢复缺失触觉，而是通过跨动作—触觉流的潜桥双向传递信息。摘要未报告网络结构、训练目标与实现细节。
AI.result: 在 HTBench 评测协议下，作者报告触觉重建 RMSE 相对一个图像条件 HandTouch checkpoint 降低 34.73%（完全掩蔽条件）与 38.84%（部分掩蔽条件）；在以目标时刻 RGB 和历史动作为条件的未来触觉预测中，平均 RMSE 相对 OpenWAM with HandTouch 降低 85.56%。这些为相对百分比降幅，而非百分点差值。真机实验中 BAT-WAM 在灵巧操作上持续优于相关 WAM 基线，但未给出数值；在未见物体与场景的泛化实验中也报告相对基线的显著提升，同样未给出具体数值。摘要未报告样本量、统计显著性或硬件细节。
AI.conclusion: 该工作支持将视觉上下文、手部状态与触觉联合建模作为多模态 WAM 的一种表征思路：在给定评测协议与基线条件下，缺失触觉的重建与未来触觉预测误差均有明显相对下降，真机灵巧操作与未见物体/场景泛化上也报告优于基线。证据边界在于：所有结果均为作者报告，未独立验证；真机与泛化部分无数值、无统计检验；摘要未说明硬件平台、试验规模、训练代价与失效情形，因此不能据此推断方法的普适性或部署成本。
AI.core_method: 为触觉与动作分别学习码本和解码器，再用一个 RGB 条件的连续潜变量桥把两流双向连起来，视觉作为连续上下文。

key_results.setting: HTBench 评测协议；对照基线为图像条件 HandTouch checkpoint；摘要未报告硬件、样本量与统计显著性。

e66f92bcd9fed2ba20562d797ebf32546e416e2e.title: HSGNav: Hypothesis Scene Graphs for Multi-Scale Lifelong Navigation under Object Relocation
e66f92bcd9fed2ba20562d797ebf32546e416e2e.summary: In real homes, assistive robots must repeatedly locate targets from large furniture to tiny tabletop items, as people move objects between household surfaces. Uniformly instantiating detections at different scales as 3D objects can be brittle for small on-surface items; without explicit object-state validation, stale entries may persist after scene changes. Our key insight is to separate persistent 3D furniture entities from revisable surface-object hypotheses, retaining their visual evidence without requiring independent object geometry. We formalize this design as the Hypothesis Scene Graph (HSG), which preserves small-object evidence and supports local revision without rebuilding the stable entity topology. Building on HSG, HSGNav uses this separation for multi-scale lifelong navigation: retrieval selects entity or hypothesis evidence according to target scale, exploration acquires additional surface observations, and verification confirms target presence or invalidates contradicted hypothesis records. Because existing lifelong benchmarks such as GOAT-Bench rarely require mid-episode memory invalidation or multi-scale search, we introduce FAROS-Bench (Find And Re-find Objects across Scales) for mid-episode relocation of surface objects and multi-scale find goals. Experiments show that HSGNav performs competitively on GOAT-Bench while substantially outperforming prior methods on FAROS-Bench.

AI.tldr: 针对家庭中物体被移动后陈旧 3D 记录难以失效、小台面物体难以稳定建模的问题，作者把持久家具实体与可修订的台面物体假设分离为"假设场景图"HSG，并据此构建多尺度终身导航方法 HSGNav；作者报告其在 GOAT-Bench 上表现具竞争力、在自建 FAROS-Bench 上大幅优于先前方法（摘要未给任何数值）。
AI.motivation: 摘要指出：真实家庭中的辅助机器人需反复定位从大件家具到桌面小物的目标，而人会不断把物体在台面间移动。把不同尺度的检测统一实例化为 3D 物体对小型台面物体很脆弱；且缺少显式物体状态校验时，场景变化后陈旧条目会持续残留。作者还称现有终身基准（如 GOAT-Bench）很少要求回合中（mid-episode）记忆失效或多尺度搜索。
AI.method: 输入是多尺度目标与机器人连续观测/探索过程。HSG 把持久的 3D 家具实体与可修订的台面物体假设分开表示：小物体只保留视觉证据、不要求独立物体几何，因此可做局部修订而不必重建稳定的实体拓扑。HSGNav 在此表示上运行三步：检索按目标尺度选择实体证据或假设证据；探索获取更多台面观测；验证确认目标存在，或让被证据否定的假设记录失效。输出是这些记忆记录支撑下的多尺度终身导航目标定位。相对"统一实例化 + 无显式状态校验"的做法，改变的是记忆表示与更新方式。作者另提出 FAROS-Bench 基准，用于回合中台面物体移位与多尺度寻找目标。
AI.result: 作者报告 HSGNav 在 GOAT-Bench 上表现具竞争力，并在 FAROS-Bench 上大幅优于先前方法；摘要未报告任何指标、数值、单位或基线名称。
AI.conclusion: 对具身智能/世界模型研究的含义是：在终身导航这类长期记忆中，把稳定实体与可修订假设分离的场景表示，可能比统一 3D 实例化更适合多尺度、物体被移动的家庭场景。但证据仅为作者自述的定性比较，无量化结果，也未提及真实机器人部署；FAROS-Bench 的规模、指标与评测条件摘要未报告。
AI.core_method: 把持久家具实体与可修订的台面小物体假设分开存入场景图，小物体只保留视觉证据并可局部修订，再按目标尺度检索、探索补观测、验证并作废被否定的假设。

key_results.finding: 作者报告 HSGNav 在 GOAT-Bench 上表现具竞争力，并在 FAROS-Bench 上大幅优于先前方法；摘要未报告任何数值、指标或单位。
key_results.setting: 终身导航任务；对比对象仅表述为 prior methods，具体基线名称、评测指标与实验条件摘要未报告；未说明是否含真实机器人。
key_results.evidence_quote: Experiments show that HSGNav performs competitively on GOAT-Bench while substantially outperforming prior methods on FAROS-Bench.

limitations: 摘要未报告任何数值结果（指标、单位、基线名称），"performs competitively" 与 "substantially outperforming" 均为作者定性表述，无法判断改进幅度。
摘要未报告实验平台与是否在真实机器人上验证；若仅有仿真或数据集层面的结果，摘要未作说明（not reported in the abstract）。
作者自述的背景性局限是现有终身基准（如 GOAT-Bench）很少要求回合中记忆失效或多尺度搜索，这属于对基准覆盖面的陈述；方法自身的失败模式与局限摘要未报告。

b042b93396a1ff0416339aeca72cfd09ee678b49.title: Zero-Shot VLA Adaptation with Retrieved Guidance
b042b93396a1ff0416339aeca72cfd09ee678b49.summary: Pre-training large parametric "Vision-Language-Action" (VLA) models on large demonstration datasets has recently yielded promising results for general-purpose manipulation. However, these models still struggle under even small domain shifts relative to the training data, such as changes in camera viewpoint, background, object identity, or robot morphology. Motivated by the success of Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) in language models, we pursue retrieval to boost VLA performance. Specifically, we seek to leverage retrieval from domain-mismatched, "in-the-wild" demonstration datasets like DROID to guide a VLA's behavior in a new target domain. To achieve this, we introduce RAGu, which overcomes robotics-specific challenges for RAG: (1) It incorporates simple geometric calibration to transform source demonstrations into the target setup and reduce cross-domain differences. (2) It uses a coarse-to-fine retrieval strategy that selects, from a large pool of pre-warped candidates, the trajectory most compatible with the base VLA. (3) It guides the VLA's flow-matching inference procedure rather than seeking to retrain the base model or expand its limited context window. We evaluate RAGu across real-world, simulation, sim-to-real transfer, and cross-embodiment humanoid manipulation. We find it improves real-world VLA success rates from 20% to 80% and outperforms the closest-related baselines in sim. Project website: this http URL

AI.tldr: RAGu 用检索到的"野外"演示来引导已训练好的 VLA 推理：把源域轨迹几何校准到目标设置，再粗到细挑出与基座 VLA 最兼容的一条，注入其 flow-matching 推理过程。作者报告真实世界成功率由 20% 提升到 80%。
AI.motivation: 大规模演示数据预训练的 VLA 虽在通用操作上有前景，但在相对训练数据的微小域偏移下仍会失效，摘要点名的偏移包括相机视角、背景、物体身份与机器人形态。作者受语言模型 RAG 成功启发，转向检索来提升 VLA 表现。
AI.method: 输入是目标域下的观测，以及一个域不匹配的"野外"演示数据集（如 DROID）构成的候选轨迹池。方法做三件事：先用简单几何校准把源演示变换到目标设置，缩小跨域差异；再用粗到细的检索策略，从大量预先变形（pre-warped）的候选中选出与基座 VLA 最兼容的那条轨迹；最后不改基座模型、也不扩展其受限上下文窗口，而是把检索到的引导注入 VLA 的 flow-matching 推理过程。输出是受引导的动作轨迹，即在目标域中执行的操作行为。
AI.result: 作者报告真实世界 VLA 成功率从 20% 提升到 80%（绝对百分点变化，非相对百分比改进）；在仿真中优于最相关基线，但摘要未给出仿真数值、指标与基线名称。评估覆盖真实世界、仿真、sim-to-real 迁移与跨形态人形操作，其中后三类无定量结果披露。
AI.conclusion: 对具身智能研究者的含义是：在不重训基座 VLA、不扩展上下文窗口的前提下，用域不匹配的野外演示经几何校准与检索来引导推理，可能显著改善小域偏移下的操作成功率——但该结论目前仅由作者报告的真实世界 20%→80% 支撑，仿真优势无数值，跨形态与 sim-to-real 无定量证据，且未报告任何消融或统计检验，因此机制各部分（校准、粗到细检索、flow-matching 引导）各自的贡献尚不可知。
AI.core_method: 把域不匹配的源演示几何校准到目标设置，检索出与基座 VLA 最兼容的轨迹，并将其作为引导注入基座模型的 flow-matching 推理过程。

1c788e9868b1794a2c7617816a89e16fc1e613ef.title: DexForesight: Grounding Dexterous Policies with Implicit Spatial Foresight
1c788e9868b1794a2c7617816a89e16fc1e613ef.summary: Dexterous manipulation requires rich spatial foresight over both the surrounding scene and the robot hand. Existing world-action models often acquire such predictive knowledge through explicit future prediction. We introduce DexForesight, a framework that learns spatial foresight implicitly by injecting dynamics-aware world representations into the latent space of a dexterous policy. During training, DexForesight learns an action-conditioned spatial world model from offline scene depth, kinematic hand geometry, and demonstration trajectories. The world model predicts 3D hand-point motion and visual feature changes, capturing both articulated hand dynamics and scene changes under demonstrated actions, including the motion of fingers occluded from the cameras. We then freeze the world model and align policy queries with its predictive world queries, transferring the learned spatial dynamics into policy latents and using them to condition action generation. At deployment, only the policy is retained, operating on RGB observations, language, and robot state without depth input or explicit future prediction. On 11 DexJoCo simulation tasks, DexForesight improves the overall success rate of the base policy from 49.4% to 60.5%. On three real-robot dexterous manipulation tasks, DexForesight achieves 58.3% success, compared with 50.0% for the strongest this http URL page this https URL

AI.tldr: DexForesight 不再显式预测未来，而是用动作条件化的空间世界模型把动力学表征注入灵巧操作策略的潜空间，从而获得隐式空间前瞻。作者报告在 11 个 DexJoCo 仿真任务上把基策略成功率从 49.4% 提升到 60.5%，在三个真机灵巧操作任务上达到 58.3%（最强基线 50.0%）。

7ac77b2d60e8d5fad7facf4115764171faafb812.title: HARP-Bench: Benchmarking Robot Manipulation Around Active Humans
7ac77b2d60e8d5fad7facf4115764171faafb812.summary: Recent robot manipulation benchmarks have enabled systematic evaluation of general-purpose robot policies across diverse objects, scenes, instructions, and embodiments. However, most existing benchmarks still assume that the robot is the only active agent and that task semantics are determined primarily by the instruction and object state. This assumption overlooks a common source of real-world variation: humans actively sharing the workspace. In such settings, humans may reveal an implicit goal, complete part of the task, temporarily change object availability, or constrain safe robot motion while working nearby. We introduce HARP-Bench, a benchmark for evaluating robot manipulation policies in workspaces shared with active humans. HARP-Bench treats human activity as part of the manipulation problem, rather than as background scene variation. It organizes human-present manipulation into four conditions: Cueing, Contribution, Interruption, and Co-presence. These conditions are instantiated through everyday manipulation tasks, including paired human-present variants for controlled comparison with standard manipulation. HARP-Bench also provides a demonstration-generation pipeline for dynamic human-present settings. We evaluate VLA models, imitation-learning methods, and heuristic policies on HARP-Bench. Human-present variations challenge current policies, and higher task success does not consistently improve safety. Quantitative failure analysis identifies manipulation and recovery as the dominant remaining challenges. Training with HARP-Bench demonstrations improves human-present performance in simulation. A real-world study on one task family shows improved performance under human contribution, but not interruption, providing initial evidence of the data's utility and identifying limits of transfer. Code is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 现有操作基准大多假设机器人是唯一主动体、任务语义由指令与物体状态决定，忽略了人类主动共享工作空间。HARP-Bench 把人类活动当作操作问题的一部分，用四类条件（Cueing、Contribution、Interruption、Co-presence）与演示生成流程来训练和评测策略；作者报告用它训练可提升仿真中的有人场景表现，真机仅在一个任务族的人类贡献条件下提升。
AI.motivation: 现有基准默认机器人是唯一主动智能体，任务语义主要由指令和物体状态决定；这忽略了真实世界常见的变化来源——人类主动共享工作空间，可能暗示隐含目标、完成部分任务、临时改变物体可用性，或在附近工作时限制机器人的安全运动。
AI.method: 输入是日常操作任务以及在其中活动的人类。HARP-Bench 不把人类活动当作背景场景变化，而是将其视为操作问题本身的一部分：把有人操作组织为四种条件（Cueing、Contribution、Interruption、Co-presence），用日常操作任务实例化，并为标准操作提供配对的"有人"变体以支持受控比较；同时提供面向动态有人场景的演示生成流程。输出是可用于训练与评测的基准与演示数据。相对基线是只考虑机器人单一主动体的既有操作基准。摘要未报告任务数量、场景规模与实现细节。
AI.result: 在 HARP-Bench 上评测了 VLA 模型、模仿学习方法和启发式策略：有人变体对现有策略构成挑战，且更高的任务成功率并不一致地带来更高安全性；定量失败分析把操作与恢复列为主要剩余挑战；用 HARP-Bench 演示训练可提升仿真中的有人场景表现；真机研究在一个任务族上显示人类贡献条件下性能提升，但中断条件下没有提升。摘要未报告任何数值指标，因此无法给出具体数值对比。
AI.conclusion: 对具身智能而言，该工作提示"人类在场"应被建模为操作问题的一部分，而不是场景扰动，并提供了一个可做受控比较的评测与数据构造思路。但证据边界有限：作者报告的改进出现在仿真，以及单一任务族的真机研究，且摘要未报告任何数值结果与统计信息，因此数据效用与迁移性只能视为初步证据。
AI.core_method: 把共享工作空间中的人类活动纳入操作任务定义，按四种有人条件构造成对任务变体并生成动态有人演示，用于训练与评测操作策略。

032d481d5e0bdaef9e51e8609387bb17c9eb6945.title: Beyond Memory Limits: A Hierarchical Spatio-Temporal Map Representation for Large-Scale 3D Autonomous Exploration
032d481d5e0bdaef9e51e8609387bb17c9eb6945.comment: 16 pages, 12 figures, preprint submitted to Elsevier
032d481d5e0bdaef9e51e8609387bb17c9eb6945.summary: Autonomous UAV exploration is increasingly used for large-scale surveying and inspection in inaccessible or disaster-affected environments, where onboard memory and computational resources are often severely constrained. Most existing UAV exploration systems maintain globally queryable geometric map representations for motion planning and exploration decision-making, causing memory consumption and spatial-query costs to increase with the explored area. Robot-centric local mapping bounds dense-map memory and computation but discards global task context needed for long-horizon this http URL present FLAVOR, a hierarchical spatio-temporal framework that confines dense metric geometry to a robot-centric local map while retaining compact global observation and task context. At the observation level, lightweight LiDAR-keyframe visibility records preserve ray-wise evidence for frontier reasoning. At the task level, unresolved frontiers beyond the local-map extent are retained as compact pending tasks associated with odometry anchors. A sparse topological graph connects these anchors through retained routes for future this http URL returning to a task region, FLAVOR reconstructs the frontier and exploration viewpoint from observations, while the topological route is instantiated and validated against the current local map before execution. Dense-map capacity remains fixed as exploration expands, with exploration-dependent memory growth confined to compact observation and task this http URL achieves 31.98--41.88% shorter exploration time and a 94--99% smaller map memory footprint than the best baseline that completes all three simulated scenes. In real-world deployments, it reduces this footprint by 92.67% in the forest and 62.42% at the construction site relative to an explicit point-cloud ikd-tree while preserving long-term task continuity under constrained onboard resources.

AI.tldr: FLAVOR 把稠密几何地图限制在机器人中心局部地图内，用轻量 LiDAR 关键帧可见性记录保留观测级证据、用拓扑图与挂起任务保留全局任务上下文，从而在大范围无人机探索中固定稠密地图容量。作者报告仿真中探索时间缩短 31.98--41.88%、地图内存减少 94--99%，并在真实森林/工地场景相对显式点云 ikd-tree 减少 92.67%/62.42%。
AI.motivation: 摘要指出，多数现有无人机探索系统维护全局可查询的几何地图以支持运动规划与探索决策，导致内存占用与空间查询开销随探索面积增长；而机器人中心局部建图虽能限制稠密地图的内存与计算，却丢失长时程任务所需的全局上下文。该方法正是为同时缓解这两者的矛盾而提出。
AI.method: 输入是探索过程中采集的 LiDAR 观测与里程计信息。方法把稠密度量几何限定在机器人中心局部地图中；在观测层用轻量 LiDAR 关键帧可见性记录保留逐射线证据以支持前沿推理；在任务层把超出局部地图范围、尚未解决的 frontier 作为紧凑的挂起任务并与里程计锚点关联；再用稀疏拓扑图通过保留的路线连接这些锚点。输出是：返回某任务区域时，从观测重建 frontier 与探索视点，并在执行前用当前局部地图实例化并校验拓扑路线。相对于摘要所述全局可查询地图与纯机器人中心局部地图两类做法，其改变在于密集地图容量随探索扩展保持固定，探索相关的内存增长仅出现在紧凑的观测与任务记录中。
AI.result: 作者报告：在完成全部三个仿真场景的最佳基线对比下，探索时间缩短 31.98--41.88%，地图内存占用减少 94--99%。真实世界部署中，相对显式点云 ikd-tree，内存占用在森林减少 92.67%、在工地减少 62.42%，并在受限机载资源下保持长期任务连续性。摘要未报告具体场景名称、基线方法名称、机载硬件与统计显著性。
AI.conclusion: 对具身智能/世界模型读者而言，其价值在于一种“分层记忆”式表示：把高保真局部几何与紧凑的全局观测、任务记录解耦，使稠密地图容量与探索面积不挂钩，同时保留长时程探索决策所需的前沿信息。证据边界是：结论来自作者自述的仿真与真实场景对比，摘要未给出硬件、基线命名与显著性检验，也未说明失败情形或适用任务的限制。
AI.core_method: 局部地图只保留稠密几何，全局侧仅存轻量关键帧可见性与挂在里程计锚点上的待解前沿任务，并用稀疏拓扑图保存回溯路线，需要时再重建前沿与视点。

key_results.finding: 真实世界部署中，相对显式点云 ikd-tree，内存足迹在森林减少 92.67%，在工地减少 62.42%，并保持长期任务连续性。
key_results.setting: 真实世界部署（森林与工地两类环境），机载资源受限；对照为显式点云 ikd-tree。
key_results.evidence_quote: In real-world deployments, it reduces this footprint by 92.67% in the forest and 62.42% at the construction site relative to an explicit point-cloud ikd-tree while preserving long-term task continuity under constrained onboard resources.

limitations: 摘要未报告作者自述的局限性；摘要中未出现对方法失败模式、适用边界或权衡的明确说明。
摘要未报告：机载计算平台/硬件规格、延迟或空间查询开销的数值、仿真场景与基线方法名称、真实实验的规模与重复次数、统计显著性。

49ccac237217923f68c52ef7007551135126e71f.title: Control-Aware Command Generation for Asynchronous Control and Action Inference with Vision-Based Policies towards Fast Execution
49ccac237217923f68c52ef7007551135126e71f.comment: 8th Robot Learning Workshop: Is Physical AI Going Zero-Shot? at NeurIPS 2026
49ccac237217923f68c52ef7007551135126e71f.summary: Vision-based control policies, including vision-language-action models, have enabled robots to perform increasingly complex tasks. However, their execution speed is often limited by the high computational cost of action inference. In this work, we investigate what can be achieved at the control level without modifying the underlying policy learning process. We introduce an asynchronous inference and control framework that enables fast task execution while maintaining smooth and stable robot motions. By formulating the generation of continuous target positions from discontinuous model predictions as a tracking control problem, our method makes asynchronous inference practical for real robots. We further accelerate execution through adaptive action skipping based on the variance of predicted positions. Experiments with Action Chunking Transformer and OpenVLA-OFT on a bimanual robot demonstrate substantial speedups while preserving high task success rates.

AI.tldr: 视觉策略（含 VLA）执行速度受动作推理高计算成本限制；作者不改动策略学习，只在控制层引入异步推理–控制框架，把"从不连续模型预测生成连续目标位置"当作跟踪控制问题，并依据预测位置方差自适应跳帧。作者在双臂机器人上用 Action Chunking Transformer 与 OpenVLA-OFT 报告显著加速并保持高任务成功率，但摘要未给出任何数值。
AI.motivation: 视觉控制策略和 vision-language-action 模型的执行速度常被动作推理的高计算成本限制。作者提出的问题是：在不修改底层策略学习过程的前提下，仅从控制层面能取得什么效果。
AI.method: 输入是不连续时刻的模型动作预测（策略本身不被改动，训练流程也不变）。关键改动在下游控制层：把"由不连续预测生成连续目标位置"表述为一个跟踪控制问题，使推理与控制回路异步并行运行，从而在推理等待期间仍输出平滑连续的指令；在此之上，按预测位置之间的方差自适应地跳过部分动作、减少推理调用。输出是给机器人的连续目标位置指令，用于快速但平稳的执行。摘要未说明具体控制器形式、方差阈值或异步频率。
AI.result: 作者报告在双臂机器人上，使用 Action Chunking Transformer 和 OpenVLA-OFT 的实验显示出明显加速，同时保持较高的任务成功率。摘要未报告加速倍数、成功率数值、单位、推理延迟或控制频率，因此无法判断加速幅度及其与基线的定量对比。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提示：对视觉策略/VLA 的部署效率，除改进策略学习外，异步化推理与基于预测不确定性的跳帧是控制层的可行着力点，且可能无需重训策略。但证据仅限作者在摘要中的定性陈述（"substantial speedups"、"high task success rates"），缺少数值、硬件与频率细节，也未见消融或稳定性代价的量化，因而无法评估平滑性约束下的速度–成功率权衡，结论强度受限。

ca2cd4eda881fd5c3700a15edc0ad47dcaef44f6.title: MOSU2: Long-range Navigation System with Multi-modal Scene Understanding
ca2cd4eda881fd5c3700a15edc0ad47dcaef44f6.summary: Robots that travel long distances through public outdoor spaces must do more than avoid obstacles: they must remain on terrain suited to their mobility and decide when to proceed, yield, or detour around pedestrians, cyclists, vehicles, traffic signals, and temporary restrictions. These decisions are difficult because their correctness often depends on how a scene evolves, such as whether an approaching car is slowing or a cyclist will cross the robot's path. Vision-language models (VLMs) can interpret such cues, but they reason over images that lack metric geometry and motion. Supplying this evidence at every step is too slow for real-time navigation, and hand-crafted triggers cannot anticipate the open-ended variety of outdoor situations. We present MOSU2, a long-range navigation system with two-stage trajectory selection, in which first-stage contextual reasoning determines when additional evidence is needed and what to retrieve. Only when an interaction remains unresolved does the first stage trigger the second stage to retrieve geometric and dynamic information and align it with scene context to make navigation decisions. Building on MOSU, MOSU2 follows routes from GPS-based route planning and filters candidate trajectories through multi-modal traversability analysis before selecting a trajectory to move the robot. In real-world experiments spanning stop gestures, construction sites, crosswalks, and roads shared with vehicles, cyclists, and pedestrians, MOSU2 raises mean navigation success from 61.8% to 94.2% and condition-detection accuracy from 72.2% to 91.4% over its single-image predecessor, at about 2.2 times its mean decision latency. Project website: this https URL

AI.tldr: 针对户外长距离导航中"单帧VLM缺几何与运动证据、而逐步检索又太慢"的矛盾，MOSU2 采用两阶段轨迹选择：第一阶段情境推理判断是否需要更多证据，仅当交互未解决时才触发第二阶段检索几何与动态信息。真实世界实验中，平均导航成功率由61.8%升至94.2%，条件检测准确率由72.2%升至91.4%，代价是平均决策延迟约为单图像前作的2.2倍。
AI.motivation: 摘要指出，机器人在公共户外空间长距离行进不只是避障：必须保持在适合其移动性的地形上，并决定是前进、让行还是绕行行人、骑行者、车辆、交通信号与临时管制。这些决策的难点在于正确性常取决于场景如何演化（如驶来的汽车是否减速、骑行者是否会横穿）。VLM能解读这类线索，但其推理所依据的图像缺少度量几何与运动信息；每一步都提供这些证据对实时导航太慢，而手工触发器无法预先覆盖户外情境的开放式变化。
AI.method: 输入是来自GPS路径规划的路线与候选轨迹。第一阶段做情境推理，判断当前交互是否仍未解决、以及需要检索哪些证据；只有当交互仍未解决时，才触发第二阶段去检索几何与动态信息，并把它们与场景上下文对齐以作出导航决策。系统通过多模态可通行性分析过滤候选轨迹，再从候选中选定轨迹驱动机器人移动。相对其单图像前作，关键改动是把几何与动态证据的获取从"每步供给"变为"由第一阶段按需触发的第二阶段检索"。
AI.result: 作者报告的真实世界实验覆盖停止手势、施工区、人行横道，以及与车辆、骑行者、行人共享的道路。相对单图像前作，平均导航成功率从61.8%提升到94.2%，条件检测准确率从72.2%提升到91.4%，同时平均决策延迟约为前作的2.2倍。摘要未报告样本量、试验次数、统计显著性、硬件平台、延迟绝对值，也未报告与单图像前作以外基线的比较。
AI.conclusion: 对具身智能与导航决策的意义在于：把"何时需要更多证据"本身作为推理的一环，可让VLM式的情境理解服务于长距离户外导航，而不必在每一步都调用重型多模态证据。但证据仅来自作者自述的真实世界实验，未经独立验证；延迟成本被明确报告为约2.2倍，摘要未提供失败模式、泛化性与安全性方面的信息，因此不宜推断该方法在其他城市环境或平台上同样有效。
AI.core_method: 先用情境推理判断交互是否未解决、需要哪些证据，仅在被触发时才检索几何与动态信息并与场景上下文对齐，再经多模态可通行性过滤后选定轨迹。

key_results.finding: 平均导航成功率由61.8%提升至94.2%（相对单图像前作）。
key_results.setting: 真实世界实验，场景包含停止手势、施工区、人行横道，以及与车辆、骑行者、行人共享的道路；基线为单图像前作。摘要未报告试验次数与统计显著性。
key_results.evidence_quote: MOSU2 raises mean navigation success from 61.8% to 94.2%

key_results.finding: 条件检测准确率由72.2%提升至91.4%（相对单图像前作）。
key_results.setting: 与同一单图像前作对比的真实世界实验；摘要未报告该指标的评测集规模与判定标准。
key_results.evidence_quote: condition-detection accuracy from 72.2% to 91.4% over its single-image predecessor

key_results.finding: 平均决策延迟约为单图像前作的2.2倍，作者将其作为性能提升的代价一并报告。
key_results.setting: 与单图像前作对比；摘要未报告延迟的绝对值、单位或实时性阈值。
key_results.evidence_quote: at about 2.2 times its mean decision latency

limitations: 作者报告了明确的成本：平均决策延迟约为单图像前作的2.2倍；摘要未说明该延迟是否仍满足实时导航要求，也未给出延迟绝对值或单位。
摘要未报告样本量、试验次数、统计显著性、硬件平台与安全相关指标（如碰撞或让行违规），因此无法判断提升的稳定性。
摘要未报告第二阶段被触发的频率、其检索开销、失败案例分析，也未报告与单图像前作之外的其他基线对比。

6bdf217bfd58af06c37086605bb0fb29f28b6093.title: How Many Demonstrations Does a VLA Need? On the Sample Efficiency of VLA Finetuning
6bdf217bfd58af06c37086605bb0fb29f28b6093.summary: Pretrained vision language action (VLA) models show strong zero-shot performance, but are rarely deployed directly and are often first post-trained on demonstrations from the target setting. Yet VLAs are typically compared by zero-shot or full-data fine-tuned success, revealing little about the data and compute required for adaptation. We study adaptation efficiency for six VLAs ($\pi_{0}$, $\pi_{0.5}$, and GR00T N1-N1.7) on four LIBERO suites, varying both demonstrations and training steps. This reveals differences hidden by full-data fine-tuning: models within two points on the full LIBERO-Spatial dataset differ by up to $3\times$ in success with 50 demonstrations. $\pi_{0.5}$ needs $2$--$5\times$ fewer demonstrations than $\pi_{0}$ and is the most sample-efficient model at every budget, with the largest gap on the long-horizon suite. Within GR00T, N1.5 adapts more efficiently than N1.6 and N1.7 on three of four suites, despite their stronger zero-shot performance. We study one pretraining factor behind these differences by freezing the VLM during finetuning: this severely degrades the $\pi$ models, whose VLM is jointly trained with the action expert during pretraining, but barely affects GR00T models. Finally, validation loss on held-out demonstrations tracks closed-loop success within a suite, but understates how much more sample-efficient $\pi_{0.5}$ is than $\pi_{0}$.

AI.tldr: 论文研究 VLA 微调的样本效率：在四个 LIBERO 套件上对六个 VLA 变化演示数量与训练步数。结果显示全数据微调会掩盖模型间的差异——在 LIBERO-Spatial 上全数据成绩仅差 2 分的模型，用 50 条演示时成功率相差最多 3 倍；π0.5 在每个预算下都最省数据，比 π0 少用 2–5 倍演示。
AI.motivation: 预训练 VLA 的零样本表现虽好，但很少直接部署，通常要先用目标场景的演示做后训练；然而现有比较多只看零样本或全数据微调后的成功率，无法说明适应目标场景需要多少数据与算力。作者由此把"适应效率"本身作为研究对象。
AI.method: 输入是六个 VLA（π0、π0.5 与 GR00T N1–N1.7）在四个 LIBERO 套件上的目标场景演示。方法不是提出新模型，而是做受控扫描：改变每个套件的演示数量与训练步数，得到不同数据/算力预算下的微调成功率曲线，从而暴露全数据微调看不到的模型间差异。另做一个机制性对照：微调时冻结 VLM，观察对 π 系列与 GR00T 系列的不同影响；并用留出演示上的验证损失与闭环成功率作比较。
AI.result: 作者报告：在 LIBERO-Spatial 全数据上仅差 2 分的模型，用 50 条演示时成功率相差最多 3 倍；π0.5 所需演示比 π0 少 2–5 倍且在每个预算下最省数据，长时程套件差距最大；GR00T N1.5 在四个套件中的三个上比 N1.6/N1.7 适应更高效，虽然后两者零样本更强。机制对照方面，微调时冻结 VLM 会严重损害 π 系列（其 VLM 在预训练中与动作专家联合训练），但几乎不影响 GR00T。此外，留出演示上的验证损失在同一套件内与闭环成功率趋势一致，却低估了 π0.5 相对 π0 的样本效率优势。摘要未给出任何绝对成功率、算力数值，也未报告统计显著性；作者未使用 SOTA 表述。
AI.conclusion: 对具身智能实践者的含义是：只报零样本或全数据微调成功率会误导选型，模型排名在低数据预算下可能翻转（最多 3 倍差距），因此应报告"成功率—演示数/训练步数"曲线；预训练中 VLM 与动作专家的耦合方式（是否联合训练）会影响微调时能否冻结视觉语言主干，这为跨模型迁移与适配策略提供了可检验的线索。局限在于证据仅来自摘要所述的 LIBERO 套件扫描，摘要未报告真实机器人实验、绝对数值与统计检验，上述结论属于作者自述、未经独立验证。
AI.core_method: 在四个 LIBERO 套件上对六个 VLA 扫描"演示数量 × 训练步数"，并冻结 VLM 做对照，以刻画微调的数据/算力效率。

key_results.finding: π0.5 比 π0 少用 2–5 倍演示，且在每一个预算下都是最样本高效的模型，长时程套件上的差距最大。
key_results.setting: 同上的六个 VLA 与四个 LIBERO 套件扫描；长时程套件具体名称与绝对成功率摘要未报告。
key_results.evidence_quote: $\pi_{0.5}$ needs $2$--$5\times$ fewer demonstrations than $\pi_{0}$ and is the most sample-efficient model at every budget, with the largest gap on the long-horizon suite.

key_results.finding: GR00T 内部并非零样本越强越易适应：N1.5 在四个套件中的三个上比 N1.6、N1.7 适应得更高效，尽管后两者零样本表现更强。
key_results.setting: GR00T N1–N1.7 在同一微调扫描协议下比较；具体演示预算与成功率数值摘要未报告。
key_results.evidence_quote: Within GR00T, N1.5 adapts more efficiently than N1.6 and N1.7 on three of four suites, despite their stronger zero-shot performance.

limitations: 作者报告的方法/度量局限：留出演示上的验证损失在同一套件内能跟踪闭环成功率，但会低估 π0.5 相对 π0 的样本效率优势，因此不能单靠验证损失选模型。
摘要未报告：真实机器人实验、绝对成功率数值、具体训练步数与算力成本、随机种子或统计显著性；也未说明 LIBERO 套件是仿真还是真机环境。
部分结果未附可定位的摘要原句，或数字未出现在所附依据中，未作为关键结果展示。

5d6b0859ecbd0e83ae37b033458600dc53511e84.title: Kimodo-Policy: Learning Kinematic Action Models for Humanoid Loco-Manipulation
5d6b0859ecbd0e83ae37b033458600dc53511e84.comment: 23 pages, 14 figures, 4 tables. Project page: this https URL
5d6b0859ecbd0e83ae37b033458600dc53511e84.summary: Humanoid loco-manipulation requires continuous coordination of high-dimensional whole-body motion to realize task objectives. While vision-language-action models and world action models transfer semantic and visual-dynamics priors to robot control, these priors do not necessarily capture the structure of robot motion. We introduce Kinematic Action Models (KAMs), a paradigm that treats whole-body motion as a direct pretraining target and uses a pretrained motion generator as the primary action-generation backbone. KAMs ground learned temporal and cross-body coordination priors through task conditioning, visual observations, and execution feedback. We present Kimodo-Policy as an initial instantiation, combining a frozen Kimodo text-to-motion backbone with lightweight ControlNet-based visual conditioning. A root-body-hand hierarchy coordinates locomotion and manipulation, while motion-history conditioning and repeated action-chunk prediction bridge motion synthesis and closed-loop control. Following large-scale loco-manipulation pretraining, the policy achieves the highest overall success among compared policies on multi-task HumanoidArena (72.14%), competitive performance on SIMPLE, and 60% mean success across eight real-world tasks, with 678M parameters (92M trainable). Ablations support the contribution of the pretrained motion backbone. Together, these results provide initial evidence for motion generation as a complementary foundation for humanoid action learning.

AI.tldr: 提出 Kinematic Action Models(KAM)范式，把全身运动本身作为预训练目标，用预训练运动生成器充当动作生成主干；首个实例 Kimodo-Policy 在 HumanoidArena 上取得对比方法中最高的 72.14% 总体成功率，并在八个真实任务上达到 60% 平均成功率。
AI.motivation: 人形 loco-manipulation 需要高维全身运动的持续协调；现有视觉-语言-动作模型与世界动作模型虽能迁移语义和视觉动力学先验，但这些先验未必刻画机器人运动结构，因此作者主张直接把运动结构当作预训练目标。
AI.method: 方法把全身运动序列本身作为预训练目标，并让预训练的运动生成器成为主要的动作生成主干，再用任务条件、视觉观测和执行反馈把这些时序与跨身体协调先验“落地”到控制中。Kimodo-Policy 是该范式的首个实例：冻结的 Kimodo 文本到运动主干��加上轻量的 ControlNet 式视觉条件模块；用 root–body–hand 层级结构协调移动与操作，用运动历史条件与重复的动作块（action chunk）预测把运动合成接到闭环控制上。输入为任务条件、视觉观测与执行反馈，输出为全身动作；整体先经大规模 loco-manipulation 预训练。
AI.result: 在多个对比策略中，该方法在多任务 HumanoidArena 上取得最高总体成功率 72.14%；在 SIMPLE 上作者称表现有竞争力；在八个真实世界任务上平均成功率 60%。模型规模 678M 参数，其中 92M 可训练。消融结果支持预训练运动主干的贡献。摘要未报告 SIMPLE 的具体数值，也未给出各任务的分解或统计显著性。
AI.conclusion: 对具身智能研究的含义是：运动生成可以作为一种补充性的动作学习基础模型范式，与 VLA / world action model 的语义与视觉动力学先验形成互补；作者将结果表述为“初步证据”。证据边界在于：摘要只给出仿真基准分数、真实世界平均成功率与消融结论，未报告训练数据规模、SIMPLE 数值、逐任务分解、统计显著性或失败模��，因此不能推断其在未测条件下的泛化能力。
AI.core_method: 把全身运动生成当作预训练目标，用冻结的文本到运动生成器作主干、以轻量视觉条件与动作块预测接入闭环控制。

key_results.setting: 多任务 HumanoidArena 基准，与所比较的其他策略对比；指标为总体成功率，单位 %。

key_results.setting: 八个真实世界 loco-manipulation 任务；指标为平均成功率；括号内给出可训练参数量。

7de893f30d0a349db118292c72dafa2d57ab2411.title: Off-Policy RL with Online Inference Tuning: My Solution to the CoRL 2026 RoboEval Challenge
7de893f30d0a349db118292c72dafa2d57ab2411.comment: Technical report for the RoboEval Challenge at CoRL 2026. Code: this https URL ; checkpoint: this https URL ; project page: this https URL
7de893f30d0a349db118292c72dafa2d57ab2411.summary: The CoRL 2026 RoboEval challenge has eight bimanual tasks, and it ranks a policy not only on whether it succeeds but on how: every stage of the task, done safely, efficiently and with both arms in coordination, scored against human demonstrations. My solution has two parts. The generic part, carried over from my LeHome challenge solution, is off-policy RL on a $\pi_{0.5}$-based policy that is also its own value function. It is trained with AWR and RECAP on advantages of the exact official score, in a loop where every rollout is at the same time a Thompson-sampling trial of about 20 inference parameters. Out of the box, it took the policy to 0.85 RDS on held-out seeds in two days (and it was still very far from convergence). The competition-specific part adds data that local exploration cannot find: generated demonstrations that reach the full reward, and recovery episodes that start from the policy's own failures. The submitted policy reaches 0.990 RDS on held-out seeds and 0.987 on the official seeds.

AI.tldr: 针对 CoRL 2026 RoboEval 的八个双臂任务，作者把基于 π_{0.5} 的策略兼作价值函数，用官方评分优势做 AWR/RECAP 离策略 RL，并让每次 rollout 同时充当约 20 个推理参数的 Thompson 采样试验。作者报告：通用部分开箱即用两天达 0.85 RDS（留出种子），加入生成示范与失败恢复数据后，提交策略达 0.990 RDS（留出种子）与 0.987 RDS（官方种子）。

AI.method: 输入是挑战的八个双臂任务，奖励/评分信号为官方 RDS 分数，策略初始化在 π_{0.5} 上。通用部分：离策略 RL，策略同时充当自己的价值函数，用 AWR 与 RECAP 在“精确官方分数”的优势上训练；训练循环中每次 rollout 同时充当对约 20 个推理参数的 Thompson 采样试验（即在线推理调参）。竞赛专用部分：额外加入局部探索覆盖不到的数据——可达到满奖励的生成示范，以及从策略自身失败开始的恢复回合。输出是提交给挑战的一个策略。摘要未给出相对其他策略基线的受控对比。
AI.result: 作者报告两类结果：通用部分开箱即用两天达到 0.85 RDS（留出种子），且作者称当时仍远未收敛；提交策略达到 0.990 RDS（留出种子）和 0.987 RDS（官方种子）。文中未报告各任务分解、基线对照或统计显著性。
AI.conclusion: 对具身策略研究而言，该方案提示两点可复用的思路：把与评测指标一致的分数直接作为优势来源做离策略 RL，并把部署时的推理参数搜索塞进训练 rollout 循环；以及用生成示范与自失败恢复数据补足局部探索的盲区。但证据仅限摘要给出的 RDS 数值，未说明仿真或真机、未给出基线对比与任务级细节，因此不能据此推断真机部署能力、泛化性或方法各部分的贡献。

9b8fc65148671abb0364b25e69da724b43e6146e.title: From Festival Video to the Stage: A Sim-to-Real Ladder for Long-Horizon Expressive Whole-Body Dance on a Commercial Humanoid
9b8fc65148671abb0364b25e69da724b43e6146e.comment: 19 pages, 12 figures. Four supplementary videos are linked in the manuscript
9b8fc65148671abb0364b25e69da724b43e6146e.summary: We present a pipeline for transferring Awa Odori, a traditional Japanese festival dance, from monocular video to a commercial Unitree G1 EDU humanoid. The pipeline combines human mesh recovery, kinematic retargeting, reinforcement learning for motion tracking in simulation, and onboard deployment via ONNX. Training ran on a single RTX 5070 GPU. An eleven-version deployment ladder evaluated on hardware examines three interventions. We detect and repair silent corruption of deployment artifacts, model state-estimator drift during training, and edit the reference motion to support stable execution and a controlled ending. The final policies achieved three consecutive rope-free completions of a 43-second routine, a 46-second performance with automatic handoff, and a continuous 9.7-minute rope-free performance composed from the captured motion. In a live handover, a single remote request let the robot start from and return to the manufacturer's walking controller on stage, with a measured torque-free window of 45-140 ms. We report the training dynamics and hardware outcomes and discuss failure boundaries involving compliant flooring and occlusion in monocular capture.

AI.tldr: 论文把单目视频中的 Awa Odori 节日舞蹈，经人体网格恢复、运动学重定向与仿真强化学习跟踪，部署到商用 Unitree G1 EDU 人形机器人上；作者用十一版硬件部署阶梯排查部署伪影、状态估计漂移与收尾问题，最终实现多次无绳表演。
AI.motivation: 目标是让商用人形机器人完成长时程、富有表现力的全身舞蹈，并把它从单目视频迁移到真实舞台；摘要未明确陈述此前方法的具体失败点，只指出需要处理部署产物的静默损坏、训练中的状态估计漂移，以及参考动作的稳定执行与可控收尾。
AI.method: 输入是一段 Awa Odori 单目视频；流水线依次做人体网格恢复、运动学重定向，在仿真中用强化学习训练运动跟踪策略，再通过 ONNX 板载部署到 Unitree G1 EDU。训练在单张 RTX 5070 GPU 上完成。相对基线：摘要未报告对照基线；作者以十一版硬件部署阶梯评估三项干预——检测并修复部署产物的静默损坏、在训练中建模状态估计漂移、编辑参考动作以支持稳定执行与可控结束。输出是可在真机上执行的长时程全身舞蹈策略。
AI.result: 作者报告：最终策略实现三次连续无绳完成 43 秒套路、一次带自动交接的 46 秒表演，以及由捕获动作组成的连续 9.7 分钟无绳表演；现场交接中单次远程请求让机器人从厂商行走控制器出发并在舞台返回，测得 45-140 ms 无力矩窗口。摘要未报告与基线的数值对比、跟踪误差或统计显著性，也未声称 SOTA。
AI.conclusion: 这项工作展示了以单目视频为输入、经仿真 RL 与板载部署，在商用 Unitree G1 EDU 上完成长时程表现性全身舞蹈的可行路径；但证据限于该舞蹈与这套硬件，作者仅报告训练动态与硬件结果，并指出柔性地板与单目遮挡是失败边界。

4d3d59210348df489655ffb155ff96ad6f64695e.title: PAIR: Proprioception-Aligned Image-Ray Representations for Viewpoint-Robust Manipulation
4d3d59210348df489655ffb155ff96ad6f64695e.summary: While imitation learning has made substantial progress toward generalizable robot manipulation through scaling, viewpoint robustness remains a major bottleneck. Visuomotor policies rely heavily on visual inputs, yet images provide an inherently ambiguous signal under viewpoint change: similar scenes may appear markedly different across viewpoints, while distinct states may share certain visual overlaps. A policy must therefore infer not only the task-relevant state, but also how it is visually projected under a particular camera configuration. This entanglement of viewpoint-dependent appearance and task-relevant state can make learning inefficient and limit generalization to unseen viewpoints. Recent work has begun to address this challenge through camera-ray conditioning and representation learning using geometric cues to induce invariance. However, providing camera information as additional context does not by itself ground visual representations in how the task scene is visually projected, while geometric alignment without camera context can introduce spurious correspondences by ignoring viewpoint-dependent projection. We propose PAIR, a contrastive learning framework that aligns joint image-ray representations using robot proprioception. PAIR encourages observations with similar robot states to remain close in representation space across viewpoints, providing a structured grounding signal for learning viewpoint-robust features. PAIR is a highly adaptable framework: it can be used to train Diffusion Policy (DP) or post-train vision-language-action (VLA) models. In simulated and real-world manipulation benchmarks with camera variation, PAIR consistently outperforms the behavior cloning baseline without ray conditioning by 12.7% and 26.7% points, respectively, demonstrating stronger generalization to unseen viewpoints. Project website: this http URL .

AI.tldr: 针对视角变化下视觉运动策略泛化差的问题，PAIR 用机器人本体感知把图像与相机射线对齐成对比学习表示，可作为 Diffusion Policy 的训练框架或 VLA 的后训练阶段使用；作者报告在含相机变化的仿真与真实操作基准上均优于无射线条件的模仿学习基线。
AI.motivation: 摘要指出，图像在视角变化下是内在歧义的信号：相似场景在不同视角下外观差异很大，而不同状态又可能共享视觉重叠。策略因此不仅需要推断任务相关状态，还要推断该状态在特定相机配置下如何被投影，这种"视角相关外观"与"任务相关状态"的纠缠导致学习低效并限制对未见视角的泛化。已有做法存在两方面不足：仅把相机信息作为额外上下文，并不能让视觉表示真正锚定到场景的投影方式；而不带相机上下文的几何对齐会忽略视角相关投影，从而引入虚假对应关系。
AI.method: 输入是图像观测、相机射线信息与机器人本体感知（状态）。PAIR 是一个对比学习框架：它对齐联合的图像—射线表示，并通过本体感知提供结构化锚定信号，使不同视角下机器人状态相近的观测在表示空间中保持接近。输出是用于策略学习的视角鲁棒特征。相对摘要中提到的基线（相机射线条件化、以及不带相机上下文的几何对齐式表示学习），PAIR 的改变在于把相机射线与图像联合编码，并用本体感知而非纯粹几何线索来决定哪些跨视角观测应当被拉近。该框架具有较强可适配性：既可用于训练 Diffusion Policy（DP），也可用于对视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型进行后训练。
AI.result: 作者报告在带相机变化的仿真与真实世界操作基准上，PAIR 持续优于"无射线条件化的行为克隆基线"，分别提升 12.7% 与 26.7% points，并称这体现了对未见视角更强的泛化能力。摘要未报告具体任务名称、基准名称、评测指标定义、基线实现细节或统计显著性。摘要原文的写法为"12.7% and 26.7% points"，百分点与百分比的确切口径以原文为准，此处不做换算。
AI.conclusion: 对具身智能研究而言，这篇工作的要点是：视角鲁棒性可以处理为表示学习问题，用本体感知作为跨视角对齐的监督信号，而不是仅把相机参数当作额外输入通道。其意义在于把"相机投影"这一因素显式纳入策略特征空间，并可挂接到 Diffusion Policy 训练或 VLA 后训练流程上。但证据边界明确：全文未读，摘要只给出仿真与真实基准相对行为克隆基线的两项提升数值，未报告具体基准、任务集、指标定义、计算开销与消融，因此不能据此推断其在其他任务、其他基线与部署效率上的表现。所有结论均为作者自述，未经独立验证。
AI.core_method: 用机器人本体感知作为锚定，对比学习对齐图像与相机射线的联合表示，使不同视角下机器人状态相近的观测在特征空间中靠近，从而得到视角鲁棒的策略特征。

key_results.setting: 仿真操作基准，存在相机视角变化；对比对象为无射线条件化的行为克隆基线。摘要未报告基准名称与具体指标。

key_results.finding: 在真实世界操作基准上，PAIR 比无射线条件化的行为克隆基线高 26.7 个百分点（按摘要原文字面表述）。

9d5fd4386a49d26a83a793e61e224e34f0d3242b.title: Breaking survivorship bias in driving world models
9d5fd4386a49d26a83a793e61e224e34f0d3242b.summary: World models allow autonomous vehicles to imagine the consequences of candidate actions before execution, but their reliability depends on the futures represented in their training data. We identify a survivorship bias in driving world models: because the futures recorded in prevailing driving datasets almost always end safely, existing models often imagine benign outcomes even when a collision is imminent. We introduce a neutral world model (NWM) that learns both routine and safety-critical futures from a mixture of routine driving and real accident videos with a bounding-box-guided objective. The NWM more faithfully anticipates imminent collisions, while maintaining a low false collision rate and competitive generation quality in routine driving. We further use the model as an imagination engine for decision-making. Given multiple ego trajectories, the NWM predicts the future associated with each candidate, and a reward function evaluates these imagined outcomes before selecting an action. On challenging NAVSIM scenarios, this procedure selects the better trajectory more reliably than the baseline world model. Zero-shot experiments with real-world pedestrian dummy crossing data collected using an autonomous research vehicle further demonstrate transfer to unseen sensor observations. These results show that correcting survivorship bias enables world models to more faithfully reason about futures and support safety-critical decision-making in autonomous driving.

AI.tldr: 驾驶世界模型因训练数据中的幸存者偏差，在碰撞临近时仍倾向想象安全未来；NWM 用常规驾驶与真实事故视频混合、以边界框引导目标学习常规与安全关键未来，并作为想象引擎评估候选轨迹。摘要报告其在碰撞预判、NAVSIM 轨迹选择和零样本行人假人过街数据上优于基线或实现迁移，但未给出数值。
AI.motivation: 摘要指出， prevailing driving datasets 中记录的 futures 几乎总是安全结束，因此现有世界模型在 collision 临近时仍常想象 benign outcomes；这限制了世界模型作为自动驾驶决策依据的可靠性。
AI.method: 训练阶段输入为常规驾驶数据与真实事故视频的混合，使用 bounding-box-guided objective 学习常规与安全关键未来，得到 neutral world model（NWM）。相对现有模型主要从安全结束的未来中学习，NWM 显式纳入安全关键未来。决策阶段给定多条 ego 轨迹，NWM 为每条候选轨迹预测未来，奖励函数评估这些想象结果后再选择动作；输出为候选轨迹对应的未来预测及最终选择的动作。摘要未报告网络架构、训练规模或目标函数细节。
AI.result: 作者报告：NWM 比现有模型更忠实地预判 imminent collision，同时维持低 false collision rate 与常规驾驶中有竞争力的生成质量；在 NAVSIM 挑战场景中，用 NWM 预测未来并由奖励函数评估，比基线世界模型更可靠地选择更好轨迹；零样本真实世界行人假人过街数据上迁移到未见传感器观测。摘要未给出任何数值、单位或统计结果，也未以数字声明 SOTA。
AI.conclusion: 若摘要所述成立，纠正幸存者偏差可让驾驶世界模型不只拟合安全未来，还能表达安全关键未来并服务决策；但当前证据仅为作者在摘要中的定性报告，缺少数值、真实道路部署结果与独立验证。
AI.core_method: 用常规驾驶视频与真实事故视频混合，并以边界框引导目标训练能同时想象常规与碰撞未来的世界模型，再用预测未来加奖励函数选择轨迹。

key_results.setting: 训练数据为常规驾驶与真实事故视频混合，使用边界框引导目标；对比对象在摘要中表述为 existing models。摘要未报告指标数值。

key_results.finding: 零样本实验显示方法可迁移到未见过的传感器观测。

c110a647e9ba4122288accfe8f899c6898a430a9.title: ScanDreamer: A Map-Grounded World Model for Quadrotor Navigation
c110a647e9ba4122288accfe8f899c6898a430a9.comment: 8 pages, 6 figures, 3 tables. Submitted to AICAP 2027; decision pending
c110a647e9ba4122288accfe8f899c6898a430a9.summary: Quadrotors inspecting buildings and tunnels must navigate unknown clutter with a forward-facing depth camera whose limited field of view constrains scene understanding and collision-avoiding navigation. Recent world-model agents learn navigation through imagined experience (e.g., AirDreamer), but remain data-intensive and often lack explicit geometric memory and awareness of what the camera can observe. We propose ScanDreamer, a map-grounded world model that constructs an online 2D scan-memory map from depth images and vehicle pose. Our world model, actor, and critic are conditioned on this map, which also defines a geodesic progress reward. Moreover, a forward-cone penalty discourages horizontal motion outside the camera's viewing direction. During imagination, ScanDreamer propagates the quadrotor pose over a frozen map and derives progress and wall-contact signals from the mapped geometry. We train ScanDreamer for 0.8 million environment steps (5.5 h on one GPU) and evaluate it in NVIDIA Isaac Sim over 1560 episodes spanning unseen layouts and parameter ranges. Across three seeds (mean $\pm$ SD), ScanDreamer achieves 96.3 $\pm$ 0.3% success with 3.6 $\pm$ 0.3% collision, compared with 59.6 $\pm$ 3.0% success and 28.8 $\pm$ 2.8% collision for AirDreamer at the same online-interaction budget. Removing the forward-cone penalty increases collisions to 9.9 $\pm$ 3.1%. These results show that combining explicit map memory, map-grounded imagination, and perception-aware motion substantially improves navigation performance and data efficiency. The source code is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 针对前向深度相机视野受限、现有世界模型缺乏显式几何记忆且数据需求大的问题，ScanDreamer 用在线二维扫描地图为世界模型、策略和价值函数提供几何条件；作者报告在 Isaac Sim 中、相同在线交互预算下，成功率由 AirDreamer 的 59.6% 提升到 96.3%。
AI.motivation: 四旋翼在建筑与隧道巡检中需在未知杂乱环境中导航，但前向深度相机的有限视场限制了场景理解与避障。近期世界模型智能体（如 AirDreamer）依赖大量数据，且摘要指出其常缺显式几何记忆和对相机可观测范围的意识。
AI.method: 输入是前向深度图像与飞行器位姿；方法在线构建二维扫描记忆地图，并让世界模型、actor 和 critic 都以该地图为条件。地图还定义测地进展奖励；前向锥惩罚抑制相机视线方向之外的横向运动。想象推演时，在冻结地图上传播四旋翼位姿，并从地图几何中导出进展与撞墙信号。相较摘要所述的 AirDreamer，核心变化是加入显式地图记忆、地图条件化想象和感知感知的运动约束；输出是用于导航的策略及其训练信号。
AI.result: 作者报告：在 NVIDIA Isaac Sim 的 1560 个回合（未见布局与参数范围）、3 个种子下，ScanDreamer 成功率 96.3 ± 0.3%、碰撞率 3.6 ± 0.3%；相同在线交互预算下 AirDreamer 为 59.6 ± 3.0% 和 28.8 ± 2.8%。去除前向锥惩罚的消融使碰撞率升至 9.9 ± 3.1%。训练预算为 0.8 百万环境步（单 GPU 5.5 小时）；摘要未报告与基线训练时长的直接比较。
AI.conclusion: 在摘要证据范围内，结果表明显式地图记忆、基于地图的想象推演和感知感知运动约束可提升仿真中的导航成功率与数据效率。证据仅限 Isaac Sim 仿真和作者自报结果，不能据此推断真实四旋翼部署有效或结果具有统计显著性。
AI.core_method: 用深度图与位姿在线维护二维扫描记忆地图，让世界模型、策略和价值函数都以该地图为条件，并在冻结地图上推演带几何奖励的想象轨迹。

key_results.finding: 去除前向锥惩罚后，碰撞率升至 9.9 ± 3.1%。
key_results.setting: 消融实验；NVIDIA Isaac Sim 仿真；摘要未报告该消融的种子数及其他条件。
key_results.evidence_quote: Removing the forward-cone penalty increases collisions to 9.9 $\pm$ 3.1%.

limitations: 摘要未报告作者明确声明的局限性；以下为摘要层面的证据边界。

f464a0e1ddaf16352cabc1b23af7048f6bf71bb6.title: Planners Exploit Deterministic Error: Dithered Low-Bit World Models
f464a0e1ddaf16352cabc1b23af7048f6bf71bb6.summary: Sampling-based planners such as MPPI and CEM query a learned world model thousands of times per control step, so low-bit world models are an obvious way to make model-based control cheaper on a robot. With round-to-nearest activation quantization and no calibration, we find that planning can collapse, by up to 100 points of success, while the world model's latent one-step prediction error stays no larger than that of a stochastic rounding scheme that plans well. At the same bit width, what decides the outcome is not the size of the rounding error but whether it persists across planner iterations and is shared across candidates. Round-to-nearest leaves an error that persists, and an iterating planner drifts toward the candidates that this error favors; in TD-MPC2, holding the same dither fixed within a step or an episode brings the drift back. Dither shared by all candidates and redrawn at every iteration removes most of the damage at the same bit width and without training: at least half of it in all 19 affected Meta-World cells (task $\times$ bit width) of TD-MPC2 (median 95%), in 4 of 5 DINO-WM cells, and in all 8 affected tasks of a 317M-parameter multi-task TD-MPC2. Captured as CUDA graphs on an Ampere GPU, a W8A4 integer TD-MPC2 world model runs its planning rollouts 1.9-3.3$\times$ and the whole planning step 1.3-1.5$\times$ faster than FP32, though not faster than BF16 with pre-converted weights; shared dither adds at most 2.3% latency. In TD-MPC2, block-scaled NVFP4 removes most of the damage and MXFP4 part of it, which ties the failure to coarse grids with a shared scale. Hypotheses, thresholds and analysis code were fixed before the data that test them, and the hypotheses that failed are reported.

AI.tldr: 低比特世界模型用于采样规划器时，round-to-nearest 量化会让规划成功率崩塌（最多 100 个百分点），而把 dither 在所有候选间共享并在每次迭代重抽可在不训练的情况下大部分修复，同时保留 W8A4 的推理加速。
AI.motivation: MPPI、CEM 等采样规划器每个控制步要查询学习到的世界模型数千次，因此低比特世界模型是降低机器人上基于模型控制成本的直接手段。但作者发现，在 round-to-nearest 激活量化、不做校准的设置下，规划可能崩塌，而世界模型潜空间单步预测误差却并不比规划正常的随机舍入方案更大——说明误差大小不是决定因素。
AI.method: 输入是量化后的世界模型（TD-MPC2、DINO-WM、一个 317M 参数多任务 TD-MPC2）加采样规划器的迭代式候选评估流程。作者改变的不是模型权重训练，而是舍入方式与 dither 的结构：让所有候选共享同一 dither、并在每次规划迭代重新抽取（对比 round-to-nearest 留下的持久误差，以及把同一 dither 固定在一个 step 或一个 episode 内的做法）。输出是规划成功率与规划耗时，用于判断误差是否跨迭代持续、是否被候选共享才是关键变量。作者还检验了块缩放 NVFP4/MXFP4 格式，以把失效归因到带共享尺度的粗网格。
AI.result: 作者报告：round-to-nearest 激活量化且不校准时规划可崩塌最多 100 个成功率点，而世界模型潜空间单步预测误差不大于一个规划良好的随机舍入方案。共享 dither 且每次迭代重抽可在同比特宽度下修复至少一半损伤：TD-MPC2 全部 19 个受影响 Meta-World 单元（任务 × 比特宽度，中位数 95%）、5 个 DINO-WM 单元中的 4 个、317M 参数多任务 TD-MPC2 的 8 个受影响任务。以 CUDA graphs 在 Ampere GPU 上测得，W8A4 整数 TD-MPC2 的规划 rollout 比 FP32 快 1.9-3.3 倍、整个规划步快 1.3-1.5 倍，但不如使用预转换权重的 BF16；共享 dither 增加至多 2.3% 延迟。作者称 TD-MPC2 中块缩放 NVFP4 消除大部分��伤、MXFP4 消除一部分，把失效与带共享尺度的粗网格联系起来。摘要未报告真实机器人实验。
AI.conclusion: 对具身智能的意义在于：为机器人上基于模型的控制做低比特加速时，单步潜空间预测误差不足以预测规划成败，误差的时间持续性与候选间共享性才是关键，因此量化方案需要与迭代式规划器联合设计。共享 dither 提供了一种无需训练的缓解手段，但证据限于 TD-MPC2、DINO-WM 等仿真/离线基准与 GPU 计时，摘要未给出真实机器人验证；相比 BF16 的加速优势并不存在。
AI.core_method: 把量化舍入从确定性的 round-to-nearest 换成所有候选共享、每次规划迭代重抽的 dither，使误差不再跨迭代持续，从而在同样比特宽度下恢复规划表现。

key_results.finding: round-to-nearest 激活量化且无校准时，规划可崩塌最多 100 个成功率点，尽管潜空间单步预测误差不大于一个规划良好的随机舍入方案
key_results.setting: 采样规划器（MPPI、CEM）在低比特世界模型上规划；round-to-nearest 量化、无校准；与随机舍入方案对比。摘要未报告具体任务、数据集或机器人平台
key_results.evidence_quote: With round-to-nearest activation quantization and no calibration, we find that planning can collapse, by up to 100 points of success, while the world model's latent one-step prediction error stays no larger than that of a stochastic rounding scheme that plans well.

key_results.finding: 共享 dither 且每次迭代重抽，在同比特宽度、不训练下消除至少一半损伤：TD-MPC2 全部 19 个受影响 Meta-World 单元（中位数 95%）、5 个 DINO-WM 单元中的 4 个、317M 参数多任务 TD-MPC2 的 8 个受影响任务
key_results.setting: TD-MPC2 在 Meta-World 的 19 个受影响 task × bit width 单元；DINO-WM 5 个单元；317M 参数多任务 TD-MPC2 的 8 个受影响任务；同比特宽度、无需训练
key_results.evidence_quote: Dither shared by all candidates and redrawn at every iteration removes most of the damage at the same bit width and without training: at least half of it in all 19 affected Meta-World cells (task $\times$ bit width) of TD-MPC2 (median 95%), in 4 of 5 DINO-WM cells, and in all 8 affected tasks of a 317M-parameter multi-task TD-MPC2.

key_results.finding: W8A4 整数 TD-MPC2 世界模型的规划 rollout 比 FP32 快 1.9-3.3×、整个规划步快 1.3-1.5×，但不快于使用预转换权重的 BF16；共享 dither 增加至多 2.3% 延迟
key_results.setting: 以 CUDA graphs 捕获、在 Ampere GPU 上的延迟测量；对比基线为 FP32 与带预转换权重的 BF16
key_results.evidence_quote: Captured as CUDA graphs on an Ampere GPU, a W8A4 integer TD-MPC2 world model runs its planning rollouts 1.9-3.3$\times$ and the whole planning step 1.3-1.5$\times$ faster than FP32, though not faster than BF16 with pre-converted weights; shared dither adds at most 2.3% latency.

limitations: 作者报告：W8A4 整数 TD-MPC2 虽快于 FP32，但"not faster than BF16 with pre-converted weights"，且共享 dither 仍有至多 2.3% 延迟开销。
作者报告：块缩放格式表现不一，NVFP4 消除大部分损伤但 MXFP4 只消除一部分，即低比特格式并非普遍安全。
摘要未报告：真实机器人实验、具体硬件平台与实机结果，以及失效假设的具体内容；摘要仅说明假设在测试前已固定且失败的假设被报告。

2a921e82d1e1c496749278f2b8ef3a3b803c2a4f.title: HINT-VLM: Humanoid Interactive Navigation over Rough Terrain with Embodiment-Grounded Vision-Language Model
2a921e82d1e1c496749278f2b8ef3a3b803c2a4f.summary: Humanoid robots have achieved significant progress in locomotion and manipulation, enabling traversal over rough terrain and richer interaction with the environment, such as moving obstacles. However, most traditional navigation methods assume non-interactive environments and focus only on traversal. While Navigation Among Movable Obstacles (NAMO) approaches relax this assumption, prior efforts have largely focused on flat environments and reactive interaction, rather than predicting object movability and planning ahead. These limitations become critical in outdoor rough-terrain scenarios, where robots must jointly reason about terrain traversability and object movability. In this work, we address NAMO for humanoid robots in cluttered outdoor rough terrain by proposing a hybrid planning framework that combines semantic priors from a Vision-Language Model (VLM) with embodied robot interaction data through a Gaussian process (GP) residual model. The GP corrects the VLM-derived movability prior to produce embodiment-grounded probabilistic movability estimates, which are then incorporated into hierarchical uncertainty-aware planning. The proposed approach allows humanoids to jointly leverage locomotion and manipulation for efficient and safe navigation, representing the first solution to NAMO in rough terrain through predictive movability reasoning and probabilistic VLM integration.

AI.tldr: 针对人形机器人在户外崎岖杂乱地形中的NAMO问题，提出用VLM语义可移动性先验加高斯过程残差修正得到具身概率估计，并接入分层不确定性感知规划；作者称这是首个崎岖地形NAMO方案，但摘要未报告任何数值结果。
AI.motivation: 传统导航假设环境不可交互、只关注通行；已有NAMO工作多面向平坦环境与反应式交互，缺少对物体可移动性的预测和提前规划。在户外崎岖地形中，机器人必须同时推理地形可通行性与物体可移动性。
AI.method: 输入是VLM给出的语义可移动性先验，以及机器人交互获得的具身数据。方法用高斯过程残差模型修正VLM先验，产出具身接地的概率可移动性估计，再将其嵌入分层、不确定性感知的规划中，输出兼顾地形通行与物体移动的导航决策。相对于传统非交互导航和以往平坦环境/反应式NAMO，关键变化是预测物体可移动性并提前规划。
AI.result: 作者声称该方法是首个在崎岖地形中通过预测性可移动性推理和概率化VLM集成解决NAMO的方案（“representing the first solution to NAMO in rough terrain through predictive movability reasoning and probabilistic VLM integration”）。摘要未报告任务基准、指标数值、基线比较或实验条件，也未说明结果来自仿真还是真机。
AI.conclusion: 若摘要所述成立，其意义在于把VLM语义先验与具身交互数据结合，使人形机器人在户外崎岖杂乱环境中联合利用行走与操作。证据边界：仅有摘要层面的方法描述与“首个方案”主张，无定量结果与真实机器人验证信息，不能推断实际性能或部署可靠性。
AI.core_method: 用机器人交互数据通过高斯过程残差修正VLM的物体可移动性先验，再把概率化可移动性估计送入分层不确定性感知规划。
limitations: 摘要未报告任何定量结果、基准、指标或基线对比，因此“first solution”主张仅属作者声明，无法从摘要验证。
摘要未报告真机实验、硬件平台、地形与障碍设置、样本量、统计显著性或消融结果。
作者未在摘要中报告方法局限性；VLM先验、GP残差模型和分层规划的实现细节在摘要中缺失。

5cfe5d6d3d852f1caa17dbdabb0b5581b2419c8c.title: Action Representation for Spatial Generalization in Robot World Models
5cfe5d6d3d852f1caa17dbdabb0b5581b2419c8c.summary: Spatial generalization in robot world models depends on whether action representations capture the physical relationships that remain valid across changing spatial configurations. Yet different coordinates can describe the same interaction, whereas similar motions can produce different outcomes when local physical conditions change. How these distinctions affect learned prediction remains insufficiently understood. This study evaluates matched action representations defined in world, object, and surface coordinate frames using a controlled robotic peeling benchmark. Global pose and contact relocation experiments reveal a cost associated with limited training data when equivalent interactions receive different spatial descriptions. Removing information about peel thickness creates an irreducible ambiguity because identical predictive inputs can correspond to different material removal outcomes. Coordinates defined relative to the surface improve consequence prediction and counterfactual action selection under accurate local observations, but learned predictors remain vulnerable to uncertainty in the coordinate frame. Joint centering of the surface and tool removes sensitivity to translation of their common origin, whereas incorrect contact geometry and actual execution deviations introduce different failure mechanisms. These results show that effective spatial generalization depends on preserving the relationships between actions and states that determine physical consequences, rather than simply minimizing coordinate variation. This perspective provides a principled basis for designing robot world models that reuse physical knowledge across spatial configurations while retaining the distinctions essential to prediction and planning.

AI.tldr: 该研究在受控机器人剥离基准上比较世界、物体与表面坐标系下的动作表示，指出仅最小化坐标变化不足以空间泛化；表面相对坐标在准确局部观测下改善后果预测与反事实动作选择，但仍受坐标系不确定性影响。
AI.motivation: 空间泛化取决于动作表示能否捕捉在不同空间构型下仍然有效的物理关系；同一交互可由不同坐标描述，而相似运动在局部物理条件变化时可能产生不同结果，这些区分对学习式预测的影响尚不清楚。
AI.method: 输入是受控机器人剥离任务中的动作与状态数据。方法改变动作表示的参考系，在世界、物体和表面坐标系之间进行匹配比较，并设置全局���姿与接触重定位实验、移除剥离厚度信息以制造歧义，以及将表面与工具联合同心化等对照。输出是学习式后果预测与反事实动作选择在不同坐标表示下的表现及失效机制。
AI.result: 摘要报告的是定性对照结果：全局位姿与接触重定位实验显示，训练数据有限时，等价交互因空间描述不同而付出代价；移除剥离厚度信息造成不可约歧义；表面相对坐标在准确局部观测下改善后果预测与反事实动作选择，但学习预测器仍易受坐标系不确定性影响；表面对与工具联合同心化消除共同原点平移的敏感性，而不正确接触几何与实际执行偏差引入不同失效机制。摘要未报告数值指标。
AI.conclusion: 作者认为，有效的空间泛化依赖于保留决定物理后果的动作—状态关系，而不是单纯最小化坐标变化；这为设计可跨空间构型复用物理知识、同时保留预测与规划所需区分的机器人世界模型提供了原则性基础。证据限于受控剥离基准上的对照研究，摘要未报告真实机器人部署或定量验证。

key_results.finding: 全局位姿与接触重定位实验显示，当等价交互收到不同空间描述时，有限的训练数据会带来代价。
key_results.setting: 受控机器人剥离基准；全局位姿与接触重定位实验；摘要未报告数值指标。
key_results.evidence_quote: Global pose and contact relocation experiments reveal a cost associated with limited training data when equivalent interactions receive different spatial descriptions.

41a157e51b5211d0e03ff0b8c634f47e39bfc761.title: K-PWM: Control-Oriented Structured Bilinear World Models under Partial Observation
41a157e51b5211d0e03ff0b8c634f47e39bfc761.summary: World models learn internal simulators of environment dynamics for prediction, planning, and control, yet learning them from limited, noisy, and partial observations remains challenging. While much progress has focused on pixel-based observations, many physical systems instead provide vector-valued measurements that reveal only part of the underlying state. We introduce K-PWM, a probabilistic world model for prediction and control under partial observation. K-PWM couples Koopman-bilinear latent dynamics with a nonlinear observation decoder and performs probabilistic latent-state inference through the learned model via extended Kalman filtering and smoothing, without a separately trained inference network. Its bilinear structure enables exact propagation of the maintained Gaussian belief through the latent transition and efficient rollouts for uncertainty-aware model predictive path integral (MPPI) control. For training K-PWM, we present a generalized expectation conditional maximization (GECM) procedure with closed-form updates for the generators, noise covariances, and latent prior, complemented by gradient-based decoder learning. A Koopman-consistent initialization selects the latent dimension from data and initializes the action-dependent dynamics. With limited training data, K-PWM achieves lower long-horizon prediction error than the evaluated baselines on partially observed Gymnasium MuJoCo systems, while substantially reducing training time relative to the strongest prediction baseline. On high-dimensional MuJoCo Menagerie robots, it achieves competitive tracking accuracy with low per-step computation times, demonstrating potential for real-time deployment. These results support structured probabilistic dynamics as a data- and compute-efficient approach to world modeling and control under partial observation.

AI.tldr: 针对只给出向量测量、仅揭示部分底层状态的部分可观测系统，K-PWM 把 Koopman 双线性潜动力学与非线性观测解码器耦合，并用扩展卡尔曼滤波/平滑在已学模型中直接做概率推断；作者报告其在部分可观测 Gymnasium MuJoCo 上长时程预测误差低于所评估基线且训练时间大幅缩短，但摘要未给出任何数值。
AI.motivation: 世界模型为预测、规划与控制学习环境的内部模拟器，但从有限、含噪、部分观测中学习这类模型仍然困难。已有进展多集中于像素观测，而许多物理系统只提供仅揭示部分底层状态的向量测量，因此需要一个面向控制、数据与算力高效的部分可观测世界模型。
AI.method: 输入是向量值（非像素）的部分观测与动作。K-PWM 用 Koopman 双线性潜动力学加一个非线性观测解码器构成概率世界模型；潜状态推断不依赖单独训练的推断网络，而是通过已学模型做扩展卡尔曼滤波与平滑。其双线性结构使所维护的高斯信念在潜转移中可精确传播，并支持高效 rollout，用于不确定性感知的 MPPI 控制。训练采用广义期望条件最大化（GECM）：对生成器、噪声协方差和潜先验给出闭式更新，解码器用梯度法学习；Koopman 一致初始化从数据中选取潜维度并初始化依赖动作的动力学。输出是预测与用于控制的 rollout。
AI.result: 作者报告：在有限训练数据下，K-PWM 在部分可观测的 Gymnasium MuJoCo 系统上长时程预测误差低于所评估基线，并相对最强预测基线大幅缩短训练时间；在高维 MuJoCo Menagerie 机器人上取得有竞争力的跟踪精度且每步计算时间低，展示出实时部署潜力。摘要未给出任何数值（误差值、训练时间、每步计算时间及其单位均缺失），也未说明是否在真实机器人上验证；因此这些均为作者自报的相对性表述，未经独立验证。
AI.conclusion: 对具身智能/世界模型研究的意义在于：作者提出以结构化概率动力学（双线性潜动力学 + 卡尔曼式信念推断）作为部分观测下数据与算力高效的世界建模与控制路线，并声称兼顾预测与控制。但证据边界很窄：仅有摘要级定性描述，缺少数值、基线细节与真实部署证据，不能据此推断其通用优越性、实时性已达成或可迁移到其他观测模态。
AI.core_method: 用 Koopman 双线性潜动力学加非线性观测解码器建模，直接在已学模型中用扩展卡尔曼滤波/平滑做信念推断，并以 GECM 闭式更新训练，从而为 MPPI 提供带不确定性的快速 rollout。

key_results.finding: 在有限训练数据、部分可观测的 Gymnasium MuJoCo 系统上，长时程预测误差低于所评估基线，且相对最强预测基线大幅缩短训练时间（摘要未给出误差值、训练时间数值与单位）。
key_results.setting: 基准/环境：部分可观测 Gymnasium MuJoCo 系统；条件：有限训练数据；比较对象：所评估基线、最强预测基线；具体指标数值、样本量与单位：摘要未报告。
