9e0d5e6f774c345f0ee18d8c7554c296fd6212af.title: BiPOP: Partial-Order Planning for Long-Horizon Bimanual Robotic Manipulation
9e0d5e6f774c345f0ee18d8c7554c296fd6212af.summary: Bimanual robotic manipulation is versatile, yet its central challenge lies not only in executing dexterous motion with each hand, but also in coordinating the two arms for long-horizon manipulation under coupled spatial and temporal constraints. Prior work has largely focused on endowing robots with human-level manipulation skills, paying less attention to the structure of bimanual behaviour itself: many practical tasks are a coordinated composition of reusable unimanual skills and a small set of synchronous bimanual skills. This makes high-level spatio-temporal coordination, rather than skill acquisition alone, a key bottleneck for efficient bimanual execution. We propose BiPOP, a framework that couples Large Language Models (LLMs) with Temporal Partial-Order Planning for long-horizon bimanual manipulation. At its core is an explicit spatio-temporal model that partitions the workspace by arm reachability and captures inter-arm dependencies, arm assignment, synchronization requirements, and opportunities for safe concurrent execution. Building on this model, an LLM translates natural-language instructions into a formal PDDL specification, while a temporal planner enforces the constraints and schedules actions, yielding plans that are logically consistent at the symbolic level and efficient through parallel execution. On simulated long-horizon tasks of varying complexity, BiPOP outperforms open-loop planning with strong reasoning models and closed-loop ReAct-style planning in success rate, planning time, and plan efficiency, and the full pipeline runs end to end on the real bimanual robot NICOL. A failure analysis further shows that LLM-only planners mainly violate spatial and temporal coordination constraints, which motivates delegating these constraints to a symbolic planner. Code: this https URL

AI.tldr: 双臂长时程操作的主要瓶颈被作者定位在高层时空协调而非单臂技能获取。BiPOP 用显式时空模型加 LLM→PDDL 转换与时序偏序规划器生成并行计划；摘要称其在仿真长时程任务上的成功率、规划时间与计划效率优于开环规划与闭环 ReAct 式规划，并在真实双臂机器人 NICOL 上端到端运行，但未给出任何数值。
AI.motivation: 作者指出，双臂操作的核心困难不只是每只手完成灵巧动作，还在于在耦合的空间与时间约束下协调两条手臂完成长时程任务。既有工作主要关注赋予机器人接近人类的操作技能，较少关注双臂行为本身的结构；许多实际任务其实是可复用单臂技能与少量同步双臂技能的协调组合。因此，高层时空协调而非单纯的技能获取，才是高效双臂执行的关键瓶颈。
AI.method: 输入是自然语言指令，以及一个显式时空模型：该模型按手臂可达性划分工作空间，并编码臂间依赖、手臂分配、同步要求与可安全并发执行的机会。机制上，LLM 把自然语言指令翻译成形式化的 PDDL 规范，随后由时序规划器施加这些约束并调度动作。输出是在符号层面逻辑一致、并通过并行执行提升效率的计划。相对摘要中提到的基线（开环 LLM 规划、闭环 ReAct 式规划），关键变化是把时空协调约束从 LLM 推理中剥离，交给符号时序规划器处理。
AI.result: 作者在仿真中不同复杂度的长时程任务上报告 BiPOP 在成功率、规划时间和计划效率三方面优于以强推理模型做的开环规划与闭环 ReAct 式规划，并称完整流水线在真实双臂机器人 NICOL 上端到端运行；摘要未报告任何数值、任务数量或统计信息。失败分析称仅用 LLM 的规划器主要违反空间与时间协调约束，这也被作者作为把约束交给符号规划器的动机。
AI.conclusion: 对具身智能而言，该工作提示"技能库 + 显式时空模型 + 符号时序规划"这一分工可能是长时程双臂协调的一条可行路线：可复用单臂技能与少量同步双臂技能的组合结构，可由规划器而非端到端策略来承担协调。局限在于证据强度：摘要只给出方向性比较，没有数值、任务规模或统计检验；真实机器人上仅说明整条流水线可端到端运行，未给出真实环境的定量结果。因此结论应限定为作者自述，未经独立验证。
AI.core_method: 让 LLM 把自然语言指令转成 PDDL，再由带显式双臂时空模型（按可达性分区、编码臂间依赖与同步/并发机会）的时序偏序规划器调度出可并行执行的计划。

key_results.finding: 在仿真长时程任务上，BiPOP 在成功率、规划时间和计划效率三项指标上优于开环规划（强推理模型）与闭环 ReAct 式规划；摘要未给出任何数值。
key_results.setting: 仿真中的长时程任务，复杂度不等；对照为使用强推理模型的开环规划与闭环 ReAct 式规划；摘要未报告任务数量、具体指标数值与统计检验。
key_results.evidence_quote: On simulated long-horizon tasks of varying complexity, BiPOP outperforms open-loop planning with strong reasoning models and closed-loop ReAct-style planning in success rate, planning time, and plan efficiency, and the full pipeline runs end to end on the real bimanual robot NICOL.

key_results.finding: 完整流水线在真实双臂机器人 NICOL 上端到端运行；摘要未报告该平台上的任何定量指标。
key_results.setting: 真实双臂机器人 NICOL 上的端到端运行；摘要未报告任务集、硬件配置、控制频率或成功率数值。
key_results.evidence_quote: and the full pipeline runs end to end on the real bimanual robot NICOL

key_results.finding: 失败分析显示，仅依赖 LLM 的规划器主要违反空间与时间协调约束，作者据此把这类约束交给符号规划器处理。
key_results.setting: 对 LLM-only 规划器的失败分析（对照对象为 LLM-only 规划器，而非 BiPOP 自身）；摘要未报告失败统计量或样本规模。
key_results.evidence_quote: A failure analysis further shows that LLM-only planners mainly violate spatial and temporal coordination constraints, which motivates delegating these constraints to a symbolic planner.

limitations: 摘要未报告任何数值结果：成功率、规划时间与计划效率的具体取值、任务数量、复杂度分级标准及统计显著性均缺失，只有方向性比较表述。
真实机器人部分仅说明在 NICOL 上端到端运行，摘要未报告真实环境下的定量评测、任务集、硬件细节与控制频率，因此不能推断真实世界性能。
作者未在摘要中陈述 BiPOP 自身的失败模式或局限（失败分析针对的是 LLM-only 规划器）；其方法在未见任务上的泛化能力、LLM→PDDL 转换的出错率等均为摘要未报告。

32f7fffc044c8776b09dc43760dd695710617c9f.title: EMS-Nav: Embodied Multi-Scale Navigation
32f7fffc044c8776b09dc43760dd695710617c9f.summary: Industrial inspection robots must reach work areas and specific equipment. These destinations span spatial scales from regions to objects, so robots must relate each target to its surroundings to interpret the task and determine where to go. Existing methods support multi-scale navigation through rich environment representations, but at substantial computational and storage cost. These costs limit deployment where wireless coverage is incomplete and robots must rely on onboard computation to keep navigating. We introduce EMS-Nav, a biologically inspired multi-scale navigation framework for online, on-device operation. Its core innovation is to organize perception, spatial understanding, and navigation around regions, making local spaces the basic units of both environmental understanding and computation. EMS-Nav groups objects and their relationships into functionally meaningful spaces and builds a hierarchy from local areas to the broader environment. This organization supports efficient map construction alongside the interpretation and execution of language goals at different scales. In multi-scale navigation experiments, EMS-Nav achieves the highest success rates across all four target categories: objects, rooms, regions, and specific instances. It outperforms state-of-the-art open-vocabulary mapping and navigation methods, improving overall first-attempt success by 9.39 percentage points over the strongest baseline while reducing mapping overhead and language-model input size. Local deployment in real indoor environments further demonstrates its applicability to on-device embodied navigation. By establishing regions as the organizing basis for perception, spatial understanding, and language-guided action, EMS-Nav provides a system that combines multi-scale understanding with computational efficiency to support diverse language goals on resource-constrained robots.

AI.tldr: EMS-Nav 面向工业巡检等场景的多尺度导航，把"区域"作为感知、空间理解与计算的基本单位，在设备端在线运行。作者报告其在物体、房间、区域、特定实例四类目标上成功率最高，整体首次尝试成功率比最强基线高 9.39 个百分点，并降低建图开销与语言模型输入规模。
AI.motivation: 巡检机器人需要到达工作区域和具体设备，目标跨越从区域到物体的多个空间尺度，机器人必须把目标与周围环境关联起来才能理解任务并决定去哪。现有方法用丰富的环境表示支持多尺度导航，但计算与存储成本很高；在无线覆盖不完整、机器人必须依赖板载计算持续导航的场景中，这些成本限制了部署。
AI.method: 输入是机器人的感知数据与不同尺度的语言目标。EMS-Nav 的做法是把感知、空间理解和导航都围绕"区域"来组织：先把物体及其相互关系归组为具有功能意义的空间，再由此构建从局部区域到更大环境的层次结构。与依赖高成本环境表示的基线不同，它让局部空间同时成为环境理解和计算的基本单元，从而支持高效建图，并在不同尺度上解释与执行语言目标。输出是可持续在线、在设备端运行的导航行为（建议见 core_method）。
AI.result: 作者报告在多尺度导航实验中，EMS-Nav 在物体、房间、区域和特定实例四类目标上均取得最高成功率，并优于最先进的开词汇建图与导航方法：整体首次尝试成功率比最强基线提升 9.39 个百分点，同时降低建图开销和语言模型输入规模（降幅未给出数值）。摘要另称其实现在真实室内环境中的本地部署。作者未报告各类别的数值成功率、任务数量、硬件或延迟数据。
AI.conclusion: 对具身智能而言，该工作的主张是把"区域"确立为感知、空间理解与语言引导行动的组织基准，从而在资源受限机器人上同时兼顾多尺度理解与计算效率。证据边界：结果来自作者自述的仿真/实验设置与一次真实室内环境的本地部署描述，未给出逐类别数值、算力与延迟细节，也未说明相比基线的任务规模与统计显著性；这些均无法从摘要核实。
AI.core_method: 把局部区域当作环境理解与计算的基本单元，将物体及其关系组织成功能空间并构建从局部到全局的层次结构，以支持设备端的在线多尺度建图与语言目标导航。

key_results.finding: 在物体、房间、区域、特定实例四类目标上均取得最高成功率（作者自述，摘要未给数值）。
key_results.setting: 多尺度导航实验；目标类别为 objects、rooms、regions、specific instances；具体基准与任务数量摘要未报告。
key_results.evidence_quote: EMS-Nav achieves the highest success rates across all four target categories: objects, rooms, regions, and specific instances.

key_results.finding: 整体首次尝试成功率比最强基线高 9.39 个百分点，同时降低建图开销与语言模型输入规模（后者未给数值）。
key_results.setting: 与最先进的开词汇建图与导航方法比较；具体基线名称、实验条件与降幅数值摘要未报告。
key_results.evidence_quote: It outperforms state-of-the-art open-vocabulary mapping and navigation methods, improving overall first-attempt success by 9.39 percentage points over the strongest baseline while reducing mapping overhead and language-model input size.

key_results.finding: 在真实室内环境中进行本地部署，作者称其表明该方法适用于设备端具身导航（未报告部署成功率等数值）。
key_results.setting: 真实室内环境的本地（设备端）部署；机器人平台、任务数量与量化指标摘要未报告。
key_results.evidence_quote: Local deployment in real indoor environments further demonstrates its applicability to on-device embodied navigation.

limitations: 作者未在摘要中报告任何自述局限；摘要亦未给出各类别成功率数值、任务数量、基线名称与统计显著性。
摘要未报告建图开销与语言模型输入规模的具体降低幅度，也未报告硬件平台、延迟或算力指标。
摘要仅称在真实室内环境中本地部署，未报告该部署的量化结果，因此不能推断真实世界的成功率水平。

ce28101f42ad72a2ca47890b51127a14c279cc32.title: GraSLA: A Lightweight Spatial-Language-Action Model with Grasp Hypotheses as Geometric Priors
ce28101f42ad72a2ca47890b51127a14c279cc32.summary: This paper focuses on improving the behavioral diversity and effectiveness of language-conditioned manipulation policies trained through imitation learning. Recently, continuous-action policies have become mainstream in robotic manipulation, but the lack of diverse demonstrations tends to restrict their behavioral diversity. For grasping, a fundamental subtask of manipulation, 6-DoF grasp detection provides diverse grasp hypotheses, but open-loop execution constrains responsiveness in dynamic environments. This motivates us to combine the diversity of grasp hypotheses with the adaptability of continuous-action policies. To this end, we propose GraSLA, a lightweight and effective spatial-language-action model with grasp hypotheses as geometric priors. In particular, we employ spatial and language foundation models to encode scene geometry and task semantics, and integrate them with grasp hypotheses through bidirectional cross-attention for continuous action prediction. On LIBERO, GraSLA achieves an average success rate of 99.30%.

AI.tldr: GraSLA 用 6-DoF 抓取假设作为几何先验，与空间、语言基础模型编码通过双向交叉注意力融合，以提升语言条件操作模仿学习策略的行为多样性；作者报告在 LIBERO 上平均成功率 99.30%。
AI.motivation: 摘要指出两个具体缺口：连续动作策略已成为机器人操作主流，但演示数据缺乏多样性，限制了策略的行为多样性；抓取检测（6-DoF grasp detection）虽能提供多样抓取假设，其开环执行又限制了动态环境中的响应能力。作者因此想把抓取假设的多样性与连续动作策略的自适应性结合起来。
AI.method: 输入为场景几何、任务语义与抓取假设三类信息。方法用空间基础模型编码场景几何、用语言基础模型编码任务语义，再通过双向交叉注意力（bidirectional cross-attention）把抓取假设与这两类表征互相整合，最终输出连续动作预测。相对摘要所述的基线（纯连续动作策略、以及开环执行的抓取检测），改变在于把抓取假设从被开环执行的最终动作，改为参与连续动作生成的几何先验。摘要未给出网络结构细节、参数规模或训练设置。
AI.result: 作者报告：在 LIBERO 基准上平均成功率为 99.30%。摘要未报告该数值的对照基线、提升幅度、任务细分、随机种子或真实机器人结果。
AI.conclusion: 对具身智能研究，该工作提示了一条将离散/几何先验（抓取假设）与连续动作策略耦合的可行路线，用于缓解模仿学习中演示多样性不足的问题。证据边界：摘要只给出单一基准 LIBERO 的平均成功率数值，未报告真实机器人验证、未报告效率或与基线的定量对比，因此“轻量”与“有效”目前仅为作者表述，不能据此推断实际部署表现。
AI.core_method: 用空间与语言基础模型分别编码场景几何和任务语义，再以双向交叉注意力把抓取假设作为几何先验融入，直接预测连续动作。

key_results.finding: GraSLA 在 LIBERO 上取得 99.30% 的平均成功率。
key_results.setting: 任务/基准：LIBERO；对照基线：摘要未报告；实验条件（真实机器人或仿真、随机种子、任务数）：摘要未报告。
key_results.evidence_quote: On LIBERO, GraSLA achieves an average success rate of 99.30%.

limitations: 作者在摘要中报告的动机性限制：连续动作策略受演示多样性不足制约，行为多样性受限；抓取检测的开环执行在动态环境中响应能力受限。
摘要未报告真实机器人实验，仅在 LIBERO 上给出成功率，因此无法判断真实场景适用性。
摘要未报告模型参数量、推理延迟或算力开销等效率数据，也未报告与基线的对比数值或消融结果；尽管标题称“lightweight”，该属性在摘要中缺乏量化证据。

d10b3fb4f4280feec65483afb62d78b655465ce1.title: Embedded Sim-to-Real Visual Servoing: Learned Reaching and Force-Guided Placement
d10b3fb4f4280feec65483afb62d78b655465ce1.summary: Embedded perception-to-control systems must combine visual targeting with reliable contact handling under tight computational constraints. We present a shared architecture on an NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin controlling a Franka Research 3 through Cartesian impedance control. RealSense D435i observations, YOLO11-seg segmentation, depth back-projection, and hand--eye calibration provide metric robot-frame targets. We compare two strategies: compact proximal policy optimization (PPO) policies transferred from simulation for object- and hole-region reaching, and force-guided Cartesian placement using approximately 2 N normal contact and spiral search. The PPO policies achieved 87.2% and 83.1% success over 1000 simulation episodes each. Across 50 real-robot trials per strategy, the learned hybrid and force-guided analytical pipelines achieved 70.0% and 74.0% completion, respectively. Mean perception latency with TensorRT was 34.55 ms. These results support an embedded architecture combining learned free-space reaching with explicit contact correction.

AI.tldr: 在NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin与Franka Research 3上构建嵌入式视觉伺服架构，用YOLO11-seg分割和深度反投影生成机器人坐标系目标。比较仿真迁移的紧凑PPO到达策略与力引导笛卡尔放置：PPO仿真成功率87.2%和83.1%，真实机器人每策略50次试验中学习混合与力引导分析流程完成70.0%和74.0%，TensorRT感知延迟34.55 ms。
AI.motivation: 嵌入式感知到控制系统需要在紧计算约束下同时完成视觉瞄准与可靠的接触处理；摘要指出这一组合是核心需求。
AI.method: 输入为RealSense D435i观测，经YOLO11-seg分割、深度反投影和手眼标定得到机器人坐标系的度量目标。系统运行在Jetson AGX Orin上，通过笛卡尔阻抗控制Franka Research 3。方法比较两条策略：从仿真迁移的紧凑PPO策略负责物体与孔区域到达；力引导笛卡尔放置使用约2 N法向接触和螺旋搜索。输出是自由空间到达与接触放置的机器人动作；作者主张将学习到的自由空间到达与显式接触修正结合。
AI.result: PPO策略在仿真中每个1000回合分别达到87.2%和83.1%成功率；真实机器人每个策略50次试验中，学习混合流程与力引导分析流程分别达到70.0%和74.0%完成率；TensorRT平均感知延迟为34.55 ms。摘要未报告基线对比或统计显著性。
AI.conclusion: 摘要层面的证据支持一种嵌入式架构：学习策略负责自由空间到达，显式力控制负责接触修正。真实机器人结果仅来自每策略50次试验，且摘要未报告与基线的定量比较，因此不能外推到更广部署或泛化能力。
AI.core_method: 用分割与深度反投影得到机器人坐标系目标，仿真迁移PPO完成自由空间到达，再用约2 N接触力和螺旋搜索做笛卡尔放置。

key_results.finding: 紧凑PPO策略在仿真中分别达到87.2%和83.1%成功率。
key_results.setting: 每个策略1000个仿真回合；任务为物体区域到达和孔区域到达；摘要未报告基线。
key_results.evidence_quote: The PPO policies achieved 87.2% and 83.1% success over 1000 simulation episodes each.

key_results.finding: 学习混合流程与力引导分析流程在真实机器人上分别达到70.0%和74.0%完成率。
key_results.setting: 每个策略50次真实机器人试验；摘要未报告基线或统计显著性。
key_results.evidence_quote: Across 50 real-robot trials per strategy, the learned hybrid and force-guided analytical pipelines achieved 70.0% and 74.0% completion, respectively.

key_results.finding: TensorRT的平均感知延迟为34.55 ms。
key_results.setting: 嵌入式平台上的感知推理；摘要未报告对比基线或端到端延迟。
key_results.evidence_quote: Mean perception latency with TensorRT was 34.55 ms.

limitations: 摘要未报告作者声明的局限性；失败模式、接触力控制误差和泛化范围均未说明。
摘要未报告真实机器人完成率（70.0%和74.0%）的统计显著性、置信区间或试验样本之外的结果。
摘要未报告与基线方法的定量对比、消融实验，也未报告除TensorRT感知延迟外的端到端延迟或计算占用。

1841c2c14935e51880e1dcadc21d728cf5cf9a34.title: Recover, Don't Just Continue: Learning from Feedback for Physical Failure Understanding and Correction
1841c2c14935e51880e1dcadc21d728cf5cf9a34.summary: Multimodal large language models are regarded as the cognitive foundation of embodied intelligence, but planning from instructions alone cannot make them reliable. During execution, actions deviate from intended effects, constrained by the embodiment and environment. An embodied brain must understand why execution deviates, identify what can be reliably realized, and revise decisions using interaction experience. These correspond to causal failure localization, capability-constrained adaptation, and experience-driven revision. Current embodied foundation models largely lack these capabilities. To address this, we introduce Embodied-Corrector. We construct failure-recovery data by injecting perturbations at subtask boundaries of successful trajectories, replaying affected subtasks, and keeping failures that are observable from public evidence and recoverable from the current state. We align actions, consequences, failure causes, and recoveries into Judge-Cause-Sub-Fine supervision. Training uses evaluation-first SFT: the model learns Judge and Cause first, then Sub and Fine conditioned on accurate prefixes. Since deployment uses self-generated prefixes, evaluation errors propagate into recovery planning, and response-level rewards are too coarse to locate affected planning tokens. We therefore use OPD to internalize the planning distribution under accurate prefixes into that under self-generated ones: the model generates plans from self-generated prefixes, while a contrastive forward pass with accurate prefixes compares token probabilities to reinforce or suppress planning tokens. At deployment, this branch is removed. Experiments show stronger failure analysis and corrective planning: with a frozen VLA, composite task success improves by 6.1 percentage points; with fixed GPT-5.5 execution, manipulation and navigation tasks improve by 13.9 percentage points.

AI.tldr: 针对多模态大模型仅凭指令规划、执行时动作偏离意图且缺乏失败定位与修订能力的问题，作者提出 Embodied-Corrector：用子任务边界注入扰动构造失败—恢复数据，以 Judge-Cause-Sub-Fine 监督做"先评估后生成"的 SFT，再用 OPD 把"准确前缀下的规划分布"蒸馏到"自生成前缀"上，部署时移除该分支。摘要报告：冻结 VLA 时复合任务成功率提升 6.1 个百分点；固定 GPT-5.5 执行时操作与导航任务提升 13.9 个百分点。
AI.motivation: 摘要指出，多模态大语言模型被视为具身智能的认知基础，但"仅从指令规划"无法保证可靠：执行过程中动作会因具身形态与环境约束而偏离预期效果。具身大脑需要理解偏离原因、识别哪些目标可被可靠实现、并利用交互经验修订决策，对应因果失败定位、能力受限适应与经验驱动修订三种能力。摘要称当前具身基础模型大体缺乏这些能力。
AI.method: 输入是成功轨迹与执行中的失败情形。数据侧：在成功轨迹的子任务边界注入扰动、重放受影响的子任务，只保留"可由公开证据观察到且能从当前状态恢复"的失败；并把动作、后果、失败原因与恢复对齐成 Judge-Cause-Sub-Fine 监督。训练分两步：先做 evaluation-first SFT，让模型先学 Judge 与 Cause，再在准确前缀条件下学 Sub 与 Fine；由于部署时用的是自生成前缀、评估误差会传导到恢复规划，且响应级奖励太粗、无法定位受影响的规划 token，作者用 OPD 将准确前缀下的规划分布内化到自生成前缀下——模型从自生成前缀生成计划，同时用准确前缀做对比前向、比较 token 概率以强化或抑制规划 token。输出是具备失败分析与纠正性规划能力的策略；部署时该对比分支被移除。
AI.result: 摘要给出两项改进，均以"百分点"报告而非相对百分比：在冻结 VLA 的设定下，复合任务成功率提升 6.1 个百分点；在执行由固定 GPT-5.5 完成的设定下，操作与导航任务提升 13.9 个百分点。摘要同时概括称实验显示"更强的失败分析与纠正性规划"，但未给出具体基准名称、成功率绝对值、对比基线、数据规模或是否包含真机实验。是否仿真或真机、样本量与显著性均未报告。
AI.conclusion: 对具身智能与规划研究而言，该工作把"执行偏离"当作一等监督信号：先定位失败原因、再在能力约束下重规划，并用准确前缀与自生成前缀之间的 token 级对比来缓解评估误差向恢复规划的传播，这是对"仅继续执行"式规划范式的一次针对性修正。证据边界明确：摘要只报告两个百分点提升，且未说明实验平台（仿真或真机）、基线定义与统计细节，因此可支持的结论仅限于"作者称失败分析与纠正性规划得到改善"，其泛化性与可靠性未经摘要层面的独立验证。
AI.core_method: 把子任务边界注入扰动得到的失败—恢复轨迹按"判断—原因—子任务—细粒度动作"监督训练，并用准确前缀与自生成前缀的 token 概率对比把纠错能力内化到部署策略中。

fad1c3d081fcec97323c82b17807fee837d90327.title: Bind-WAM: Binding-Uncertainty-Guided Selective Future Imagination in World Action Models
fad1c3d081fcec97323c82b17807fee837d90327.summary: World Action Models (WAMs) can improve robot learning by jointly predicting future visual states and actions, but generating a visual future at every replanning step is expensive and sometimes unnecessary. This raises a critical question: when should a robot policy imagine the future? In this paper, we propose Bind-WAM, a binding-uncertainty-guided WAM for selective future imagination. Bind-WAM introduces language-object binding uncertainty, selectively invoking joint future-action generation when the current observation does not support stable task-relevant action generation. An offline labeling pipeline uses complete demonstrations and action context to identify task-relevant objects and detect reference mismatch, invisibility, and identity drift. The resulting pseudo-labels supervise a lightweight router that predicts binding uncertainty from the current observation and language instruction. At inference, a shared WAM policy invokes selective future imagination according to the predicted uncertainty and its change between consecutive replanning steps. Simulation and real-world experiments demonstrate that Bind-WAM can establish binding uncertainty as a strong, interpretable signal for selective future imagination.

AI.tldr: 世界动作模型（WAM）在每个重规划步都生成视觉未来代价高且有时不必要；Bind-WAM 用语言-物体绑定不确定性训练轻量路由器，选择性触发未来-动作联合生成。作者称仿真与真实世界实验表明该不确定性可作为选择性未来想象的强且可解释信号，但摘要未报告数值结果。
AI.motivation: WAM 联合预测未来视觉状态与动作可以改善机器人学习，但在每个重规划步生成视觉未来昂贵，且并不总是必要。核心缺口是：机器人策略应当在何时想象未来。
AI.method: 输入是当前观测与语言指令。离线阶段用完整示范和动作上下文标注任务相关物体，检测参考错配、不可见与身份漂移，生成伪标签；再用这些伪标签监督一个轻量路由器，从当前观测和语言指令预测语言-物体绑定不确定性。推理时，共享 WAM 策略根据预测的不确定性及其在两个连续重规划步之间的变化，选择是否调用未来视觉状态与动作的联合生成。相对于“每步都生成视觉未来”的设定，关键变化是让未来想象由绑定不确定性选择性触发，而非无条件执行。
AI.result: 作者报告仿真和真实世界实验表明，Bind-WAM 可以确立绑定不确定性作为选择性未来想象的强且可解释信号；摘要未给出任务、基准、对比基线或任何数值指标。
AI.conclusion: 对具身智能与世界模型研究而言，该工作提出用语言-物体绑定不确定性作为“何时想象未来”的触发信号，可能减少无条件未来生成的开销。但摘要仅支持定性声明：没有量化增益、任务细节或计算节省数据，无法判断相对基线的实际效果与真实部署范围。
AI.core_method: 用离线伪标签训练轻量路由器，从当前观测和语言指令预测语言-物体绑定不确定性，并据此及其跨重规划步变化选择性触发 WAM 的未来-动作联合生成。

key_results.finding: 作者称在仿真和真实世界实验中，绑定不确定性可作为选择性未来想象的强且可解释信号；摘要未报告指标数值、单位或对比基线。
key_results.setting: 实验条件为仿真与真实世界实验；具体任务、基准、基线与评估指标在摘要中未报告。
key_results.evidence_quote: Simulation and real-world experiments demonstrate that Bind-WAM can establish binding uncertainty as a strong, interpretable signal for selective future imagination.

limitations: 作者报告的问题/动机是：在每个重规划步生成视觉未来昂贵且有时不必要。
摘要未报告任务、基准、对比基线、成功率或误差等任何数值结果，无法判断相对改进或绝对效果。
摘要未报告路由器预测精度、不确定性阈值、实际计算/时延节省量，以及真实世界实验的平台、场景范围与失败情况。

587932382dada5b5d480484e64516fba1a60cac6.title: What Makes a VLA Reactive? A Study of Execution Strategies for Dynamic Manipulation
587932382dada5b5d480484e64516fba1a60cac6.comment: 13 pages, 7 figures, Efficient Foundation Models for Real-Time Embodied AI, CoRL 2026 Workshop
587932382dada5b5d480484e64516fba1a60cac6.summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models predict chunks of future actions, and when objects move, those chunks go stale before they are executed. We study what makes a pretrained VLA reactive, using \pihalf{} on two dynamic simulation benchmarks and three real-robot tasks. We vary the prediction and execution horizons, compare synchronous and asynchronous inference, test methods that deliver actions sooner or keep successive chunks continuous, and adapt the policy with motion cues and latent-space reinforcement learning. The best prediction horizon is about one second, and the best execution horizon depends on the checkpoint. Short horizons help more with asynchronous execution, and methods that keep the trajectory continuous outperform those that only reduce latency. Adapting the policy repairs targeted failures, but on the conveyor task changing the execution horizon gained as much. Reactivity depends on the execution pipeline as much as on the policy, so both should be evaluated together.

AI.tldr: 针对 VLA 动作块在动态场景中执行前过期的问题，作者在预训练 π0.5 上系统改变预测/执行时域、同步与异步推理以及动作块连续性，并测试运动线索和潜空间强化学习适配；报告最佳预测时域约一秒、最佳执行时域依检查点而变，且保持轨迹连续的方法优于仅降低延迟。
AI.motivation: VLA 模型会预测未来动作块，但物体移动时这些动作块在真正执行前就已失效，导致动态操作反应性不足；摘要指出现有理解需要区分反应性来自策略本身还是执行管线。
AI.method: 以预训练 VLA（π0.5）的动作块预测为对象，输入为动态操作任务中的预测动作块与执行管线设置；方法改变预测时域和执行时域，比较同步与异步推理，测试提前交付动作或保持相邻动作块连续的策略，并用运动线索和潜空间强化学习适配策略。输出是在两个动态仿真 benchmark 和三个真实机器人任务上的操作表现/任务结果。相对默认的动作块预测后执行流程，改动主要在预测-执行管线与策略适配，而非提出全新 VLA 架构。
AI.result: 作者报告：最佳预测时域约为 one second（约一秒）；最佳执行时域取决于检查点。短时域在异步执行下帮助更大；保持轨迹连续的方法优于只降低延迟的方法。策略适配能修复针对性失败，但在 conveyor 任务上，改变执行时域获得的增益与策略适配相当。摘要未报告成功率、单位、baseline 数值或统计显著性，也未给出具体 benchmark 名称和检查点细节。
AI.conclusion: 对具身智能/动态操作而言，该摘要提示 VLA 反应性由执行管线与策略共同决定，预测/执行时域、异步推理和动作连续性应与策略一起评测。证据边界：仅基于摘要，未读全文；没有定量指标，不能推断真实部署效果或存在普适最优执行时域。
AI.core_method: 在预训练 VLA π0.5 上系统改变预测/执行时域、同步异步推理与动作块连续性，并用运动线索和潜空间强化学习做策略适配。

key_results.finding: 短时域对异步执行的帮助更大；保持轨迹连续的方法优于仅降低延迟的方法。
key_results.setting: 比较同步与异步推理，并测试提前交付动作或保持连续动作块的方法；具体 benchmark、指标和 baseline 摘要未报告。
key_results.evidence_quote: Short horizons help more with asynchronous execution, and methods that keep the trajectory continuous outperform those that only reduce latency.

key_results.finding: 策略适配可修复针对性失败，但在 conveyor 任务上，改变执行时域获得的增益与策略适配相当。
key_results.setting: 用运动线索和潜空间强化学习适配策略，并在 conveyor 任务上与改变执行时域比较；具体指标与统计信息摘要未报告。
key_results.evidence_quote: Adapting the policy repairs targeted failures, but on the conveyor task changing the execution horizon gained as much.

limitations: 作者报告：最佳执行时域取决于检查点，意味着不存在统一最优执行时域；摘要未报告具体检查点、时域取值或任务差异。

e1b0461e381ff79704886e5873369e4d1302d04a.title: MOSAIC: Modular Obstacle and Spatial-Aware Framework for Manipulation In Cluttered Scenes
e1b0461e381ff79704886e5873369e4d1302d04a.summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have demonstrated strong performance in robotic manipulation, yet most rely primarily on 2D visual observations and language instructions, leaving scene geometry and obstacle relationships to be inferred implicitly. This limitation is particularly problematic in cluttered environments, where small spatial errors can lead to unintended contacts or collisions. We propose MOSAIC, a modular spatial- and obstacle-aware framework that can be integrated with pretrained VLA policies to improve object-level scene understanding and action generation. Our method augments the VLA backbone with an auxiliary semantic grounding task that predicts role-specific masks for the target object, destination region, and surrounding obstacles. We further combine the target and destination masks with depth estimated from 3D scene reconstruction to construct role-specific geometric tokens that are injected directly into the action expert. In addition, we propose obstacle-aware attention supervision that emphasizes obstacles near the robot body during task execution. The resulting attention features are subsequently injected into later action-expert layers to further guide action generation. Together, these components provide explicit semantic, geometric, and obstacle-aware cues while preserving the underlying pretrained VLA architecture. We evaluate our framework on pretrained VLA model using the RoboPRO benchmark, including visual perturbation tests, and further validate it on real-world manipulation tasks. MOSAIC improves the success rate by 5.1% in cluttered scenes, and by 9.7% under visual perturbations, with gains of up to 25.0% in the most challenging environment. We will release our code and dataset upon acceptance at the following Github page: this https URL

AI.tldr: MOSAIC 是一个可插入预训练 VLA 策略的模块化空间-障碍感知框架，通过角色专属掩码、深度几何 token 与障碍注意力监督显式注入语义、几何与障碍线索，作者报告杂乱场景成功率提升 5.1%、视觉扰动下提升 9.7%。
AI.motivation: 现有 VLA 模型主要依赖 2D 视觉观测与语言指令，场景几何与障碍关系只能被隐式推断；摘要指出这在杂乱环境中尤其成问题，小的空间误差会导致非预期接触或碰撞。
AI.method: 输入仍是预训练 VLA 骨干所用的视觉观测与语言指令，方法不替换骨干，而是加装三部分：①一个辅助语义 grounding 任务，预测目标物体、目的地区域与周围障碍物的角色专属掩码；②把目标掩码与目的地掩码同基于 3D 场景重建估计的深度结合，构造角色专属几何 token，直接注入 action expert；③障碍感知注意力监督，在执行任务时强调靠近机器人本体的障碍物，并把得到的注意力特征注入 action expert 的较后层。输出是更受语义、几何与障碍线索引导的动作生成，同时保留原有预训练 VLA 架构。
AI.result: 在预训练 VLA 基线与 RoboPRO 基准上评估，并包含视觉扰动测试，另称在真实世界操作任务上做了验证。摘要报告：杂乱场景成功率提升 5.1%；视觉扰动下提升 9.7%；最具挑战性环境中增益最高达 25.0%。摘要未说明这些数字是百分点还是相对百分比，也未给出绝对成功率、真实机器人任务的具体指标或基线数值。项目代码与数据集称将在接收后于 Github 页面发布（摘要中为 "this https URL"）。
AI.conclusion: 对具身智能而言，这项工作给出一种"不重训骨干、只注入显式空间与障碍线索"的路线，说明把角色级语义掩码、深度几何与障碍注意力作为额外监督和 token 注入 VLA，可能改善杂乱场景与视觉扰动下的操作成功率。证据边界：仅为作者自述的基准与真实机器人成功率增量，摘要未报告效率开销、失败模式或统计细节，因此不能推断其泛化性、实时性或优于其他空间感知方案。
AI.core_method: 用辅助语义分割预测目标/目的地/障碍物掩码，把掩码与深度重建得到的几何 token 及障碍注意力特征注入预训练 VLA 的 action expert，而不改动骨干架构。

key_results.finding: 在视觉扰动条件下成功率提升 9.7%（摘要未说明是百分点还是相对提升）。
key_results.setting: RoboPRO 基准的视觉扰动测试，基线为预训练 VLA；扰动类型与强度摘要未报告。
key_results.evidence_quote: and by 9.7% under visual perturbations

key_results.finding: 在最具挑战性的环境中增益最高达 25.0%（对比对象为预训练 VLA 基线，摘要未说明是百分点还是相对提升）。
key_results.setting: 作者所述的 most challenging environment，具体环境条件、真实或仿真、样本量摘要未报告。
key_results.evidence_quote: with gains of up to 25.0% in the most challenging environment.

limitations: 作者在摘要中未报告任何自身方法的局限（作者报告的局限：无；摘要未报告）。
摘要仅称在真实世界操作任务上做了验证（"further validate it on real-world manipulation tasks"），未给出该真实机器人任务的任务定义、指标数值、平台或试验次数（摘要未报告）。

b07e4ea84b0f72d73487041b62f9ad2f0f8d81f1.title: DexRemo: A Force-Sensing Hand Platform and Task Suite for Contact-Rich Removal Manipulation
b07e4ea84b0f72d73487041b62f9ad2f0f8d81f1.comment: Accepted for publication in IEEE Transactions on Robotics (T-RO), 2026. Project website: this https URL
b07e4ea84b0f72d73487041b62f9ad2f0f8d81f1.summary: Many manipulation tasks require separating adhered, embedded, contaminated, or mechanically constrained targets. We study this setting as removal manipulation, where progress depends on evolving contact states that are only partially observable from vision and kinematics. We introduce DexRemo, a three-finger robotic hand with high-force actuation, modular fingertips, and three-axis fingertip force sensing, together with a nine-scenario real-robot task suite spanning adhesive detachment, surface cleaning and self-cleaning, and occluded retrieval. To make multi-finger force observations easier to fuse, we express fingertip forces in a shared wrist-centered frame, giving force components consistent geometric meaning across fingers and time. Using an Action Chunking Transformer backbone, policies fuse multi-view vision, proprioception, fingertip pose, and force observations to predict closed-loop action chunks from demonstrations. Evaluation uses six core benchmark tasks for controlled fingertip-input and force-frame ablations, plus three extension scenarios for additional held-out coverage. Across these evaluations, the learned policies achieve consistent removal performance, and ablations show that wrist-frame forces, especially with fingertip pose, improve stability and generalization over local-frame force inputs and no-force baselines. Project website: this https URL

AI.tldr: 针对"移除式操作"（分离粘附/嵌入/污染/受机械约束的目标）中接触状态难以从视觉与运动学观测的问题，作者提出三指力感知手平台 DexRemo 与九场景真机任务套件，并让策略在统一腕部坐标系下融合指尖力；消融显示腕部坐标系力（尤其结合指尖位姿）比局部坐标系力与无力基线更稳定、泛化更好。摘要未报告任何数值结果。
AI.motivation: 许多操作任务需要分离粘附、嵌入、被污染或受机械约束的目标，作者把这类设定定义为 removal manipulation；其进展依赖于仅从视觉和运动学只能被部分观测到的、不断变化的接触状态。摘要指出这一可观测性缺口，但没有报告任何失败率、数值基线或具体失败案例。
AI.method: 硬件输入/输出：DexRemo 是一只有高力输出驱动、模块化指尖与三轴指尖力传感的三指机器人手。数据表示：把指尖力统一表达在共享的腕部中心坐标系中，使各手指、各时刻的力分量具有一致的几何含义，便于多指力观测融合。策略：以 Action Chunking Transformer 为骨干，输入多视角视觉、本体感受、指尖位姿与力观测，从示教中预测闭环动作块。评测组织：六个核心基准任务用于受控的指尖输入与力坐标系消融，另加三个扩展场景用于额外留出覆盖；摘要未给出消融的具体实现细节与训练规模。
AI.result: 作者报告在全部评测中学习到的策略取得一致的移除操作表现，并通过消融说明腕部坐标系力优于局部坐标系力与无力基线；摘要未报告任何数值指标、单位或基线数值，也未区分各任务的量化成功率。
AI.conclusion: 对具身智能研究的意义在于：把"移除式"接触丰富任务做成可复用的真机平台+任务套件，并给出一种让多指力信号可融合的坐标表达思路，可能对依赖接触状态的任务策略有参考价值。证据边界：所有结论均为作者自述，仅来自标题与摘要；没有数值结果、没有与外部方法的定量比较、没有统计显著性，也未报告失败模式，因此无法判断相对现有方法的实际增益幅度。

5d15fd427fd4e0889694cf426125227788a1557f.title: Memory-Efficient Parallel Policy Learning for Collapse-Reactive Retreat via Hybrid Terrain Modeling
5d15fd427fd4e0889694cf426125227788a1557f.summary: At disaster sites and on unstable slopes, robot contact can collapse uninspected terrain, requiring retreat upon support loss. Massively parallel reinforcement learning of collapse-reactive retreat requires independent state--action experiences. However, on shared rigid-body collapsible terrain, one robot's collapse alters others' contacts without direct interaction. We call this indirect interference. Duplicating terrain objects prevents this but is memory-intensive, limiting parallel sampling. Our key insight is that policy learning does not necessarily require rigid-body collapse modeling, which is feasible but computationally expensive; collapse-induced contact responses can suffice. We therefore propose a memory-efficient parallel policy-learning framework for collapse-reactive retreat via hybrid terrain modeling. Hybrid terrain modeling combines rigid-body simulation of non-collapsible terrain with virtual contact forces for collapsible regions. A State-Multiplexed Contact Model shares terrain geometry and a contact-response law while maintaining environment-specific collapse states, enabling independent experiences without terrain objects for collapsible regions. The framework trains a proprioceptive policy for both normal locomotion and collapse-reactive retreat. It supports over 100 times as many parallel environments as fine-resolution rigid-block terrain within the same GPU memory limit. This scalability and improved sample efficiency enable over 50 times faster policy convergence with comparable retreat performance. Sim-to-sim and real-robot experiments demonstrate retreat under multiple collapse conditions. A supplementary video is available at: this https URL

AI.tldr: 并行强化学习训练「坍塌可反应式撤退」策略时，共享刚体可坍塌地形会造成间接干扰，而复制地形物体又太占内存。作者用「混合地形建模」把不可坍塌区域留在刚体仿真、把可坍塌区域换成虚拟接触力，并用状态复用的接触模型维持各环境独立坍塌状态，从而在同等显存下支持超过100倍的并行环境数、策略收敛快于50倍以上。
AI.motivation: 在灾害现场和不稳定坡面上，机器人接触可能导致未勘察地形坍塌，需要在失去支撑时撤退。大规模并行强化学习需要各环境独立的「状态-动作」经验；但在共享的刚体可坍塌地形上，一个机器人的坍塌会在无直接交互的情况下改变其他机器人的接触（作者称之为间接干扰）。复制地形物体可避免干扰，但内存开销大，限制了并行采样规模。
AI.method: 输入是机器人本体感知状态与地形接触信息；方法改变的是地形仿真方式而非机器人硬件。混合地形建模：非坍塌区域继续用刚体仿真，可坍塌区域不再建模刚体坍塌，而是施加虚拟接触力。State-Multiplexed Contact Model 让各并行环境共享同一份地形几何与接触响应规律，同时各自维护环境特定的坍塌状态，因此不需要为可坍塌区域创建地形物体也能得到相互独立的经验。相对基线为「精细分辨率刚体块地形（含地形物体复制）」；输出是一个本体感知策略，同时负责正常行走与支撑丧失后的反应式撤退。
AI.result: 在相同 GPU 显存上限下，并行环境数是精细分辨率刚体块地形的 100 倍以上；样本效率提升使策略收敛速度快 50 倍以上，且撤退性能相当（均为相对倍数，非百分点）。sim-to-sim 与真机实验显示在多种坍塌条件下可以完成撤退。摘要未报告成功率、前进距离等具体任务指标数值。
AI.conclusion: 对该方向的启示是：学习坍塌反应式策略未必需要昂贵的刚体坍塌建模，坍塌诱发的接触响应可能已足够，这使高并行采样在有限显存下变得可行。证据边界：全部结论来自摘要，规模与加速均为相对倍数且未给绝对显存、环境数或成功率；真机仅表述为「demonstrate retreat under multiple collapse conditions」，未报告平台、条件数量或试验次数，也未与具体基线方法做数值对比。
AI.core_method: 不可坍塌地形用刚体仿真、可坍塌区域用虚拟接触力，并通过共享几何与接触响应律、各自维护坍塌状态的接触模型实现无地形物体的独立并行经验。

key_results.finding: 在相同 GPU 显存上限下，可支持的并行环境数超过精细分辨率刚体块地形的 100 倍。
key_results.setting: 与精细分辨率刚体块地形对比；条件为「相同 GPU 显存上限」；任务为坍塌反应式撤退的并行策略学习。摘要未报告具体显存数值与环境数绝对值。
key_results.evidence_quote: It supports over 100 times as many parallel environments as fine-resolution rigid-block terrain within the same GPU memory limit.

key_results.finding: 该可扩展性与样本效率提升带来超过 50 倍的策略收敛加速，且撤退性能相当。
key_results.setting: 同一框架下的收敛速度与撤退性能对比；摘要未报告绝对训练步数/时间、基线方法名称与性能指标数值。
key_results.evidence_quote: This scalability and improved sample efficiency enable over 50 times faster policy convergence with comparable retreat performance.

key_results.finding: sim-to-sim 与真机实验展示了在多种坍塌条件下的撤退行为。
key_results.setting: sim-to-sim 仿真迁移与真机实验；摘要未报告成功率、坍塌条件数量、真机平台与试验次数。
key_results.evidence_quote: Sim-to-sim and real-robot experiments demonstrate retreat under multiple collapse conditions.

limitations: 摘要未报告定量任务指标（如撤退成功率、前进距离、失败率），因此无法判断「comparable retreat performance」的具体差距；这属于摘要未报告，而非作者声明的缺陷。
摘要未报告实验细节：真机平台型号、坍塌地形参数与条件种类数、试验次数、sim-to-sim 使用的仿真器，以及训练的绝对时间或迭代步数。
作者未在摘要中陈述自身方法的局限性（如虚拟接触力近似的适用范围、对坍塌类型变化的泛化边界）；摘要仅给出两个相对倍数（100 倍以上、50 倍以上），未提供绝对数值或统计显著性。

e0b6270d4c8b4b3b94449237ef6eed972fae192d.title: MotionSkill: From Bipedal Motion Video to Control across Embodiments
e0b6270d4c8b4b3b94449237ef6eed972fae192d.comment: 8 pages, 7 figures, 5 tables. Fortune AI technical report
e0b6270d4c8b4b3b94449237ef6eed972fae192d.summary: Reusing a demonstrated gait can reduce the work of specifying the same motion for each biped. A video captures the timing of a step, but each robot must execute it with its own limbs and actuators. MotionSkill recovers a timed reference once from monocular video and adapts it to each target in simulation. It aligns root motion and body landmarks in a common frame and records which landmarks are available at each instant. At each source timestamp, the mapper preserves limb directions, uses the target segment lengths, and solves inverse kinematics under joint limits and closure constraints. In MuJoCo, we train a separate residual policy for each of ten bipeds on its mapped reference from one four-second walking clip. Each policy uses the measured robot state to correct joint commands during contact. From initial states held out during training, MotionSkill completed 98% of trials on the original video and 26% with the upper body occluded for one second.

AI.tldr: 单目视频能提供步态时序，但每个双足机器人需用自己的连杆与驱动器执行；MotionSkill 从一段四秒视频中提取一次带时序的参考动作，映射到十个双足机器人并用逆运动学求解，再在 MuJoCo 中为每个机器人各训练一个残差策略，在接触期用实测机器人状态修正关节指令。作者报告在训练时留出的初始状态下，原始视频完成 98% 的试验，上半身被遮挡一秒时降至 26%。
AI.motivation: 摘要指出，复用已演示的步态可以减少为每个双足机器人单独指定同一动作的工作量；但视频只记录了迈步的时序，每个机器人必须用自己的肢体和驱动器去执行，因此需要一种把视频中的时序参考适配到不同机体的方法。
AI.method: 输入是一段单目视频（实验中为一个四秒行走片段）与目标机器人模型。方法先从视频中提取一次带时序的参考：把根运动与身体地标对齐到共同坐标系，并记录每一时刻哪些地标可用。在每个源时间戳上，映射器保留肢体方向、改用目标机器人的段长，并在关节限位与闭合约束下求解逆运动学，得到目标机的参考轨迹。随后在 MuJoCo 中为十个双足机器人各自训练一个独立的残差策略，策略以映射后的参考和实测机器人状态为条件，在接触阶段修正关节指令。输出是各目标机器人可执行的关节指令/控制策略，相对基线（摘要未明确指定基线）的变化在于：参考只从视频恢复一次，机体差异由段长替换、约束逆运动学与逐机残差策略吸收。
AI.result: 作者报告在 MuJoCo 中为十个双足机器人各训练残差策略，参考来自同一个四秒行走片段，并在训练时留出的初始状态下评测：原始视频完成 98% 的试验，上半身被遮挡一秒时完成 26% 的试验。摘要未报告与其它方法的数值对比，也未报告真实机器人结果。
AI.conclusion: 对具身智能而言，该工作提出一条“视频时序参考 + 机体映射 + 逐机残差策略”的跨机体运动复用路径，说明一次单目视频恢复的参考可经逆运动学映射供多个仿真双足使用。证据边界明确：全部结果来自 MuJoCo 仿真与十个仿真双足，摘要未报告真机部署或 sim-to-real 验证；遮挡条件下的完成率（26%）明显低于无遮挡（98%），说明对地标可见性的依赖是作者自报的薄弱环节。
AI.core_method: 从单目视频恢复一次带时序的参考，用保留肢体方向、替换段长的约束逆运动学映射到目标双足，再在仿真中为每个机器人训练残差策略修正接触期关节指令。

key_results.finding: 在训练时留出的初始状态下，原始视频的试验完成率为 98%，覆盖十个双足机器人（每个机器人各有一个独立残差策略）。
key_results.setting: MuJoCo 仿真；十个双足机器人；参考来自同一段四秒行走片段；初始状态为训练时留出（held out）；摘要未报告对比基线。
key_results.evidence_quote: From initial states held out during training, MotionSkill completed 98% of trials on the original video and 26% with the upper body occluded for one second.

key_results.finding: 上半身被遮挡一秒时，试验完成率降至 26%（同一评测条件与指标下从 98% 下降）。
key_results.setting: MuJoCo 仿真；十个双足机器人；四秒行走片段；训练时留出的初始状态；遮挡条件为上半身被遮挡一秒。
key_results.evidence_quote: MotionSkill completed 98% of trials on the original video and 26% with the upper body occluded for one second.

key_results.finding: 每个目标机体使用独立的残差策略，训练信号为其映射后的参考，来源是单个四秒行走片段。
key_results.setting: MuJoCo；十个双足机器人；每个机器人单独训练残差策略；摘要未报告策略输入维度、训练步数或硬件条件。
key_results.evidence_quote: In MuJoCo, we train a separate residual policy for each of ten bipeds on its mapped reference from one four-second walking clip.

limitations: 摘要未报告真实机器人实验或 sim-to-real 迁移结果，全部评测在 MuJoCo 仿真中完成——这是摘要信息缺失，而非作者明确指出该方法不具备真机能力。
作者自报的遮挡条件结果明显偏低：上半身遮挡一秒时完成率仅 26%，说明对地标可见性存在依赖；摘要未给出该退化的原因分析。
摘要未报告与其它方法的对比基线、统计显著性、真实视频类别多样性，也未说明残差策略的训练细节；参考仅来自一个四秒行走片段。

ac4ded1138477554e875d650f2b204c44f8f005c.title: Video-Action Models for Data-Efficient Industrial Manipulation
ac4ded1138477554e875d650f2b204c44f8f005c.summary: Industrial manipulation requires precise alignment and controlled handling of rigid, deformable, and flexible components. Yet, the benefits of pretrained visuomotor policies remain underexplored in settings where limited access to specialized hardware, components, and fixtures constrains demonstration collection and evaluation. Understanding task-specific data requirements is important for assessing their scalability across diverse processes on the factory floor. We investigate whether video pretraining can support reliable industrial manipulation with limited action data. We propose FLUX-mimic, a video-action model, motivated by the potential of video pretraining to capture motion and interaction patterns that enable sample-efficient training. FLUX-mimic is built on a backbone pretrained on large-scale web and industrial task data, and an action expert to generate robot trajectories. We train our policy by joint video-action training. Across four automotive manufacturing benchmark tasks and two bimanual robot platforms, FLUX-mimic outperforms all considered baselines on the dexterous robot platform and matches pi_{0.5}'s average success rate on the gripper-based robot platform. On a deformable part kitting task, FLUX-mimic reaches 77.5% success with as little as two hours of task-specific action-labeled demonstrations.

AI.tldr: 针对工业操作中动作数据稀缺，作者提出视频-动作模型 FLUX-mimic，用预训练骨干加动作专家并联合视频-动作训练生成机器人轨迹；在四个汽车制造基准任务、两种双臂平台上，作者报告其在灵巧平台优于所有考虑基线、在夹爪平台平均成功率与 pi_{0.5} 持平，并在可变形零件配料任务仅用两小时动作标注演示达到 77.5% 成功率。
AI.motivation: 工业操作需要精确对齐并处理刚性、可变形和柔性部件，但专用硬件、部件和夹具有限，导致演示采集与评估受限；预训练视觉运动策略在此类场景的收益尚未被充分探索，且任务特定数据需求不明，影响其在工厂流程中的可扩展性。
AI.method: 输入包括任务特定动作标注演示，以及来自大规模网络和工业任务数据的预训练信息。FLUX-mimic 以预训练骨干和动作专家为核心，通过联合视频-动作训练学习策略，输出机器人轨迹。摘要未说明相对具体基线的架构改动、训练细节或视频与动作目标的组合方式。
AI.result: 作者报告：在四个汽车制造基准任务与两种双臂机器人平台上，FLUX-mimic 在灵巧机器人平台优于所有考虑基线，在夹爪机器人平台平均成功率与 pi_{0.5} 持平；在可变形零件配料任务上，仅用两小时任务特定动作标注演示达到 77.5% 成功率。摘要未报告灵巧平台的具体成功率数值、除 pi_{0.5} 外的基线名称、统计显著性，也未明确结果是真机还是仿真。
AI.conclusion: 对具身智能而言，该工作提供了“视频预训练可支持有限动作数据下工业操作”的作者报告证据，并以 77.5% 成功率与两小时演示作为数据效率信号。但摘要只给出结果性声明，未报告消融、真实部署条件、统计显著性和具体效率指标，因此不能据此判断视频-动作联合训练各部分的独立贡献或泛化边界。
AI.core_method: 用大规模网络与工业任务数据预训练骨干，加上动作专家，通过视频-动作联合训练生成机器人轨迹。

key_results.finding: 在灵巧机器人平台上，FLUX-mimic 优于所有考虑的基线；在夹爪机器人平台上，其平均成功率与 pi_{0.5} 持平。
key_results.setting: 四个汽车制造基准任务、两种双臂机器人平台；摘要未报告具体成功率数值、基线名称与统计显著性。
key_results.evidence_quote: Across four automotive manufacturing benchmark tasks and two bimanual robot platforms, FLUX-mimic outperforms all considered baselines on the dexterous robot platform and matches pi_{0.5}'s average success rate on the gripper-based robot platform.

key_results.finding: 在可变形零件配料任务上，FLUX-mimic 仅用两小时任务特定动作标注演示达到 77.5% 成功率。
key_results.setting: 可变形零件配料任务，两小时任务特定动作标注演示；摘要未报告对比基线数值，也未明确真机或仿真条件。
key_results.evidence_quote: On a deformable part kitting task, FLUX-mimic reaches 77.5% success with as little as two hours of task-specific action-labeled demonstrations.

limitations: 摘要未报告作者明确声明的局限性。
摘要未报告样本量、统计显著性、具体硬件、推理延迟或效率指标，也未区分真机与仿真结果。
摘要未报告消融实验，无法判断视频预训练、动作专家或联合训练各自的贡献。

432fcb21b711b8466cb88e78d5ec223c32b9b1c5.title: Robot Navigation and Obstacle Avoidance from Randomly Positioned External Cameras
432fcb21b711b8466cb88e78d5ec223c32b9b1c5.comment: 8 pages, 2 figures, accepted as a regular paper for the 2027 IEEE/SICE International Symposium on System Integration
432fcb21b711b8466cb88e78d5ec223c32b9b1c5.summary: We study robot navigation in indoor environments from fixed exocentric cameras (infrastructure-mounted, external to the robot). We show that standard Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO), which succeeds with onboard cameras, fails to learn this navigation end-to-end in our setup. This failure results from the perspective mismatch between exocentric observations and egocentric action and goal formulations, which is too complex to resolve from the reward signal alone. To address this, we propose Viewpoint-Invariant Navigation from Exocentric Cameras (VINE). VINE uses an obstacle map estimation network, trained with supervised learning, that takes exocentric images, camera pose, robot pose, and room dimensions as input and produces a viewpoint-invariant obstacle map. This map can be used either by a PPO policy or by a planner such as A*. VINE's map estimation performs better than perspective mapping approaches, handles cameras placed across a wide range of positions and orientations without view-specific tuning, requires only approximate camera pose estimates (noise with a standard deviation of 30cm per axis in x, y, and z and about 20° of rotation error on average), is robust to intrinsic variation, and extends to two-camera setups with partial coverage. Despite operating from cameras randomized in position during evaluation, VINE surpasses the navigation success rate of PPO with an onboard camera in simulated environments.

042de32e3bc93a47683945321bc70cba94219cf9.title: Visibility-Aware Task and Motion Planning with Task-Centric Perception
042de32e3bc93a47683945321bc70cba94219cf9.summary: Long-horizon manipulation under uncertainty remains a challenging problem in robotics. We present \ourmethod{}, an algorithm for Visibility-Aware Task and Motion Planning. \ourmethod{} extends existing deterministic task and motion planning solvers to partially observable object rearrangement tasks, while still being able to take advantage of the efficiency and compositional generalization over long horizons of the base solver. This extension interleaves sensing actions into a plan skeleton that assumed full observability, and uses a novel persistent object-based memory to fuse observations into object mesh hypotheses and an observed occupancy map. We evaluate \ourmethod{} on real-world tabletop rearrangement tasks which feature heavy occlusion and partial visibility and demonstrate that it outperforms baselines that do not perform active perception or have persistent memory.

AI.tldr:

6d7708d8380196751bb66207fc2cec5e3a9753cd.title: Remember What Changes the Odds: Critic-Gated Event Memory for Long-Horizon Manipulation
6d7708d8380196751bb66207fc2cec5e3a9753cd.summary: In long-horizon manipulation, a robot may need to take different actions under identical observations, depending on task progress and the outcomes of earlier attempts. We refer to this ambiguity as decision aliasing. Resolving it requires the policy to maintain memory of its execution history. To reduce the cost of processing full observation histories, recent methods build compact event memories using perceptual, semantic, or kinematic cues. However, these criteria may miss events that matter for task success. We instead propose an outcome-grounded principle: remember events that substantially change the predicted probability of eventual success. Following this principle, we introduce CGEM, a critic-gated event memory that uses a critic to select events with large estimated changes in success probability. Positive and negative changes are encoded as progress and failure records, respectively. Failure records are discarded once the corresponding subtask is completed. In a ten-subtask diagnostic environment with exactly computed success probabilities, CGEM achieves 88.0% success, compared with 0.0% for both a 36-step observation window and a kinematic event memory. Removing failure records reduces success to 1.7%.

AI.tldr: 长时程操作中，相同观测在不同任务进度下需要不同动作（决策别名），而基于感知、语义或运动线索的事件记忆可能漏掉决定成败的关键事件。CGEM 改用奖励/成败概率变化来筛选记忆：用 critic 选出使预测成功率发生大幅变化的事件，分存为进展与失败记录，失败记录在对应子任务完成后丢弃；在十子任务的诊断环境中取得 88.0% 成功率，而 36 步观测窗口与运动事件记忆均为 0.0%。
AI.motivation: 摘要指出，长时程操作中存在“决策别名”：相同观测下，因任务进度与先前尝试结果不同，机器人需要采取不同动作。解决它要求策略保留执行历史的记忆；而近期方法用感知、语义或运动线索构建紧凑事件记忆以降低处理完整观测历史的成本，这些判据可能漏掉对任务成功真正重要的事件。
AI.method: 输入是机器人的执行历史（其中的候选事件），目标是为策略保留紧凑的记忆而非完整观测历史。核心机制是“以结果为据”的筛选原则：只记住那些会显著改变“最终成功概率”预测的事件。具体实现为 CGEM——一个由 critic 门控的事件记忆，critic 估计各事件带来的成功率变化，并选取变化大的事件；正向变化记为进展记录，负向变化记为失败记录。失败记录在对应子任务完成后被丢弃。输出是供策略使用的事件记忆，据摘要所述其作用是降低处理完整观测历史的成本并缓解决策别名。相对基线的改变在于筛选判据：从感知/语义/运动线索改为成功率变化。
AI.result: 作者报告在“十子任务、成功概率被精确计算”的诊断环境中，CGEM 成功率为 88.0%，而 36 步观测窗口和运动事件记忆均为 0.0%。消融方面，去掉失败记录后成功率降至 1.7%。摘要未报告与真实机器人相关的结果，也未报告随机种子、样本量或统计显著性。
AI.conclusion: 对具身智能中长时程操作策略而言，该工作提示：事件记忆的取舍判据可以直接锚定在“是否改变成功概率”上，而非感知或运动新颖性，并且正向进展与负向失败信息可能都需要保留。但证据仅来自一个成功概率可精确计算的十子任务诊断环境，摘要未提及真实机器人验证或与其他学习式记忆方法的数值对比，因此结论目前限于该诊断设置内的作者报告结果。
AI.core_method: 用 critic 估计每个事件对最终成功概率的改变量，只保留改变大的事件并分别记为进展或失败记录，从而把完整观测历史压缩成紧凑事件记忆。

key_results.setting: 十子任务诊断环境，成功概率被精确计算（模拟/诊断设置，非真实机器人）；基线为 36 步观测窗口与运动事件记忆。
key_results.evidence_quote: In a ten-subtask diagnostic environment with exactly computed success probabilities, CGEM achieves 88.0% success, compared with 0.0% for both a 36-step observation window and a kinematic event memory.

key_results.finding: 去掉失败记录后成功率降至 1.7%。
key_results.setting: 同一诊断环境下的消融，移除失败记录（摘要未报告其余消融条件或样本量）。

limitations: 摘要未报告真实机器人实验或部署结果，全部结果来自十子任务诊断环境。
摘要未报告随机种子、试验次数、样本量或统计显著性。

d40b79897c6f2d66ff66082a8a39085f67aa7f12.title: BlinkMimic: Training a Humanoid Motion Tracker in Minutes on a Single GPU
d40b79897c6f2d66ff66082a8a39085f67aa7f12.comment: 18 pages, 5 figures. Code: this https URL
d40b79897c6f2d66ff66082a8a39085f67aa7f12.summary: Whole-body motion tracking lets a humanoid robot follow reference motions, but training a tracking policy for a library of motions has usually taken hours of GPU time. SuperMimic showed that the policy can instead be trained by backpropagating through a world model learned from parallel simulation, and InstantTrack added Muon updates, a residual policy around the reference and an averaged deployed policy. We build on both and present BlinkMimic, a recipe that makes this training faster. On a simulated Unitree G1, BlinkMimic trains one policy for all 40 LAFAN1 clips in 3.4 minutes on a single RTX 4090, measured until three consecutive checkpoints reach a normalized return of at least 0.82 with no failed clip (mean of three seeds). We split training time into the cost of an iteration, the iterations needed to fit the motions, and the iterations needed to remove the last failures, and assign each component, inherited or new, to one of these terms. The new components are a step size that decreases once training has progressed, resets directed by failures of the deployed policy under deployment conditions, and GPU graph capture of the whole iteration. A leave-one-out ablation with three seeds per component shows which term each component affects, and further measurements of the gradient, the update rule and the failure cases explain these effects. Code and per-seed results are available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: BlinkMimic 在 SuperMimic/InstantTrack 的世界模型反传训练路线上叠加三项改动（步长衰减、失败引导的重置、整迭代 GPU graph 捕获），在仿真 Unitree G1 上 3.4 分钟、单张 RTX 4090 训出覆盖 40 条 LAFAN1 动作的单一全身跟踪策略。
AI.motivation: 摘要指出，为人形机器人的一个动作库训练全身运动跟踪策略通常要耗费数小时 GPU 时间；已有工作 SuperMimic 证明可通过并行仿真学到的世界模型反传训练策略，InstantTrack 又加入 Muon 更新、围绕参考动作的残差策略和平均后的部署策略，作者在此基础上继续压缩训练时间。
AI.method: 输入是 LAFAN1 参考动作库与并行仿真中的 Unitree G1 环境；沿用 SuperMimic 的世界模型反传训练与 InstantTrack 的 Muon 更新、参考动作残差策略、平均部署策略，并新增三个组件：训练进展后触发的步长衰减、按部署条件下部署策略失败定向的重置、以及覆盖整个迭代的 GPU graph 捕获。作者把训练时间拆成“单次迭代开销 / 拟合动作所需迭代数 / 去除最后失败所需迭代数”三项，并把每个组件归入其中一项，输出是用于全部 40 条动作的单一策略，以及按项归因的留一消融与梯度、更新规则、失败案例的测量。
AI.result: 在仿真 Unitree G1 上，单一策略覆盖全部 40 条 LAFAN1 动作，单张 RTX 4090 用时 3.4 分钟；判定标准为连续三个 checkpoint 的归一化回报至少 0.82 且无失败动作，取三个随机种子的平均。相对“通常数小时 GPU 时间”的既有状况，这是作者给出的时间对比，摘要未给出与 SuperMimic/InstantTrack 的具体数值。作者报告了每个组件三个种子的留一消融（用于确定各组件影响哪一时间项），但摘要未给出消融数值或加速百分比。
AI.conclusion: 对具身智能的意义在于：人形全身跟踪策略的训练成本可压缩到分钟级，且训练不再直接依赖在线仿真采样，而依赖从并行仿真中学得的世界模型反传，这使“世界模型 + 反传”成为快速获得运动技能库的一条可行路径，也让按迭代开销/收敛迭代/尾段失败迭代三项做工程归因的做法可被复用。证据边界：结果仅在摘要所述的仿真 Unitree G1 与 40 条 LAFAN1 动作上报告，未报告真机验证、未报告消融数值，也未给出与其他基线的数值对比。
AI.core_method: 在世界模型反传训练配方上加入训练后期步长衰减、按部署策略失败定向重置状态、以及整迭代 GPU graph 捕获，从而压缩收敛所需迭代与每次迭代开销。

key_results.finding: 把训练时间分解为单次迭代开销、拟合动作所需迭代数、去除最后失败所需迭代数三项，并将每个继承或新增组件归入其中一项
key_results.setting: 摘要未报告各分项的具体数值或占比
key_results.evidence_quote: We split training time into the cost of an iteration, the iterations needed to fit the motions, and the iterations needed to remove the last failures, and assign each component, inherited or new, to one of these terms.

limitations: 摘要未报告与 SuperMimic、InstantTrack 逐项对比的数值结果，因此 3.4 分钟相对基线的实际加速幅度无法从摘要得知。
摘要未报告任何真机实验：结果在仿真 Unitree G1 上给出，作者也未声称真机部署。

2d1bc05f1d7fcd8dcc1da97ab090dcf9cf4d1033.title: ManiLadder: Benchmarking Robot Manipulation Through a Categorized and Multi-Difficulty Level Task Ladder
2d1bc05f1d7fcd8dcc1da97ab090dcf9cf4d1033.summary: Recent advances in robotic manipulation have enabled increasingly complex and dexterous behaviors, yet existing benchmarks still focus on simple pick-and-place tasks and lack a systematic framework for measuring progress in robot learning along the axis of task difficulty. We present ManiLadder, a large-scale and organized simulation benchmark for robotic manipulation. ManiLadder contains 112 carefully designed tasks stratified into 4 difficulty levels, with 8 categories in each level, spanning rigid-body and deformable-object manipulation, single-arm and dual-arm settings, and gripper and dexterous-hand end-effectors. To calibrate difficulty, we fix the data amount the same for every task and use a unified flow- matching imitation learning policy under the same training and evaluation protocols, then use its evaluation success rate as an operational empirical difficulty signal. All tasks are iteratively refined until they fall into target difficulty ranges, which are then verified across different random seeds, policies, and agentic learning systems. We further analyze the task properties, compare different policy performances and training settings, analyze task transfer and data scaling behaviors, and conduct real-world experiments showing that the designed tasks preserve their difficulty ordering beyond simulation. ManiLad- der provides a calibrated ladder for measuring, comparing, and advancing robotic manipulation capabilities. More results are available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 现有操作基准多为简单抓放任务、缺少沿难度轴衡量进展的系统框架；ManiLadder 提出含 112 个任务、4 个难度等级、每级 8 个类别的仿真基准，用固定数据量的统一 flow-matching 模仿学习策略成功率标定难度，并在真实实验中显示难度排序仍成立（摘要未报告数值）。
AI.motivation: 摘要指出，机器人操作虽已出现更复杂灵巧的行为，但现有基准仍聚焦简单抓放任务，缺少沿任务难度轴系统衡量机器人学习进展的框架。
AI.method: 输入是 112 个精心设计的操作任务，按 4 个难度等级分层、每级 8 个类别，覆盖刚体与可变形物体操作、单臂与双臂设定、夹爪与灵巧手末端执行器。做法是把每个任务的数据量固定为相同，用统一的 flow-matching 模仿学习策略在相同训练与评测协议下运行，把该策略的评测成功率当作可操作的经验难度信号；任务被迭代精修直至落入目标难度区间，再在不同随机种子、不同策略与 agentic learning 系统上验证。产出是一个经过标定的大型仿真难度阶梯基准，并附带任务属性分析、不同策略性能与训练设置比较、任务迁移与数据扩展行为分析，以及真实世界实验。

6294015cfef25b35c7c5297a047d348c120f8fc1.title: VOKE: Visual Object Kinematics Estimator for Dexterous In-Hand Manipulation
6294015cfef25b35c7c5297a047d348c120f8fc1.comment: 8 pages, 4 figures, 6 tables. Submitted to the 2027 IEEE International Conference on Robotics and Automation (ICRA 2027). Project page: this https URL
6294015cfef25b35c7c5297a047d348c120f8fc1.summary: Vision-based dexterous in-hand manipulation requires knowing not only where an object is, but also how it moves. However, most robotic manipulation systems rely on off-the-shelf visual perception models whose outputs are limited to static object masks, geometry, or 6D poses, leaving downstream controllers to infer object dynamics implicitly from noisy visual observations. We present VOKE, a kinematics-aware perception framework that augments existing object and hand-object pose estimators to recover a complete object kinematic state comprising pose, linear and angular velocity, and linear and angular acceleration. VOKE contains two core perception modules and a downstream application study. First, a Pluggable Kinematics Module (PKM) attaches to the output of a standard pose estimator and predicts the object's linear and angular velocity and acceleration from temporal visual features. Second, a Kinematics-guided Pose Refinement Module (KPRM) converts this motion vector into a second-order, motion-prior reference pose and refines the per-frame pose estimates. We evaluate VOKE on DexYCB and OakInk, where it consistently improves object pose estimation across three different backbones and substantially reduces velocity and acceleration estimation error compared with pose differencing. As a downstream application, we use Kinematics-Augmented Reinforcement Learning (KARL) to compare a kinematics-augmented policy with a pose-history baseline. After training the policies in simulation, we transfer the kinematics-augmented policy to the physical robot without policy fine-tuning, demonstrating the complete perception-to-control pathway in the target domain.

AI.tldr: 针对视觉灵巧手内操作中感知只输出静态掩码、几何或6D位姿、动力学需控制器从噪声视觉观测中隐式推断的问题，VOKE 在现成位姿估计器上附加运动学模块，显式输出物体线/角速度与线/角加速度并据此精修逐帧位姿。作者称其在 DexYCB 与 OakInk 上跨三种骨干一致提升位姿估计、较位姿差分显著降低速度与加速度误差，且仿真训练的运动学增强策略零微调迁移到真机。
AI.motivation: 多数机器人操作系统依赖现成视觉感知模型，输出仅限静态物体掩码、几何或6D位姿；下游控制器只能从带噪视觉观测中隐式推断物体动力学。作者认为这不足以支撑视觉灵巧手内操作——该任务不仅要知道物体在哪，还要知道它怎么动。
AI.method: VOKE 是一个运动学感知框架，在已有物体位姿估计器与手-物位姿估计器的输出之上做增广，目标是恢复完整物体运动学状态：位姿、线速度与角速度、线加速度与角加速度。其中可插拔运动学模块（PKM）接在标准位姿估计器输出之后，从时序视觉特征预测物体的线/角速度与加速度；运动学引导位姿精修模块（KPRM）把该运动向量转换为二阶运动先验参考位姿，并据此精修每帧位姿估计。下游用一个运动学增强强化学习（KARL）设置，把运动学增强策略与位姿历史基线策略对比，策略在仿真中训练，随后在无策略微调的情况下迁移到实体机器人。
AI.result: 作者报告三类结果，均无具体数值。其一，在 DexYCB 与 OakInk 两个数据集上，VOKE 跨三种不同骨干网络一致提升物体位姿估计。其二，相对位姿差分（pose differencing）这一比较对象，速度与加速度估计误差被显著降低。其三，运动学增强策略在仿真中训练后无策略微调迁移到实体机器人，用于展示面向目标域的完整感知到控制通路；摘要未报告该策略与位姿历史基线的对比结论，也未给出任何位姿、速度或加速度的数值指标、单位或统计显著性。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提示：把速度与加速度作为显式可估计量嵌入感知层，可能比仅提供静态位姿更有利于手内操作的策略学习，且运动学感知在仿真中学到的策略可零微调落到实体机器人上。但证据边界明确：摘要未给出任何数值结果、真机任务成功率或定量对比，所谓位姿提升与误差降低均为作者陈述，比较对象、幅度与条件未量化，也未报告运行效率，因此不能据此断言相对已有方法的具体增益或真机性能水平。
AI.core_method: 在现成物体/手-物位姿估计器之后插入运动学模块，用时序视觉特征预测物体速度与加速度，并以二阶运动先验参考位姿反过来精修每帧位姿。

key_results.finding: 在 DexYCB 与 OakInk 上，VOKE 跨三种不同骨干网络一致提升物体位姿估计（作者称一致提升，摘要未给出数值）。
key_results.setting: 评测数据集：DexYCB 与 OakInk；比较对象为三种不同的骨干位姿估计器；具体指标、数值与条件摘要未报告。
key_results.evidence_quote: We evaluate VOKE on DexYCB and OakInk, where it consistently improves object pose estimation across three different backbones and substantially reduces velocity and acceleration estimation error compared with pose differencing.

key_results.finding: 相对位姿差分（pose differencing）这一基线，速度与加速度估计误差被显著降低（作者称大幅降低，摘要未给出数值）。
key_results.setting: 比较基线：由位姿差分得到的速度与加速度；评测数据集为 DexYCB 与 OakInk；具体误差指标、单位、幅度与条件摘要未报告。
key_results.evidence_quote: where it consistently improves object pose estimation across three different backbones and substantially reduces velocity and acceleration estimation error compared with pose differencing

key_results.finding: 运动学增强策略在仿真中训练后，在无策略微调条件下迁移到实体机器人。
key_results.setting: 下游应用：Kinematics-Augmented Reinforcement Learning（KARL），对比运动学增强策略与位姿历史基线；策略在仿真训练、真机无微调迁移；摘要未报告真机任务指标或与该基线的定量对比结果。
key_results.evidence_quote: After training the policies in simulation, we transfer the kinematics-augmented policy to the physical robot without policy fine-tuning, demonstrating the complete perception-to-control pathway in the target domain.

limitations: 摘要未报告任何数值结果：位姿提升幅度、速度与加速度误差的具体数值、单位及比较条件均缺失，因此“一致提升”“显著降低”仅为作者定性陈述。
摘要未报告 KARL 中运动学增强策略与位姿历史基线的对比结论与真机定量表现；真机部分只说明无微调迁移，未给出成功率和任务设置。
作者未在摘要中报告明确局限；摘要也未报告统计显著性、样本量、计算开销或实时性等信息，这些属于摘要未报告项，而非该方法的已知缺陷。

61c40019785a85a60ccad05bd4681c2d8cd93a0a.title: PERA: Plug-in Experts for Robotic Actions in Continual Whole-Body Control
61c40019785a85a60ccad05bd4681c2d8cd93a0a.summary: Motion imitation enables humanoid robots to acquire whole-body skills such as walking and dancing. However, fine-tuning an entire policy for a new skill can affect existing behaviors, while training a separate policy for each skill increases training and maintenance costs. We present PERA, a method for learning new skills by reusing existing motion capabilities. PERA freezes a pretrained mixture-of-experts policy and trains an additional task expert and its routing score using task rewards or teacher-action supervision. In Unitree G1 simulation, each added task module contains approximately 1.03% of the parameters of the base actor. Built on our pretrained policy, PERA successfully completes all ten new tasks. Disabling the expert restores the original computation path of the base policy, which still fully executes all 126 original motions. Enabling the expert also improves the execution of some dance motions not used to train that expert, indicating that its benefits extend beyond its training motions. Experiments with HoloMotion further demonstrate the applicability of PERA to different base policies.

AI.tldr: PERA 冻结预训练混合专家（MoE）全身控制策略，只为每个新技能额外训练一个任务专家及其路由分数，从而在不破坏原有动作的前提下持续学习新技能。
AI.motivation: 动作模仿可让类人机器人获得行走、跳舞等全身技能，但为新技能微调整个策略会损害已有行为，而为每个技能单独训练一个策略会提高训练与维护成本。摘要指出需要一个能复用已有运动能力、只增量学习新技能的方法。
AI.method: 输入是一个预训练的混合专家（MoE）类人全身控制策略，以及一个新技能的学习信号（任务奖励或教师动作监督）。PERA 不更新基座策略，而是冻结它，并额外训练一个任务专家和一个路由分数，决定何时调用该专家。输出是扩展后的策略：启用专家时完成新任务，禁用专家时恢复到基座策略原本的计算路径。相对基线的改变在于不整体微调、也不为每个技能独立训练完整策略，只添加小型插件式模块。
AI.result: 作者报告：在 Unitree G1 仿真中，每新增一个任务模块约占基座 actor 参数量的 1.03%；在预训练策略基础上，PERA 完成了全部十个新任务；禁用专家可恢复基座策略原计算路径，且仍能完整执行全部 126 个原始动作。作者还称启用专家会改善部分未用于训练该专家的舞蹈动作，并用 HoloMotion 实验说明 PERA 可适用于不同基座策略。摘要未报告成功率、与微调或独立策略基线对比的具体数值，也未报告真机结果。
AI.conclusion: 对持续全身控制而言，该工作提出一种插件式的技能增量学习思路：保持基座策略不变、仅学习少量专家参数，可能同时降低遗忘与维护成本。证据仅来自摘要，且局限在 Unitree G1 仿真与无量化对比的任务完成度陈述；其在新基座策略与真机上的可扩展性尚未由摘要中的数字支持。
AI.core_method: 冻结预训练 MoE 策略，只训练一个新增任务专家及其路由分数来注入新技能，禁用该专家即可回到原策略路径。

key_results.finding: 每个新增任务模块的参数量约为基座 actor 参数量的 1.03%，即新增技能只需很小的参数开销。
key_results.setting: Unitree G1 仿真；基座为预训练的混合专家（MoE）策略；对比对象是基座 actor 的参数量。摘要未报告训练时长或计算量。
key_results.evidence_quote: In Unitree G1 simulation, each added task module contains approximately 1.03% of the parameters of the base actor.

key_results.finding: 在预训练策略基础上，PERA 成功完成全部十个新任务。
key_results.setting: Unitree G1 仿真，十个新任务；以作者自述完成度为准。摘要未报告成功率、任务清单或与微调/独立策略基线的对比数值。
key_results.evidence_quote: Built on our pretrained policy, PERA successfully completes all ten new tasks.

key_results.finding: 禁用新增专家后，基座策略恢复原计算路径，并仍能完整执行全部 126 个原始动作，作者据此说明原有能力未被破坏。
key_results.setting: Unitree G1 仿真；对比条件是启用/禁用新增专家。摘要未报告各动作的成功率或量化遗忘指标。
key_results.evidence_quote: Disabling the expert restores the original computation path of the base policy, which still fully executes all 126 original motions.

limitations: 摘要未报告真实机器人实验：所有结果均在 Unitree G1 仿真中给出，不能据此推断真机部署效果。
摘要未报告量化评测细节：没有新任务成功率、与整体微调或每技能独立策略基线的对比数值，也没有统计显著性、样本量或消融实验。
摘要未报告 HoloMotion 实验的具体设置与数值，仅称该实验表明 PERA 适用于不同基座策略；此外未报告训练/维护成本的实际测量值。

a236f65b1b8458f1ae4bb5c15154c40d2301fb4e.title: STVLA: Spatial-aware and Temporal-memory forVision-Language-Action Models
a236f65b1b8458f1ae4bb5c15154c40d2301fb4e.summary: Robotic manipulation often requires both spatial scene understanding and task history. However, many vision-language-action (VLA) policies rely primarily on current observations, without explicitly integrating spatial structure and task history. Appearance-based memories can be sensitive to occlusion and viewpoint changes, while spatial representations of the current scene alone do not preserve how the scene has changed during task execution. We introduce STVLA, a framework that incorporates features from a pretrained visual geometry foundation model into temporal memory alongside visual representations. This allows the policy to recall past scene structure as context for current action decisions. To select informative history, STVLA uses a mathematically grounded scoring rule that balances relevance to the current observation with complementary evidence from memory. Across evaluations on LIBERO, LIBERO-Mem, MIKASA-Robo, and SimplerEnv Bridge, STVLA achieves the highest average success rate among the compared methods on each benchmark. On real-world block stacking, object organization, and phone packaging, it improves success over $\pi_{0.5}$ by $58.33$, $30.00$, and $35.00$ percentage points, respectively. These results support integrating scene geometry into temporal memory to improve manipulation requiring both spatial precision and task history. Project website: \href{ this https URL }{ this https URL }

AI.tldr: STVLA 把预训练视觉几何基础模型的特征并入时序记忆，让 VLA 策略在决策时回看过去的场景结构；作者称在 LIBERO、LIBERO-Mem、MIKASA-Robo、SimplerEnv Bridge 上平均成功率均为对比方法中最高，并在真实世界三项任务上相对 π0.5 提升 58.33、30.00、35.00 个百分点。
AI.motivation: 摘要指出：许多 VLA 策略主要依赖当前观测，没有显式整合空间结构与任务历史；基于外观的记忆对遮挡和视角变化敏感，而仅用当前场景的空间表示又无法保留任务执行中场景如何变化。因此需要一种既包含场景几何、又保留历史变化信息的记忆。
AI.method: 输入是当前观测与历史记忆。STVLA 把预训练视觉几何基础模型提取的特征与视觉表示一起写入时序记忆，使策略能把过去的场景结构召回作为当前动作决策的上下文；为挑选有信息量的历史，使用一个有数学依据的打分规则，在当前观测的相关性与记忆中的互补证据之间做平衡。输出是动作决策。相对摘要所述的"仅依赖当前观测"的基线，改动点在于把几何特征纳入记忆而非只存外观。
AI.result: 作者报告在 LIBERO、LIBERO-Mem、MIKASA-Robo 和 SimplerEnv Bridge 四个基准上，STVLA 的平均成功率在每个基准上都高于所对比的方法，但摘要未给出任何具体数值、单位或对比方法名称。真实世界任务上给出数值：相对 π0.5，方块堆叠提升 58.33 个百分点、物体整理提升 30.00 个百分点、手机包装提升 35.00 个百分点（百分点，非相对百分比）。
AI.conclusion: 若这些作者报告的结果成立，说明把场景几何并入时序记忆，可能对同时需要空间精度与任务历史的操作任务有帮助；但证据边界明显：基准结果只有"最高平均成功率"的定性声明而无数字，真实世界结果仅相对 π0.5 一个基线、未报告试验次数、随机性或显著性，也未报告消融。对世界模型方向，本工作提供的是"记忆过去的场景结构"这一时序上下文机制，摘要未说明是否包含对未来的预测或动力学建模。

key_results.finding: 真实世界方块堆叠、物体整理、手机包装三项任务上，成功率相对 π0.5 分别提升 58.33、30.00、35.00 个百分点。
key_results.setting: 真实世界操作任务（方块堆叠、物体整理、手机包装）；对比基线为 π0.5；试验次数、随机种子与统计显著性摘要未报告。
key_results.evidence_quote: On real-world block stacking, object organization, and phone packaging, it improves success over $\pi_{0.5}$ by $58.33$, $30.00$, and $35.00$ percentage points, respectively.

43f4a0f104291da11e03a07863cb775d04e60200.title: APG-Planner: Learning Vision-Based High-Speed Trajectory Planning via Analytic Policy Gradient
43f4a0f104291da11e03a07863cb775d04e60200.summary: Vision-based high-speed navigation requires a trajectory planner that can reactively generate smooth, collision-free trajectories from onboard visual observations. Deep reinforcement learning offers a promising approach to vision-based trajectory planning, as it enables the optimization of sequential decision-making policies in complex environments. However, model-free policy gradient methods rely on sample-based policy gradient estimation, which yields noisy gradient estimates and inefficient training. To this end, we propose a framework for learning trajectory planning policies using the analytic policy gradient (APG) method and use it to train APG-Planner, a vision-based high-speed trajectory planner. The proposed framework leverages differential flatness to analytically reconstruct vehicle states from planned trajectories, thereby enabling differentiable trajectory-level state transitions without requiring an explicit low-level dynamics model. By iteratively performing trajectory planning and differentiable state transitions, we construct a differentiable episode rollout and analytically compute policy gradients from episode-level losses, improving both training efficiency and policy performance. After approximately 30 minutes of training on a single GPU, APG-Planner demonstrates comparable or superior performance to existing baseline methods in simulation and achieves speeds of up to 11\,m/s in real-world flight experiments. We further validate the proposed framework on a skid-steer ground robot, demonstrating its applicability to differentially flat robotic systems beyond quadrotors.

AI.tldr: APG-Planner 针对视觉高速轨迹规划中模型无关策略梯度噪声大、训练效率低的问题，用微分平坦性构造可微的轨迹级状态转移，并从回合级损失解析计算策略梯度。作者报告单 GPU 约 30 分钟训练后仿真性能与现有基线相当或更优，真实飞行实验最高速度达 11 m/s。
AI.motivation: 视觉高速导航需要从机载视觉观测反应式生成平滑、无碰撞轨迹；而模型无关策略梯度依赖样本估计，梯度噪声大且训练效率低。
AI.method: 输入是机载视觉观测，学习目标是生成轨迹规划。方法利用微分平坦性从规划轨迹解析重建车辆状态，使轨迹级状态转移可微且无需显式低层动力学模型；通过迭代轨迹规划与可微状态转移构造可微回合回放，并从回合级损失解析计算策略梯度。相对依赖样本估计的模型无关策略梯度，它直接解析求梯度，以提升训练效率和策略性能。输出为用于高速导航的轨迹规划。
AI.result: 作者报告：在仿真中，单 GPU 约 30 分钟训练后，APG-Planner 与现有基线方法相比性能相当或更优；在真实世界飞行实验中速度最高达 11 m/s。摘要未报告具体仿真基准、指标名称、基线名称或真实世界对照结果；另在滑移转向地面机器人上验证了框架适用性，但摘要未给该平台的定量结果。
AI.conclusion: 这表明解析策略梯度有潜力提高视觉高速轨迹规划的样本效率与性能，并扩展到除四旋翼外的微分平坦机器人系统；但摘要只支持“仿真中相当或更优”和“真实飞行最高 11 m/s”的有限证据，缺少基线、指标数值和真实世界对照，不能据此推断更广泛部署效果。
AI.core_method: 用微分平坦性把规划轨迹解析还原为可微状态序列，再基于回合级损失解析求策略梯度。

afdc530730ff0cc9210eee16d863c1ff1f284116.title: I See What You Want: Decoding Hierarchical Operator Intent from Visual Teleoperation History
afdc530730ff0cc9210eee16d863c1ff1f284116.comment: 8 pages, 6 figures. Project page: this https URL
afdc530730ff0cc9210eee16d863c1ff1f284116.summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) have become a powerful foundation for robotic scene understanding, task planning, and language-conditioned control. A natural question follows: can these models also decode what a human operator intends while teleoperating a robot, without any explicit instruction? We formulate this as hierarchical intent prediction, jointly inferring the ongoing atomic action and the broader mission it serves from a short visual teleoperation history. To study this, we introduce VI AMO (Vision Intention Action and Mission Ongoing), a dataset of 6,600 episodes from eleven robot sources with 13,653 temporally aligned action annotations and 9,702 mission annotations. Large proprietary models struggle with this problem: on held-out episodes, GPT-4o reaches Sentence-BERT similarities of only 0.563 and 0.470 for action and mission, and GPT-5.6 Luna achieves only 0.581 and 0.554. Fine-tuning a VLM on VI AMO yields our Vision-Intention Model (VIM), which raises these scores to 0.825 and 0.821 and still reaches 0.726 and 0.717 on the 35.4% of test actions with both labels absent from training. Finally, as a downstream application, VIM's predicted mission enables a vision-language-action (VLA) policy to take over from the operator mid-task in a real-world environment unseen during VIM fine-tuning, reducing human teleoperation time by 34.6% relative to GPT-4o and 39.8% relative to GPT-5.6 Luna, while cutting intent-prediction latency by roughly 70% on average.

AI.tldr: 论文把“从短视觉遥操作历史推断操作者意图”形式化为分层意图预测（同时推断当前原子动作与更高层任务使命），发布 VIAMO 数据集并微调 VLM 得到 VIM；在留出片段上把 Sentence-BERT 相似度从 GPT-4o 的 0.563/0.470 提升到 0.825/0.821，并在真实环境下游接管中相对 GPT-4o 减少 34.6% 遥操作时间。
AI.motivation: 视觉语言模型已用于机器人场景理解、任务规划与语言条件控制，但摘要指出一个尚未回答的问题：这些模型能否在没有任何显式指令的情况下，仅凭一段简短的视觉遥操作历史解码人类操作者的意图。作者同时在摘要中说明大型专有模型在该问题上表现不佳（GPT-4o 动作/使命相似度仅 0.563/0.470），这构成了研究动机。
AI.method: 输入是一段简短的视觉遥操作历史；监督信号来自 VIAMO 中时间对齐的原子动作标注与任务使命标注。方法上的变化是对一个 VLM 在 VIAMO 上做微调（而非直接使用大型专有模型），得到 Vision-Intention Model（VIM），输出是当前正在进行的原子动作与它所服务的更宏观使命。下游使用时，VIM 预测出的使命被用来让一个视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略在任务中途从操作者手中接管。摘要未说明模型规模、微调方式、提示格式或是否使用额外模态。
AI.result: 作者报告三类结果：（1）大型专有模型在该任务上困难：留出片段上 GPT-4o 的 Sentence-BERT 相似度为 0.563/0.470（动作/使命），GPT-5.6 Luna 为 0.581/0.554；（2）在 VIAMO 上微调得到的 VIM 把分数提升到 0.825/0.821，且在训练中两层标签均缺失的 35.4% 测试动作上仍达 0.726/0.717；（3）下游真实环境接管中，相对 GPT-4o 减少 34.6%、相对 GPT-5.6 Luna 减少 39.8% 的人类遥操作时间，意图预测延迟平均降低约 70%。这些均为作者报告值，未经独立验证；相似度为无单位分值，时间与延迟数字为相对降幅而非百分点。
AI.conclusion: 对具身智能研究的含义是：操作者的显式指令之外，其潜在意图可能可以从视觉遥操作历史中被解码，并且该意图信号可作为一种“任务级”条件，驱动 VLA 策略在任务中途接管，从而压缩人工遥操作时长。证据边界：全部结论仅来自摘要，摘要未报告硬件、任务清单、统计显著性、按机器人来源的拆分或与在 VIAMO 上微调的其他基线的对比；因此不能据此推断方法在其他机器人平台或更长任务上的表现。
AI.core_method: 用带动作与使命双层标注的遥操作片段微调一个 VLM，使其仅凭短视觉历史直接输出当前原子动作与上层任务使命。

key_results.finding: 在留出片段的分层意图预测上，GPT-4o 的动作与使命 Sentence-BERT 相似度仅为 0.563 与 0.470，GPT-5.6 Luna 为 0.581 与 0.554（作者用以说明大模型在该任务上表现不佳）。
key_results.setting: 任务：从短视觉遥操作历史做分层意图预测（同时预测原子动作与任务使命）；评测：留出片段上的 Sentence-BERT 相似度；基线：GPT-4o 与 GPT-5.6 Luna，摘要未说明其提示或微调设置。
key_results.evidence_quote: Large proprietary models struggle with this problem: on held-out episodes, GPT-4o reaches Sentence-BERT similarities of only 0.563 and 0.470 for action and mission, and GPT-5.6 Luna achieves only 0.581 and 0.554.

key_results.finding: 作为下游应用，VIM 预测的使命使 VLA 策略能在任务中途接替操作者，在 VIM 微调未见过的真实环境中把人类遥操作时间相对 GPT-4o 减少 34.6%、相对 GPT-5.6 Luna 减少 39.8%，同时意图预测延迟平均降低约 70%。
key_results.setting: 任务：真实世界中由 VLA 策略中途接管遥操作；条件：环境在 VIM 微调时未见过；对照：GPT-4o 与 GPT-5.6 Luna；指标：人类遥操作时间相对降幅、意图预测延迟相对降幅。摘要未报告硬件、任务数量、延迟测量的具体条件。
key_results.evidence_quote: reducing human teleoperation time by 34.6% relative to GPT-4o and 39.8% relative to GPT-5.6 Luna, while cutting intent-prediction latency by roughly 70% on average.

limitations: 作者在摘要中未报告任何自身局限性（例如失败案例、标注歧义、跨机器人来源的泛化问题），也未报告统计显著性检验；这些均为摘要未报告的信息，而非方法缺失的证据。
摘要未报告基线模型的具体使用方式（是否为零样本提示或其他设置）、11 个机器人来源的构成，以及 VIAMO 的采集条件与标注一致性信息。

3de65af74587ed5ecceb9b7ce50957c224027442.title: EgoX: Egocentric Cross-Embodiment Manipulation with Embodiment Dreaming
3de65af74587ed5ecceb9b7ce50957c224027442.summary: Generalist manipulation policies can benefit from the complementary experience of humans, real robots, and simulated agents. However, differences in morphology, sensing, and control interfaces make it difficult to learn effectively from their combined demonstrations. We introduce EgoX, an egocentric cross-embodiment learning framework that organizes heterogeneous demonstrations through semantically corresponding observation and action modalities. EgoX pretrains a Modularized Cross-Embodiment Transformer with Embodiment Dreaming (MXT+) on this mixture and fine-tunes it on target-embodiment demonstrations. Within each embodiment, MXT+ assigns a dedicated tokenizer to each observation modality and a dedicated expert to each action modality, with a Transformer trunk shared across embodiments. A training-only embodiment-dreaming objective predicts latent representations of future visual and proprioceptive states, encouraging the shared trunk to model each embodiment's dynamics. Across 13 task-embodiment pairs spanning five tasks and six robot embodiments, including five physical robots and one simulated humanoid, cross-embodiment pretraining raises MXT+'s average normalized task progress from 0.63 to 0.80 over training from scratch. The gains are particularly pronounced under out-of-distribution conditions, where average task progress increases from 0.53 to 0.77. Ablations demonstrate the benefits of broader pretraining mixtures, modular interfaces, and embodiment dreaming, with dreaming producing more similar latent geometry across embodiments. Project page: this http URL .

AI.tldr: EgoX 用"语义对应的观测/动作模态"组织人类、真实机器人与仿真智能体的异构演示，预训练 MXT+（含仅训练期的"具身做梦"目标）后在目标具身上微调；在 13 组任务-具身对上，平均归一化任务进度由从零训练的 0.63 提升到 0.80。
AI.motivation: 通用操作策略有望受益于人类、真实机器人与仿真智能体的互补经验，但形态、感知与控制接口的差异使这种混合演示难以被有效利用。
AI.method: 输入是来自多来源（人类、真实机器人、仿真智能体）的异构演示，先按语义对应的观测模态与动作模态重新组织成可共享的数据结构。方法学习的是 MXT+（Modularized Cross-Embodiment Transformer with Embodiment Dreaming）：在每种具身内部，每个观测模态配一个专用 tokenizer、每个动作模态配一个专用专家，而 Transformer 主干跨具身共享；训练时额外加入"具身做梦"目标，预测未来视觉与本体感受状态的隐表示，促使共享主干为每种具身建模其动力学。流程为在此混合数据上预训练，再在目标具身演示上微调，最终产出该目标具身上的操作策略。
AI.result: 作者报告：在覆盖 5 个任务、6 种机器人具身（5 台物理机器人 + 1 个仿真人形）的 13 组任务-具身对上，跨具身预训练把 MXT+ 的平均归一化任务进度从 0.63 提升到 0.80（相对于从零训练）。分布外条件下增益更明显，平均任务进度从 0.53 提升到 0.77。消融显示更广的预训练混合数据、模块化接口与具身做梦均有收益，且做梦使不同具身间的隐空间几何更相似（消融未给出数值）。
AI.conclusion: 对具身智能的意义在于：跨具身（含人类与仿真）演示可通过"按语义对齐模态 + 共享主干 + 分具身 tokenizer/专家"的结构被统一利用，而预测未来隐状态的辅助目标似乎有助于对齐不同具身的动力学表示。证据仅限于摘要所述 13 组任务-具身对的平均归一化进度与分布外进度，以及定性消融结论；未报告的泛化边界、单具身分解与真实/仿真分别的贡献无法从摘要判断。
AI.core_method: 把不同具身的观测与动作按语义对应的模态切分，给每个模态配专用 tokenizer/专家、共享同一 Transformer 主干，并用仅训练期的未来视觉与本体状态隐表示预测（具身做梦）对齐各具身动力学。

7ed281d55a36e7119d92d07564a2f7575d4bba1e.title: What Can a VLA Learn from the Agent That Calls It? Task-Level Experience Distillation for Embodied Navigation
7ed281d55a36e7119d92d07564a2f7575d4bba1e.summary: Navigation agents use a large language model (LLM) planner to call a vision-language-action (VLA) model. Each episode needs the LLM, adding cost and delay. We distill successful agent experience into the VLA instead of distilling the planner. The VLA then navigates alone at test time. Agent sessions are not VLA demonstrations. They include motions driven by planner tools and sub-instructions, along with detours. We present H2E, a task-level experience distillation method that converts these sessions into VLA training data. Every motion becomes a VLA action under the original task instruction, with the resulting poses as targets. H2E masks the loss on steps that move away from the goal. It labels every visited state within 1 m of the goal as a stop. We then update the VLA with low-rank adaptation. The VLA learns to stop at the goal and find goals the base model never reaches. On all 3,189 REVERIE-CE val-unseen episodes, H2E raises the success rate of an 8B VLA from 35.0% to 44.9%.

AI.tldr: H2E 把"LLM 规划器调用 VLA"的整段导航会话转成任务级训练数据，用 LoRA 微调 VLA，使其在测试时无需 LLM 规划器即可单独导航。作者报告在全部 3,189 个 REVERIE-CE val-unseen 回合上，8B VLA 成功率由 35.0% 升至 44.9%。
AI.motivation: 现有导航智能体由 LLM 规划器调用 VLA 执行，每个回合都需要 LLM，带来额外成本与延迟。作者指出直接蒸馏规划器并非其选择，而是希望把成功智能体的经验蒸馏进被调用的 VLA，使 VLA 测试时可独立完成导航。
AI.method: 输入是智能体的成功会话记录，作者强调这类会话不是干净的 VLA 演示：其中包含由规划器工具和子指令驱动的动作以及绕路。H2E 做任务级经验蒸馏：把每一段运动都视作在"原始任务指令"下的一个 VLA 动作，并以实际到达的位姿作为目标；对偏离目标方向的步骤在损失上做掩码；把距目标 1 m 以内的每个访问状态标注为"停止"。产出的数据用于以低秩适配（LoRA）更新 VLA，输出是一个测试时无需 LLM 规划器、能停在目标处并找到基座模型原本到不了的目标的 VLA 策略。
AI.result: 作者报告在全部 3,189 个 REVERIE-CE val-unseen 回合上，H2E 将 8B VLA 的成功率从 35.0% 提升到 44.9%（相对自身基座模型，同一评测集全部回合）。此外作者以定性方式声称 VLA 学会了在目标处停止、并找到基座模型从未到达的目标；该定性说法未给出数值指标。运行形态（仿真或真机）、延迟/成本的实际下降幅度、训练数据规模与统计显著性均未在摘要中报告。
AI.conclusion: 对具身智能而言，该工作提出一条以任务级数据复用替代逐回合 LLM 规划的路线：把"智能体—规划器—VLA"会话变成 VLA 自身的监督信号，从而在测试时移除规划器调用。证据边界为：摘要只给出 REVERIE-CE val-unseen 上的成功率数字，未报告真实机器人实验、延迟或成本量化，也未说明与除基座模型外其他基线的比较，因此"测试时不再需要 LLM"的收益目前是作者陈述而非被量化验证的效率结论。
AI.core_method: 把含绕路与规划器动作的成功导航会话重标注为"原始任务指令下的动作—位姿对"，掩掉远离目标的步骤损失、把距目标 1 m 内的状态标为停止，再用 LoRA 微调 VLA。

key_results.finding: H2E 将 8B VLA 的成功率从 35.0% 提升到 44.9%（作者报告值，未计算差值）。
key_results.setting: 具身导航任务，评测集为 REVERIE-CE val-unseen 的全部 3,189 个回合；对比对象为同一 8B VLA 基座模型；摘要未报告是仿真还是真机、是否与其他方法对比。
key_results.evidence_quote: On all 3,189 REVERIE-CE val-unseen episodes, H2E raises the success rate of an 8B VLA from 35.0% to 44.9%.

key_results.finding: 作者声称更新后的 VLA 学会在目标处停止，并能找到基座模型从未到达的目标（定性陈述，无数值）。
key_results.setting: 摘要未报告具体任务指标、评测集或统计量；仅为作者对学习效果的定性描述。
key_results.evidence_quote: The VLA learns to stop at the goal and find goals the base model never reaches.

limitations: 作者虽以成本与延迟为动机，但摘要未报告任何延迟或成本数值，也未报告硬件信息；测试时移除 LLM 规划器的效率收益未被量化。
摘要未报告实验形态（仿真或真机）、是否与其他方法对比、训练会话数量、LoRA 超参或统计显著性，这些属于摘要未报告，而非方法缺陷。
作者自述的数据难点是会话并非 VLA 演示（含规划器工具/子指令驱动的运动与绕路），H2E 通过掩码偏离目标步骤与 1 m 内停止标注来应对；摘要未报告该处理引入的失败模式或消融结果。

e5cb291f0563930f3e4f78fa7a2562366a8e7238.title: FORGE: Force-Aware Multi-Granularity Control for Efficient Humanoid Loco-Manipulation
e5cb291f0563930f3e4f78fa7a2562366a8e7238.summary: Humanoid loco-manipulation requires coordinated locomotion, balance regulation, and manipulation under frequent contacts, making teleoperated demonstration collection difficult: a practical controller must simultaneously provide precision, stability, and contact awareness. We propose FORGE, a force-aware multi-granularity control system with a coarse-to-fine command space spanning velocity navigation, planar foot placement, wrist-pose tracking, and optional force-conditioning inputs. Policy training requires no full-body human motion trajectories or joint-angle references; deployment consumes only sparse bilateral wrist poses relative to the pelvis, coarse motion commands, and optional desired wrist-load inputs. For sustained contact, FORGE combines a momentum observer with a learned correction trained using simulator contact-force supervision. At deployment, it estimates low-frequency, wrist-equivalent interaction forces from proprioception and reconstructed low-level arm PD torques, without wrist force/torque sensors. A quasi-static virtual-target loop uses this estimate and an optional desired applied-force input to adapt the wrist target. A frozen locomotion prior and asymmetric residual actions stabilize manipulation-induced whole-body corrections. Experiments evaluate unified-control stability, task-space tracking, quasi-static wrist-equivalent force estimation, squeezing forces during sustained contact with a rigid box, and downstream diffusion-policy execution of a squat-and-lift task across payload conditions. Website: this https URL .

AI.tldr: FORGE 提出一种力感知、多粒度的人形机器人全身 loco-manipulation 控制接口：训练不需要人体全身运动轨迹或关节角参考，部署只用骨盆相对的稀疏双腕位姿、粗粒度运动指令和可选期望腕部载荷；无腕力/力矩传感器即可估计腕等效力并用于准静态目标修正。摘要未报告任何数值结果。
AI.motivation: 人形 loco-manipulation 需要在频繁接触下同时协调行走、平衡与操作，因此遥操作示范采集困难；一个实用的控制器必须同时提供精度、稳定性和接触感知能力。摘要指出这正是现有做法难以兼顾的缺口。
AI.method: 输入：部署时仅用骨盆相对的稀疏双腕位姿、粗粒度运动指令，以及可选的期望腕部载荷输入。方法改变：构建由粗到细的指令空间（速度导航 → 平面足部落点 → 腕部位姿跟踪 → 可选力条件输入），把底层控制拆成多粒度接口；训练阶段不需要全身人体运动轨迹或关节角参考。持续接触部分把动量观测器与一个学习到的修正项结合，后者用仿真器接触力监督训练。部署时从本体感受与重建的低层手臂 PD 力矩中估计低频“腕等效力”，不使用腕部力/力矩传感器；再用该估计和可选期望作用力，通过准静态虚拟目标环去调整腕部目标。此外用冻结的运动先验与不对称残差动作来稳定操作引起的全身修正。输出：可执行的全身 loco-manipulation 控制指令序列与力估计。
AI.result: 摘要列举了实验评估的维度（统一控制稳定性、任务空间跟踪、准静态腕等效力估计、与刚性箱持续接触时的挤压力、以及下游扩散策略在不同载荷条件下执行蹲起搬运任务），但未给出任何数值、单位或与基线的对比，也未报告仿真与真机的区分。因此没有可提取的定量结果。
AI.conclusion: 对具身智能的启示是：把全身 loco-manipulation 的控制接口做成由粗到细、并让力感知从本体感受与 PD 力矩中隐式获得，可能降低遥操作示范采集对全身动捕与腕部力传感器的依赖；冻结运动先验加残差动作是稳定“行走 + 操作”耦合的一种设计选择。以上均为摘要自述，摘要未提供任何定量证据或真机结果，效果无法据此评估。
AI.core_method: 用由粗到细的多粒度指令空间统一行走与操作，并通过动量观测器 + 仿真接触力监督训练的学习修正项，从本体感受与 PD 力矩中隐式估计腕等效力来修正腕部目标。
limitations: 摘要未报告任何定量结果（指标、数值、单位、基线对比），也无可验证的性能声明。
未说明实验是在仿真还是真机上完成；仅提到用仿真器接触力监督训练学习修正项，真机部署情况未报告。

910015cf8583b8c231087b9cbad058e1910b6559.title: SALA: Semantically Aligned Latent Actions Enable Dual-Axis Scaling of Embodied Foundation Models
910015cf8583b8c231087b9cbad058e1910b6559.summary: Embodied foundation models hinge on diverse robot interaction data, which are costly to collect. Egocentric human videos offer a complementary source of experience, and latent action models (LAMs) provide a popular means of leveraging these videos for policy supervision. Compared with world-action models (WAMs), LAMs can offer greater training efficiency and potentially lower inference costs by avoiding explicit pixel prediction during policy learning and execution. However, most existing LAMs learn latent actions solely through video reconstruction, which can cause their representations to cluster by visual appearance rather than by the underlying actions. As a result, they struggle to align human actions with their robot counterparts. To bridge the gap, we introduce SALA, which emphasizes establishing the semantic correspondence for latent actions. Without requiring paired data, we use the language descriptions of unpaired human and robot clips to estimate semantic similarities and supervise cross-embodiment correspondence. Specifically, we translate these similarities into soft neighborhood structures that guide human latent actions toward semantically related robot latents, while robot action reconstruction grounds the latent space in control. The resulting shared latent action space provides a unified supervision signal for training an embodied foundation model on both human and robot videos. Notably, latent action supervision enables scaling along two axes: (1) pre-training on increasing amounts of general human video consistently reduces robot action prediction error on downstream tasks, and (2) post-training on increasing amounts of task-specific human video substantially improves real-world robot task success rates.

AI.tldr: SALA 用人类与机器人视频片段的语言描述估计跨具身语义相似度，把相似度转成软邻域约束来对齐人类与机器人的隐动作，从而在人类和机器人视频上统一监督具身基础模型；作者报告两条缩放轴趋势，但摘要未给出任何数值。
AI.motivation: 机器人交互数据采集成本高，第一视角人类视频是补充来源，但多数既有隐动作模型仅靠视频重建学习隐动作，表示会按视觉外观而非底层动作聚类，因此难以把人类动作与对应的机器人动作对齐。
AI.method: 输入是无配对的人类视频片段与机器人视频片段、它们的语言描述，以及机器人动作数据。方法不要求配对数据，用语言描述估计跨具身语义相似度，把这些相似度转成软邻域结构，引导人类隐动作靠近语义相关的机器人隐动作；同时用机器人动作重建把隐空间锚定在控制上。输出是一个共享隐动作空间，作为统一监督信号在人类与机器人视频上训练具身基础模型。相对仅用视频重建的既有 LAM，改变点是加入基于语言描述的语义对应监督而非依赖配对数据。
AI.result: 作者报告了两个方向性缩放趋势，但摘要未报告任何具体基准名称、指标数值、单位或基线数值：(1) 预训练人类视频量增加时，下游机器人动作预测误差持续下降；(2) 后训练任务相关人类视频量增加时，真实世界机器人任务成功率显著提升。摘要只把 LAM 相对世界动作模型（WAM）的训练效率与潜在推理成本优势作为定性宣称，未给数据。
AI.conclusion: 对具身基础模型而言，该工作提示隐动作监督可能同时沿数据规模（人类视频预训练）与任务适配（任务相关人类视频后训练）两条轴扩展，且跨具身对齐可借助语言语义而非配对数据。但证据仅限摘要的定性描述：没有数值、基准或基线，无法判断改善幅度，也无法确认结论在真实机器人上的具体强度。
AI.core_method: 用无配对视频的语言描述计算跨具身语义相似度，转化为软邻域约束把人类隐动作对齐到语义相近的机器人隐动作，再用机器人动作重建锚定控制。

key_results.setting: 下游机器人动作预测任务；具体基准、指标数值与基线摘要未报告。
